chapters.title: Chapter 1101: Lightning Bead
paragraphs: Since the situation in the sky had calmed down and there were no more lightning bolts striking, the cultivators who had previously been watching from below immediately flew up into the sky. However, Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, Luo Zhenhai, and the five Luo Ancestors immediately blocked them.
They created a formation to prevent those people from approaching Luo Yunxiao and Zhang Fei, especially since the lightning tribulation had not yet ended.
Those people immediately recognized their attire, especially since Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were the leaders of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.

A middle-aged man and a middle-aged woman immediately approached Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi, cupping their hands to the two. "Sect Master Luo and Vice Sect Master Huang, long time no see, but I didn’t expect those two young ones to be members of your sect."
"Are they the disciples of your sect? Otherwise, you guys wouldn’t have gathered here specifically to protect them, right?" The middle-aged woman asked.

Huang Xiaoyi nodded her head in response. "You’re half right, Sect Master Lu Shaqing. The young man is our disciple, and the young woman is his wife. Although he has just broken through to the Five Celestial Realm, his talent ranks among the best of our sect’s disciples, and we brought him here because his previous breakthroughs have consistently caused trouble in our domain."
"What’s his name, Vice Sect Master Huang?" The middle-aged man asked.

"His name is Zhang Fei, Sect Master Gong Wei." The two people immediately remembered something, but Huang Xiaoyi dismissed their guess directly. "Even though he has the Zhang surname, he is not a member of the Zhang Clan of the Martial Starfall Domain. Actually, he ascended to this realm not long ago, about five years ago."

"Five years ago?" Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing were surprised again, and they looked at Zhang Fei. "According to his bone age, that kid is only in his early forties, which means he reached the peak mortal cultivation under 40 years old."

"That’s true." Lu Shaqing nodded in agreement with Gong Wei. "Many young cultivators from this realm managed to reach the peak that quickly, but it’s truly a miracle for a cultivator from the three mortal realms to be able to accomplish such a feat with the Qi being so weak there, which proves his talent in cultivation. In addition to his cultivation, he is also a master of swordsmanship, and the sword technique he used earlier demonstrated his understanding of the sword dao."

Gong Wei nodded with a solemn expression. "He is a swordmaster in his early forties, but he has already attained the Sword Dao. Although I’m not a swordmaster myself, I know that reaching that stage is not easy. Even that sword maniac, Jian Kuang, took thousands of years to achieve it. Look at him; he seems to be an alchemist as well, and his alchemy level shouldn’t be low if he dares to think about refining the core of his lightning tribulations. Do you know his alchemy rank, Vice Sect Master Huang?"
Huang Xiaoyi turned to Luo Fenghan, who immediately answered the man, "His alchemy rank is God Rank."
"God... Rank...!" Both Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing stammered as their eyes widened in shock. "Are you serious, Sect Master Luo? How can he learn so many things at once?"

"Have you ever witnessed such realistic clones?" Luo Fenghan pointed to Zhang Fei’s five clones, making both of them shake their heads in response. "He can learn everything because of his clones, which shortens his learning time."
"Then—"
"He’s already started." Lu Shaqing stared at Zhang Fei’s alchemy furnace, which was already smoldering from his flames.
"What kind of flame is that? Why have I never seen a golden flame before?"

"The Golden Crow Flame." Gong Wei looked shocked when Lu Shaqing said that. "As far as I know, there are only two beast races that possess golden flames. The first is the Golden Dragon Emperor, Long Wuzhao. The second is the Golden Crow Race, and this kid’s flame is theirs, which means this kid has a connection with them."

Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi naturally knew his relationship with the Golden Crow Race from the Three Mortal Realms, but they didn’t say anything to Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing, leaving them to guess. They focused more on Zhang Fei, who had begun to refine the core of his lightning tribulations.
"Hmm?" Luo Yunxiao seriously watched the Heaven Creation Furnace, which continued to churn due to the attacks of those lightning bolts from within.

Zhang Fei’s five clones immediately sat around the furnace, and they used their golden crow flames as well. "Heaven gives birth to materials, Earth nurtures them, and Man refines them! Alchemy is not just about concocting pills, and it is a miracle from the heavens. My flame can burn anything, but it can also create anything! This is my Dao of alchemy!"
A few minutes later, their flames flared up and rose upwards, forming a giant silhouette of the Golden Crow, which amazed all the spectators.
Witnessing that, Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing became even more convinced that Zhang Fei had ties to the Golden Crow Race; otherwise, he would not be able to summon such a silhouette.

After a few hours, the heat from their flames gradually weakened the resistance of the lightning tribulation core, and it no longer fired lightning bolts. Additionally, the situation in the Moon Illusion Domain had returned to normal, bringing relief to Zhang Fei and his five clones.
[Congratulations! The host’s cultivation broke through to the 1-Sun Celestial Lord.]
[Ding]
[Generated new daily quests.]
[Daily quest I: Absorb 10,000,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1000 purple jewels.]
[Daily Quest II: Absorb 10,000,000 demon essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade demon cores.]
[Daily Quest III: Absorb 10,000,000 beast essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade beast cores.]
[Daily Quest IV: Killing 1000 beasts/demon beasts in the Celestial Lord or above.]
[Reward: Celestial daily pack x1]

’Hmm?’ Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow as the four notifications appeared, especially since three of the four daily quests were no different from back then. However, the third daily quest was a little complicated, especially since he only had two ways to get beast essence. First, he could dual cultivate with a female beast, and second, he had to use the essence-absorption ability.
[Ding]
[Generated new quests.]
[Quest: Join a sect.]
[Reward: Sect Gift Pack x1]
[Quest: Build up a deep relationship with beast races.]
[Reward: Beast Gift Pack x1]
[Quest: Build up a deep relationship with natural races.]
[Reward: Natural Gift Pack x1]
[Quest: Build up a deep relationship with demon races.]
[Reward: Demon Gift Pack x1]
[Other quests will appear when the host goes to certain places.]
’Tch! Even the system forced me to join a sect!’ Zhang Fei inwardly cursed.

[Haha! Unlike in the Three Mortal Realms, you don’t have backers in the Paradise Realm. Therefore, I think it’s natural for the system to give you such a quest, Master. Furthermore, all of your wives have agreed to let you join the Moonlit Passion Temple, right? After you go to the Forgotten Land, you can go directly to the Twin Flames Domain to join that sect, and you can look for the mysterious woman who gave the Forbidden Lotus Codex to you.]
"Yeah." After the furnace had calmed down, Zhang Fei and his five clones withdrew their flames. He opened the lid and took out a small object with a flash of lightning in it from the furnace. "Hmm?"
"Master!" Lei exclaimed as he flew to their side. "Master! I didn’t expect you to successfully create a lightning bead!"
"A lightning bead?"
"Yes." Lei took it from his hand. "This lightning bead is a condensation of the lightning from your lightning tribulations, and it is beneficial for cultivators with the lightning element, like me."

"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao chuckled and rubbed Lei’s head. "He’s right, husband. In this realm, you can find not only lightning beads but also other elemental beads, and their prices are usually exorbitant. After all, condensing an element into an elemental bead is truly difficult, and not every alchemist can do it."

Zhang Fei smiled wryly at that. "Honestly, I don’t know anything about elemental beads, and I managed to create this lightning bead by pure chance. I used my alchemy techniques to refine the core, just like I was concocting pills, and the result was this bead."

"Even though you managed to create it by chance, you’ve already memorized the process, right?" Zhang Fei nodded to Luo Yunxiao. "Since you have several different elements, you can use the same method to create the other beads, and you can sell them in your shop later."
Zhang Fei once again nodded to Luo Yunxiao before shrinking the Heaven Creation Furnace and storing it again in the system’s inventory. "You can swallow the lightning bead, Lei."
"Thank you, Master!" After he swallowed the lightning bead, Lei immediately entered Zhang Fei’s body again.

Luo Yunxiao then looked at the cultivators who crowded the sky of the Moon Illusion Domain. "Husband, these people come from various domains, and I believe news about you will definitely spread quickly in this realm. The Fairy King will probably hear about you soon, so you should start preparing to face him."

"Phew." Zhang Fei exhaled softly and stood up. "I expected this situation to happen, so I’ve been preparing myself for a long time. However, I won’t make any moves for now, especially since my strength is still not enough to face them."

chapters.title: Chapter 1102: Luo Clan’s Ancestors’ Decision
paragraphs: After his clones returned to the training room, Zhang Fei brought Luo Yunxiao to Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi, who introduced him to Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing. "Sect Master Gong comes from the Zenith Sect, and Sect Master Lu comes from the Spring Breeze Pavilion, both of which are located in the Sun-Moon Main Domain."

Zhang Fei immediately read their status. According to the data, Gong Wei’s cultivation has reached the 2-Sun Celestial Venerable, and Lu Shaqing’s cultivation has reached the 1-Sun Celestial Venerable, just like Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi.

"Although my Spring Breeze Domain is a universal sect, we focus more on the Wind Element, and three-quarters of our members are wind cultivators. As for the rest, they have different elements." Lu Shaqing explained it to Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao.

Gong Wei also explained it to them. "My Zenith Sect is also a universal sect, but half of our members are body cultivators. One-quarter are formation array masters, and the rest of my members study various other fields, including swordsmanship."
"What about you, Sect Master Gong? Are you a body cultivator or a formation array master?" Zhang Fei curiously asked.

"Haha." Gong Wei laughed in response. "Honestly, I’m interested in formation arrays, but I don’t have any talent in that field. I’m kind of a muscle-head person, so I prefer the body cultivation path and blacksmithing. My body cultivation has long reached the Diamond Body Stage, but I have never managed to break through to the Divine Body Stage."

Zhang Fei then slowly spoke. "When body cultivators break through to the Divine Body Stage, we will surpass the limits of blood, bone, and marrow, transforming their physical form into something that can contend with heaven and earth. Our bodies become divine, capable of harnessing and unleashing the power of heaven and earth."
"Oh?" Gong Wei was surprised. "Are you also a body cultivator?"
Zhang Fei smiled at his question. "Just like you, my body cultivation has also reached the Diamond Body Stage, Sect Master Gong."
"Did...did you just say that your body cultivation has also reached the Diamond Body Stage?" Gong Wei asked stutteringly.

Lu Shaqing was also shocked by this, and she thought she had misheard. However, Zhang Fei’s smile proved that his body cultivation had indeed reached that stage. "You heard it right, Sect Master Gong. Look at his confidence; his body cultivation should be on par with yours."
"How... how did you manage to reach this stage so quickly?" Gong Wei was completely shocked by that.

Zhang Fei immediately explained to him. "Sect Master Gong, the mistake of common body cultivators is that they think that they cannot learn more than one body cultivation technique, mainly because learning one technique and reaching the peak stage is already too difficult. In reality, we can learn several techniques at once, and our body cultivation level will improve faster if we learn many techniques at once. Even so, we still have to temper our bodies with external help, such as pills, liquid, and other similar items."

"I agree with you." Gong Wei replied with a nod. "In fact, I mastered three body cultivation techniques; otherwise, my body cultivation level would not have reached this stage today. Even so, I only managed to reach this stage after I became a body cultivator for thousands of years, so I was really shocked by your body cultivation level. So, how many techniques have you mastered?"

"As you have seen before, I have five clones. Currently, I have mastered seven body cultivation techniques, and most of them have reached peak level." Zhang Fei’s answer made Gong Wei let out a heavy sigh, but it also spurred his spirit to do even better. "Honestly, I still don’t want to stop studying body cultivation techniques, and I want to master as many as I can."

Gong Wei nodded in understanding. "In this universe, you’re probably the only cultivator who can learn so many techniques at once, especially since no one else has such realistic clones like yours. If you are interested in learning body cultivation techniques, you can try visiting my sect. I know you’re a disciple of the Immortal Lotus Sect, but I think it wouldn’t be a problem if you also wanted to join my sect."

"Eh?" Zhang Fei stole a glance at Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi, as he didn’t expect that they would introduce him to Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing as a disciple from their sect. "Thank you for your offer, but I still haven’t decided my next step, Sect Master Gong."
"It’s okay; you don’t need to rush." Gong Wei replied with an understanding nod. "By the way, I’ll be returning to my disciples, or they’ll slack off if I don’t supervise them."
After Gong Wei left, Lu Shaqing asked Zhang Fei. "Who taught you your clone technique? I have a clone technique myself, but my clones only have 50% of my strength."

After she said that, Lu Shaqing immediately summoned two clones, and Zhang Fei could sense that they only had half of her overall strength. "No one taught me that technique, and I found it in the Star Tower."
"The Star Tower?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Back then, I was trapped in an area filled with human bones, and I found an intact skeleton holding a scroll. After I read it, it turned out to be my clone technique, but the scroll did not write the name of the technique or its owner."

"Hmm?" Lu Shaqing tried to recall if she had ever encountered someone from the Paradise Realm who possessed such a technique in the past. However, she was sure that she had never met or heard of someone with that technique.

Luo Yunxiao spoke directly to her. "Sect Master Lu, there are so many mysteries in the cultivation world, as well as many rogue cultivators who don’t want to be known by others. The owner of that technique was probably a rogue cultivator in the past, so you may not have met or heard of that person before."
"You’re probably right about that." Lu Shaqing then asked her. "Did he teach you that technique?"

Luo Yunxiao responded with a shake of her head. "That technique requires too much Qi to maintain the clones, and my Qi capacity is insufficient to learn it. Even if I learn it, I’ll probably only be able to create one clone for a short duration, so I think it’s just a waste of my time to learn it. As for my husband, he was born with a much greater Qi capacity than most cultivators, so he has no difficulty using the technique."

"One of the advantages and disadvantages of cultivators is their Qi capacity. Some cultivators are born with normal Qi capacity, some with high Qi capacity, and some with too low a Qi capacity, preventing them from going very far in their cultivation path." Lu Shaqing then asked Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi. "When will you two depart for the Divine Samsara Sect? The portal to the Forgotten Land should open in a week, right?"

Huang Xiaoyi answered Lu Shaqing directly. "I won’t be going to the Forgotten Land this time, but my husband will take Zhang Fei and his wife there in three days. If I’m not mistaken, Beiming Youhuang will also be going there."
"I see." Lu Shaqing nodded in understanding. "In that case, I will return to my disciples now, and we will meet again in the Forgotten Land."
After Lu Shaqing left, Luo Jieyi and the others approached Zhang Fei and the others. "Let’s go back, and we want to talk to you, kid."
"Yes."

A while later, they were gathered in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and Luo Jieyi spoke directly to Zhang Fei. "Kid, we’ve heard about your matter with the Fairy King. Although you’re part of our Luo Clan now that you’re Little Yunxiao’s husband, I regret to inform you that we don’t want to get involved in the matter between you two."

Luo Yunxiao clenched both fists after Luo Jieyi said that, and her other ancestors also gave their nods of agreement. She wanted to refute them, but Zhang Fei immediately stopped her. "Ancestors, I know that Yunxiao asked you all to be on my side, especially since you are her family. However, I can understand your decision, and I don’t have a problem with it. Moreover, I have never relied on anyone since I started my path of cultivation, and I have always tried to solve all my problems myself. If I run into a dead end and am unable to resolve my issues, I will seek assistance from my wives, family members, and allies. They may not be as strong as you all now, but they will become much stronger in the future, and their numbers are far more than enough to help me."
"Hmm?" All of them frowned in response, especially since they didn’t know anything about Zhang Fei’s other wives, family members, or allies. "How many allies do you have now?"

"Thousands." Zhang Fei’s answer surprised them a bit. "My organization is the Demon Fox Group, and all of them have reached the Seven Divine Realms, with some already reaching the Five Celestial Realms. With my status as a God-Rank Alchemist, I can concoct many pills that are beneficial to speeding up their cultivation. They are nothing compared to the cultivators in this realm, but one day in the future, everyone in this realm will hear of their names."

"In this universe, you’re probably the only cultivator who can learn so many techniques at once, especially since no one else has such realistic clones like yours.
If you are interested in learning body cultivation techniques, you can try visiting my sect.
I know you’re a disciple of the Immortal Lotus Sect, but I think it wouldn’t be a problem if you also wanted to join my sect."
"Eh?" Zhang Fei stole a glance at Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi, as he didn’t expect that they would introduce him to Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing as a disciple from their sect.
"Thank you for your offer, but I still haven’t decided my next step, Sect Master Gong."
"It’s okay; you don’t need to rush." Gong Wei replied with an understanding nod.
"By the way, I’ll be returning to my disciples, or they’ll slack off if I don’t supervise them."
After Gong Wei left, Lu Shaqing asked Zhang Fei.
"Who taught you your clone technique?
I have a clone technique myself, but my clones only have 50% of my strength."
After she said that, Lu Shaqing immediately summoned two clones, and Zhang Fei could sense that they only had half of her overall strength.
"No one taught me that technique, and I found it in the Star Tower."
"The Star Tower?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"Back then, I was trapped in an area filled with human bones, and I found an intact skeleton holding a scroll.
After I read it, it turned out to be my clone technique, but the scroll did not write the name of the technique or its owner."
"Hmm?" Lu Shaqing tried to recall if she had ever encountered someone from the Paradise Realm who possessed such a technique in the past.
However, she was sure that she had never met or heard of someone with that technique.
Luo Yunxiao spoke directly to her.
"Sect Master Lu, there are so many mysteries in the cultivation world, as well as many rogue cultivators who don’t want to be known by others.
The owner of that technique was probably a rogue cultivator in the past, so you may not have met or heard of that person before."
"You’re probably right about that." Lu Shaqing then asked her.
"Did he teach you that technique?"
Luo Yunxiao responded with a shake of her head.
"That technique requires too much Qi to maintain the clones, and my Qi capacity is insufficient to learn it.
Even if I learn it, I’ll probably only be able to create one clone for a short duration, so I think it’s just a waste of my time to learn it.
As for my husband, he was born with a much greater Qi capacity than most cultivators, so he has no difficulty using the technique."
"One of the advantages and disadvantages of cultivators is their Qi capacity.

Some cultivators are born with normal Qi capacity, some with high Qi capacity, and some with too low a Qi capacity, preventing them from going very far in their cultivation path." Lu Shaqing then asked Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi.
"When will you two depart for the Divine Samsara Sect?
The portal to the Forgotten Land should open in a week, right?"
Huang Xiaoyi answered Lu Shaqing directly.
"I won’t be going to the Forgotten Land this time, but my husband will take Zhang Fei and his wife there in three days.
If I’m not mistaken, Beiming Youhuang will also be going there."
"I see." Lu Shaqing nodded in understanding.
"In that case, I will return to my disciples now, and we will meet again in the Forgotten Land."
After Lu Shaqing left, Luo Jieyi and the others approached Zhang Fei and the others.
"Let’s go back, and we want to talk to you, kid."
"Yes."
A while later, they were gathered in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and Luo Jieyi spoke directly to Zhang Fei.
"Kid, we’ve heard about your matter with the Fairy King.
Although you’re part of our Luo Clan now that you’re Little Yunxiao’s husband, I regret to inform you that we don’t want to get involved in the matter between you two."
Luo Yunxiao clenched both fists after Luo Jieyi said that, and her other ancestors also gave their nods of agreement.
She wanted to refute them, but Zhang Fei immediately stopped her.
"Ancestors, I know that Yunxiao asked you all to be on my side, especially since you are her family.
However, I can understand your decision, and I don’t have a problem with it.
Moreover, I have never relied on anyone since I started my path of cultivation, and I have always tried to solve all my problems myself.
If I run into a dead end and am unable to resolve my issues, I will seek assistance from my wives, family members, and allies.
They may not be as strong as you all now, but they will become much stronger in the future, and their numbers are far more than enough to help me."
"Hmm?" All of them frowned in response, especially since they didn’t know anything about Zhang Fei’s other wives, family members, or allies.
"How many allies do you have now?"
"Thousands." Zhang Fei’s answer surprised them a bit.
"My organization is the Demon Fox Group, and all of them have reached the Seven Divine Realms, with some already reaching the Five Celestial Realms.
With my status as a God-Rank Alchemist, I can concoct many pills that are beneficial to speeding up their cultivation.
They are nothing compared to the cultivators in this realm, but one day in the future, everyone in this realm will hear of their names."

chapters.title: Chapter 1103: Absorb Long Zhaihuo’s Soul
paragraphs: "Do you think we made a mistake?" Luo Meizhen asked the others after Zhang Fei and Luo Yunxiao left.
Luo Shiwen also spoke to the others. "That kid is a God Rank alchemist, and we have already experienced the effects of his pills. If he dislikes us because of our decision, we will suffer losses."

"Phew." Luo Zhigui released a soft sigh. "This is not a matter of right or wrong, but it is a matter of principle. Since our ancestor founded this sect, we have never interfered in external affairs for the safety of our clan and sect members. If you all still remember, our ancestor sacrificed his son to save this sect in the past. Zhang Fei’s status as a God Rank alchemist will indeed be useful for us, but the safety of the people is much more important."

Luo Qifeng then added. "Furthermore, the Fairy King is not a simple person; he possesses greater strength than us, despite our equal cultivation levels. Not to mention, he is suspected of having ties with the Nine Nether Demon Clan, and those demons are simply terrifying. If we encounter any problems with them, they will attack us together, which will result in many casualties."

"We have made a decision regarding this matter, and we will stick to it for now." Luo Jieyi then stood up. "As for the future, we will assess the situation more clearly first. If the situation is not too dangerous for our sect and clan, we will change our decision."
Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi, who heard that, could only shake their heads. ’Ancestor Jieyi! You don’t know Zhang Fei! It will be too late if you want to change your decision in the future.’
"Let’s go back." Luo Jieyi and the other four immediately disappeared.
Huang Xiaoyi let out a soft sigh before asking her husband. "Are we going to follow their decision?"

"Haha." Luo Fenghan laughed in response. "Do you think I’ll follow their decision, wife? Zhang Fei and Yunxiao are our children; thus, I will always be by their side, and I will help them as much as I can. By the way, you should go to the Huang Clan and discuss this matter with my parents-in-law and the others, and I’m sure they will also support our children."
Huang Xiaoyi nodded in agreement. "In that case, I will go there and meet my parents now."
"Alright."

"You don’t need to act like this, okay?" Zhang Fei spoke to Luo Yunxiao, who continued to wear a gloomy look. "They are indeed your ancestors, but they have no obligation to side with us. If I were in their shoes, I would probably take the same decision as theirs, especially if these problems endanger all of you."
"But—"

"No buts, okay?" Zhang Fei stopped walking and grabbed her shoulders. "Yunxiao, I started my path of cultivation without anyone’s help, and I struggled to build my relationships and strength to reach this stage myself, remember? If I could do it in the past, I’m sure I can do it in the future, so you don’t need to worry about their decisions. Moreover, I’m no longer alone now, and I have all of you by my side. We aren’t as strong as your ancestors, but we will surpass them in the future, and they’ll regret their decisions today."
Luo Yunxiao released a soft sigh as she nodded. "Since you have broken through to the Five Celestial Realms, it is time for you to take my virginity, and my Yin Qi will be of great help to you."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed and carried Luo Yunxiao directly into the pavilion. Once he informed his other wives, he took her to the main bedroom, where they began to dual cultivate.

Quickly, three days passed in the outside world, which was equivalent to twelve days in the training space. During these days, Zhang Fei spent his time with Luo Yunxiao, leaving her exhausted several times. As for the daily quests, his five clones completed them.

Early in the morning, Zhang Fei [5] brought three women to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, especially since Luo Fenghan would take them to the Heavenlight Main Domain before they went to the Forgotten Land.

Zhang Fei decided not to use his real body because all his wives had not yet reached the Five Celestial Realms, and he wanted to focus on helping them first. Moreover, his clone has the same strength as his real body, and his fifth clone does not have many wives.

When they arrived at the sect, Luo Yunxiao immediately took Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing to meet her parents. Zhang Fei [5] brought them because they had long broken through to the Five Celestial Realms, and they were keen to explore new places with him.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] went to see Luo Zhenhai to ask about the purification process of Long Zhaihuo’s soul.
"How did it go, Senior?" Luo Zhenhai turned to Zhang Fei [5] before leading him to the Purification Crystal, where Long Zhaihuo’s soul was being purified. "It’s done, huh?"

"Yes." Luo Zhenhai took out the soul and handed it to Zhang Fei [5]. "However, his past strength is below yours now, so it won’t be of much use to you. However, his soul power is still useful to you, including his past abilities stored within it."

Zhang Fei [5] directly released his soul and absorbed Long Zhaihuo’s soul. Although he gained the soul’s past strength, it was not that significant, and the increase in his soul power was too minuscule. Despite this, he obtained several new abilities from the soul, quite satisfying him. "Thank you for your help, Senior."
"Kid."
"Yes?"
"Are you disappointed with their decision?"

"Why should I be disappointed by that, Senior?" Zhang Fei [5] asked back with a smile. "Everyone has their own principles and thoughts, and we cannot force our will on them. If I were in their shoes, I would probably make the same decision, so I don’t feel disappointed at all. Moreover, I have many subordinates, and I will never stop strengthening them. One day in the future, I will lead them to stand at the top of the cultivation world, and the cultivators in this realm will respect them."

"Hahaha." Luo Zhanhai grabbed his shoulder. "If those two brats said this, I would definitely laugh at them. However, you have already proven that you can break through from the 1-Moon Divine Expansion Realm to the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm in five years, so I believe you will succeed. At that time, I will see you stand at the pinnacle of the cultivation world and surpass all cultivators in this realm, including the Golden Dragon Emperor."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded with a determined look. "I assure you that day will come, Senior."

After chatting for a while, Zhang Fei [5] left to join Luo Yunxiao and the others, while Luo Zhenhai continued to watch him and pondered his thoughts. "What exactly happened? He only did five years of seclusion, but his bone age increased by twenty years, which should have been impossible. Could it be that he has other tricks? Is that the reason his cultivation increased so quickly? Sigh! Forget it! I don’t need to think about it, and I will look forward to the day when he fulfills his dream of becoming the strongest. Unfortunately, those five made the wrong decision, and they will regret it in the future."

When Zhang Fei [5] arrived there, Luo Fenghan had already taken out his flying artifact. Apart from Luo Yunxiao, Yan Jiwnu, and Sima Huiqing, his father-in-law decided to take his two brothers-in-law and their wives.

Luo Fenghan spoke to him. "Son, I know you can take us to that domain faster, but we should go using the normal route. Moreover, news about you should have spread widely in other domains by now, and you will attract people’s attention if you use your movement technique."
"I understand, father-in-law." Zhang Fei [5] then turned to Beiming Youhuang and Hua Xiang’er, who had just arrived.

Beiming Youhuang and Hua Xiang’er were shocked when they sensed Zhang Fei [5]’s cultivation had already reached the 1-Sun Celestial Lord, especially since he had only broken through to the 1-Moon Divine Expansion Realm five years ago. "When did you break through?"
"My husband broke through three days ago, Master." Luo Yunxiao answered her master.

Beiming Youhuang nodded slightly. "I didn’t expect him to actually reach the Five Celestial Realms in just five years. However, I feel there’s something strange about the two of you, especially since your bone ages have increased by twenty years."
"Oh! That’s right!" Luo Fenghan just remembered that. "How could this happen, Son? How did your bone age increase by twenty years?"

Luo Yunxiao turned to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately answered their father. "Father-in-law, in everyone’s eyes, we’ve been in seclusion for five years, but in reality, we’ve been in seclusion for twenty years. Thus, you shouldn’t be surprised if our bone ages increase by twenty years, and we will age faster than other people if we continue our seclusion."
"How can you do that?" Luo Fenghan asked again. Beiming Youhuang and Hua Xiang’er were also curious about that.

Luo Yunxiao immediately spoke. "Father! Master! We’ll talk about that another time, and we have to go to the Heavenlight Main Domain now! My husband will take us to the portal to the border, and we’ll go to the Divine Samsara Sect using a flying artifact."
"Let’s go."

chapters.title: Chapter 1104: Heavenlight Main Domain
paragraphs: Beiming Youhuang and Hua Xiang’er were completely shocked as Zhang Fei [5] brought them all to the border in just a blink of an eye, but Luo Fenghan immediately led them to the gate that connected to the Heavenlight Main Domain.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Heavenlight Main Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
As soon as they passed through the gate, Luo Fenghan hurriedly took out his flying artifact, enlarged it, and took everyone on board.
Shortly after them, several other flying artifacts appeared behind them, and their number continued to grow to thousands, carrying cultivators from various domains in the Paradise Realm.

The Heavenlight Main Domain is a place of tranquility and light. The light is gentle and steady, and the land is peaceful. The air is calm, and the Qi is perfectly clean and balanced. This domain is where cultivators live, train, and meditate without much distraction.

The land, sea, and sky were filled with various types of beasts from many races. Unlike other domains, these beasts showed no hint of aggression, and the flying beasts flew merrily, undisturbed by their presences.

Even though the distance was still very far, they could see a protective dome stretching for several miles in every direction. The barrier protects the only sect in the domain, the Divine Samsara Sect. Although their number is not as large as in other domains, there are many large and small cities scattered in several corners of the domain.

Hidden behind the Divine Samsara Sect was the portal to the most sacred place in the Paradise Realm, the Forgotten Land that was long sealed after the appearance of the Primordial Flame, better known as the Eternal Flame.

From a distance, they could see the majestic buildings of the Divine Samsara Sect. The main building of the sect is constructed in a circle or spiral, symbolizing the endless cycle of samsara. It is built of plain stone with minimal decoration. The sect surroundings are simple—trees, open courtyards, and a tranquil lake.

According to the story, the Divine Samsara Sect focuses on the cycle of life, death, and rebirth. Its teachings center around understanding one’s past lives, correcting past mistakes, and improving the soul through each lifetime. The sect is quiet and disciplined. Its members value reflection, patience, and inner clarity. Cultivators are taught to remain calm, control their emotions, and accept the changes that come with time and fate.
Zhang Fei [5] stood in front of the flying artifact with Luo Yunxiao, Yan Jinwu, and Sima Huiqing. They looked around them, both in the sky and on the ground.
Unlike Luo Yunxiao, Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing were amazed by the situation in the Heavenlight Main Domain.

Like all cultivators in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, Sima Huiqing had long resigned herself to waiting for her lifespan to run out. Even though her cultivation had long since reached the pinnacle of mortal cultivation, she could never break through. However, things changed for her after the battle back then, which paved the way for her to improve herself.

At first, Shang Huiqing didn’t like her situation, especially since she was no different from Zhang Fei [5]’s slave, even though he didn’t enslave her directly and just merged their souls together. However, after living with him for more than two decades, she changed her mind, and she has completely accepted her fate. Her cultivation had already broken through to the Five Celestial Realms, specifically 3-Sun Celestial Lord, thanks to him.

Similar to her, Yan Jinwu never thought that she would succeed in reaching the Five Celestial Realms, much less set foot in the Paradise Realm. Things started to change for her after Zhang Fei [5]’s arrival to the Sky Dragon Realm, and her fate entirely changed after he took her as one of his wives. Even though her husband was a clone, she was completely satisfied with her decision and their relationship, which brought many changes to her life.
"That’s the Divine Samsara Sect, husband," Luo Yunxiao spoke, pointing her index finger forward.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "The materials used to build the sect aren’t luxurious, but their main building still looks magnificent from here. Moreover, their protective dome is also extraordinary, and it should be a peak-grade one, which costs a lot to create."

"Hehehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled. "Back then, the sect was founded by a combination of all the cultivators in the Paradise Realm, except for the demon races. However, they changed and became independent, which was due to their arrogance. They even separated themselves from their main clans and created new clans of their own."

"Many people are like that, right? When they are successful and reach a higher level, they prefer to follow their ambitions rather than their roots." Luo Yunxiao nodded in agreement to Zhang Fei [5]. "Back then, Zhang Hai was a good father, and I always admired him. However, he changed after he achieved success and formed relationships with many important people, and he could no longer distinguish between good and right."

"What about you?" Zhang Fei [5] looked at Beiming Youhuang, who was walking toward them with Hua Xiang’er. "Will you remain who you are? Or will you become as arrogant as them once you become much stronger?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in response. "I’m an ordinary person with worldly emotions, and I have my arrogance. Therefore, I cannot answer your question now, and time will tell in the future. However, I dare to say with certainty that I will never turn my back on my roots, as they continue to encourage and support me to move forward, and I will never be able to reach this stage without them by my side. When I succeed in the future, I will bring everyone to enjoy the results of our hard work."
Luo Yunxiao, Yan Jinwu, and Sima Huiqing pleasantly smiled when they heard that.
"I see." Beiming Youhuang nodded slightly. "So, what are your plans next? Do you want to join one of the sects in our domain?"

"Master, my husband will go to the Twin Flames Main Domain to join the Moonlit Passion Temple after we return from the Forgotten Land." Luo Yunxiao’s revelation shocked Beiming Youhuang and Hua Xiang’er. "My mother doesn’t want him to join that sect, but all my sisters and I have agreed to let him join there."
"Why did you guys allow him to join the sect?" Beiming Youhuang asked with a frown.

Luo Yunxiao turned to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately released his soul, surprising Beiming Youhuang and Hua Xiang’er with hundreds of white lotuses blooming within. "I obtained that technique from one of the women from that sect, and I suspect that she is the leader of that sect. Therefore, I decided to go to that sect to look for her, but I still haven’t decided whether I will join or not, and I’m still thinking things over."
"What kind of lotuses are they?" Hua Xiang’er asked, paying attention to them.

"These lotuses symbolize his bond with all his wives, and there are hundreds of them because he has that many women, Senior Sister." Luo Yunxiao’s answer stunned Hua Xiang’er. "Since my husband is a dual cultivator by nature, we allow him to join the sect. However, the decision is still his, and we will find out after we leave the Forbidden Land."
"Are you really okay with him hooking up with those cheap women, Yunxiao?" Hua Xiang’er asked in a disbelieving tone.

"Senior Sister, you don’t know my husband’s character. Even if he joins the sect, he will not take all the women from the sect as his women, and he will only choose the best of them. "Please forgive me, Senior Yu. I have to decline your offer because I am a dual cultivator, and Sect Master Luo already told me that there is no dual cultivation section in this sect." Yu Shan immediately checked Zhang Fei [5]’s body, and he realized that there were so many kinds of Yin Qi in his body, proving that he was indeed a dual cultivator.

"It’s a pity." Yu Shan spoke disappointedly. "Since you are a dual cultivator, this sect is indeed not suitable for you. Instead, you should go to the Twin Flames Domain, especially since that domain is a gathering place for dual cultivators."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "I’ve thought about going to that domain myself, but I’ll do it after we look over the Forbidden Land."
Yu Shan then looked at Beiming Youhuang. "You’re still as quiet as ever, Elder Beiming."
Beiming Youhuang smiled faintly. "Talking a lot of nonsense is just a waste of energy, Elder Yu."
"Pfftt!" Luo Yunxiao almost laughed out loud listening to her master, and so did Hua Xiang’er, especially since they were the closest to Beiming Youhuang, so they knew her character by heart.

"Speaking of the Forbidden Land, our sect master and elders have decided to cancel the exemption for the younger generation starting this year onwards. Therefore, all younger generations who wish to go there must pass a series of entrance tests first." Yu Shan’s explanation made them frown because those tests were a waste of time. "You guys don’t need to worry about those tests, especially since you only need to take them once. If you successfully pass all of them, we will give you a plaque that you can use as an entry pass in the future."
Luo Fenghan immediately asked him, "What exactly happened, Elder Yu? Why did Sect Master Liang Huizhong and the others suddenly decide to change the rules and remove the exceptions?"

"Let’s go to the registration area, and I’ll explain on the way there." Zhang Fei [5] and the others immediately followed Yu Shan. "Some time ago, there was strange activity in the Forbidden Land, and we detected the movement of several demon races there. We sent several people to check, but none of them returned, including Zhan Kuang."
"Huh?" Luo Fenghan and Beiming Youhuang were shocked to hear that. "Did Elder Zhan die in there, Elder Yu?"

Yu Shan shook his head before continuing. "Zhan Kuang’s life stone is still intact, so he should still be alive. However, we’ve checked the entire Forbidden Land, including the Temple of the Forgotten Flame. Unfortunately, we couldn’t find anyone, and we suspect the demons kidnapped them. However, we can’t be certain which demon race did it because they didn’t leave any traces at all. For this event, we will send several escorts to accompany all groups, and I’ll be your group."
"I see." Luo Fengdan and Beiming Youhuang nodded in understanding. "So, when will the tests begin, Elder Yu?"

"Registration opened three days ago, and many cultivators have already registered. However, the tests will start early tomorrow morning, so I will send someone to pick you all up tomorrow." Yu Shan then spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "If you want to look for alchemy ingredients, you can go to sector five in the east, but we only have one alchemy shop in this sect."

"What about blacksmithing and formation array materials, Elder Yu?" Yu Shan immediately looked at Zhang Fei [5] with surprise. "Besides being an alchemist, I am also a blacksmith and array master, but my skills in both are only so-so."

Yu Shan released a disappointed sigh, as he was disappointed that Zhang Fei [5] preferred to become a dual cultivator. "You can find the blacksmith shop in sector two and the array shop in sector seven. Do you already have the identity tokens for those three fields? If you do, you can directly purchase items in our shops. If you don’t have them yet, you can take tests in our shops, and representatives from each field will give you identification afterward."

’Sigh! What a troublesome thing! Everything has to go through tests!’ Zhang Fei [5] then answered him. "Unfortunately, I have never tested my abilities in all three areas, so I don’t have my identity tokens yet. Do I also need them for shopping in other domains, Senior Yu?"

"Not really." Yu Shan shook his head in response. "Every domain has its own rules, and we never interfere in their affairs. However, the items in other domains aren’t as good as those in this sect, so you might consider testing your skills in all three areas."
Zhang Fei [5] suddenly saw three familiar figures who had just arrived. ’As expected! She appeared!’
"Son!"
"Do you know those three phoenixes, young man? Why does that female phoenix refer to you as her son?" Yu Shan asked as he looked at Feng Yao’s group.
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his nose. "I’ve known them since we were still living in the Three Mortal Realms, but I haven’t seen them for a long time because they ascended to this realm before me."
"I see." Yu Shan nodded in understanding, but he did not recognize Yan Jinwu’s identity as a golden crow beast.

Soon, Feng Jiu had arrived in front of them and grabbed Zhang Fei [5]’s shoulders. "Hey! I didn’t expect you to have ascended to this realm, and Yao’er only told us a few days ago. Moreover, your cultivation is nowalmost on par with both mine and my husband’s."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed as he stole a glance at Feng Yao, who wore a playful smile on her face. "Mother-in-law, you have to punish your daughter. I arrived a long time ago, but she didn’t come to see me again after she picked me up on the first day I arrived in this realm."
’Mother-in-law?’ Not only was Yu Shan shocked to hear that, but also Beiming Youhuang and Huang Xiang’er.
"Hehe." Feng Jiu chuckled and looked at her daughter. "Yao’er, he misses you so much."

Feng Yao immediately stood in front of Zhang Fei [5] and pressed her index finger against his chest. "You’ve finally reached the 1-Sun Celestial Lord, but your cultivation is still far behind mine. As I said in the past, if you want me to acknowledge you as my husband, you have to surpass me first. Therefore, you must cultivate even more diligently, or you will continue to lag behind me."
’Shameless! You are the reincarnation of a primordial being, remember?’ Zhang Fei [5] grabbed Feng Yao’s hand. "Don’t worry, I will surpass you one day, and I will pin you under me at that time."
"Hahaha!" Feng Jiu laughed out loud at Zhang Fei [5]’s shamelessness. "Are you impatient to give me a grandchild, son?"
"Naturally," Zhang Fei [5] shamelessly replied.
Feng Yao’s lips curled upwards. "Words are meaningless without proof, okay?"
"You’ve always lived in my heart, so you should know that I’m not just talking, right?" Feng Yao nodded to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately looked at Feng Tian. "Long time no see, Father-in-law."
Feng Tian nodded slightly as he smiled faintly. "Incredible! We ascended earlier than you, but you’re almost on our level now." ’What about our race? Did you bring them with you?’
’Not yet.’ Zhang Fei [5] then informed Feng Tian and Feng Jiu about the phoenix race. ’Once everything is ready, I will bring them to this realm.’
Feng Tian and Feng Jiu nodded in understanding. ’Alright, you can arrange it, and we will follow your plan.’
"Cough!" All of them turned to Yu Shan. "Are you three phoenixes from the Soaring-Dragon Divine Domain?"

"As you heard earlier, we ascended from the Three Mortal Realms." Feng Yao took out her plaque and showed it to Yu Shan, causing his eyes to widen. His body trembled and cold sweat dripped from his forehead. "I don’t want anyone to disturb us, and you don’t need to tell those little brats about us. Do you understand?"
Yu Shan wiped his sweat. "Don’t worry, I won’t tell anyone about your return, Empress."
’Empress?’ Beiming Youhuang and Hua Xiang’er were shocked by that.
"Lead us."
"Please follow me." Yu Shan hurriedly led them all.

chapters.title: Chapter 1107: Meet Feng Bingying
paragraphs: Upon arriving at the registration hall, Luo Fenghan and Beiming Youhuang immediately followed Yu Shan to discuss their preparations. The old man invited Feng Yao to join them, but she declined and joined Zhang Fei [5] and the others instead.

"I’m satisfied with your progress." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Feng Yao in surprise. "You didn’t waste your twenty years of seclusion, and you’ve managed to reach the pinnacle in several areas. Of all that, the most important thing is that your understanding of the Dao becomes deeper."

Zhang Fei [5] smiled at that. "It’s rare to hear you praise me, you know? It’s true that I’ve reached the peak in several fields, and my understanding of the Dao is much deeper, but it’s still not enough to surpass you, right? If it weren’t for the Forgotten Land only opening every few years, I wouldn’t have come out of my seclusion, and I would have continued until all of them reached the Five Celestial Realms."

"Yeah." Feng Yao looked at the group dressed in pink, followed by Zhang Fei [5], who was also looking at them. "They are the group from the Moonlit Passion Temple, and the one leading them is You Feiling."

Sensing their gaze, the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple looked at them. The female disciples were dumbstruck by Zhang Fei [5]’s attractive looks and muscular body, but they hurriedly turned their eyes away after remembering Su Yao’s previous warning. You Feiling looked at him for a moment and smiled faintly without saying anything.

Feng Yao shook her head slightly. "You Feiling is Qing Qiu’er’s sister-in-arms, and the two of them put a lot of effort into developing the sect. Her sister should be the one who gave you the Forbidden Lotus Codex, and I’m sure she’ll be here soon."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] didn’t respond to Feng Yao and was busy reading their statuses, discovering that You Feiling’s cultivation was at the 1-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, and Su Yao’s was at the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm. Meanwhile, the other disciples had varying cultivation levels. "She is quite strong, huh? I only detected a single man’s Yang Qi in her body, but I detected something unusual from within her body, which is continuously producing Yang Qi."

"The item inside her body is the Solar Yang Seed. It’s quite rare but not too rare, and it will produce a large amount of Yang Qi for five years before dissolving on its own." Feng Yao then took out a crystal with the color of the moon, giving it to Zhang Fei [5]. "This Lunar Yin Crystal is the opposite, and it will produce a large amount of Yin Qi for five years before dissolving on its own."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] received and observed the seed. "Since this seed was born from nature, it should be possible to duplicate it, right?"
"Try it."

Zhang Fei [5] held the seed before using his plant generation ability. Unfortunately, the results weren’t what he had hoped for, making him sigh in disappointment. "I guess I’ll have to buy it somewhere else."
"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed. "There’s no perfect ability, right? By the way, one seed costs ten million gold coins, so you’ll only be wasting jewels if you want to buy it."
"Cough... Cough..." Zhang Fei [5] coughed as his eyes widened. "That expensive?"

Feng Yao nodded at him. "This seed is indeed useful, but there are already so many women around you. Therefore, I believe you don’t really need it, and you only need to focus on dual cultivating with them."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] immediately swallowed the seed and drove it into his dantian. Within minutes, he could feel a strong flow of Yin Qi from the seed, surprising him. "No wonder You Feiling’s cultivation can be so fast."

As they waited for their turn, Zhang Fei [5] discussed his plan to move the Phoenix Race and the other beast races to the Blazing Nirvana Domain with Feng Yao, especially since he didn’t have much faith in Long Wuzhao for one reason or another.
Feng Yao agreed with Zhang Fei [5]’s plans, but she asked him to wait for a few years, especially since she had not returned to the Blazing Nirvana Domain since she returned to the Paradise Realm.
Sometime later, they had completed their registration to undergo tests to enter the Forbidden Land, and Yu Shan sent someone to escort them to the most luxurious inn in the sect.

However, a woman was already waiting for them there along with five other women, and Zhang Fei [5] did not need to use the system to find out her identity, mainly because of the extreme cold that radiated from her body.
The woman raised an eyebrow slightly as soon as she saw Feng Yao and her parents, but she said nothing and approached them. "You’re Zhang Fei, right? Can we talk alone?"
"Feng Bingying, right?" Zhang Fei [5] turned to Luo Yunxiao and the others. "You all go to your rooms first, and I’ll talk to her."
Feng Yao also spoke to her parents. "I’ll accompany him."
After they left, Zhang Fei [5], Feng Yao, and Feng Bingying left the inn and went elsewhere.
When they arrived there, Feng Yao immediately threw an artifact, creating a small dome around them. "No one will be able to see or eavesdrop on us."
"That’s good." Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to Feng Bingying. "I’ve heard about your wishes from my parents-in-law, but I won’t allow them to go with you."
"Why?" Feng Bingying frowned.

"Didn’t my parents-in-law tell you about my relationship with Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu?" Feng Bingying frowned deeper when Zhang Fei [5] asked that. "The two of them are not my official women yet, but they are no different from my woman because they always cultivate using my Yang Qi, and we help each other in the soul cultivation path. Your domain may be the most suitable place for you and the other ice phoenixes, but the Qi and the cold there will never be able to match my Yang Qi. Additionally, I have a place that is much better than your domain, and the cold there is much more extreme than yours, which is much more suitable for them."
Feng Bingying immediately denied him. "I don’t believe you! There is no place in this realm that is much colder than my domain! At least, you can bring them here, and I will talk to them myself."
"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed. "Little girl, you are too haughty! You don’t know anything about him, so you shouldn’t look down on him or doubt his words."
Feng Bingying turned to Feng Yao. "Who exactly are you? Are you the fire phoenix from that realm?"
"I am the princess of the Phoenix Realm of the Three Mortal Realms." Feng Yao’s revelation took Feng Bingying aback for a moment. "Summon them out and let her talk to them first."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the portal to the training room. Soon, Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu emerged from it, and the Yang Qi within the bodies of the two ice phoenixes caused Feng Bingying to frown again. "She is the Feng Bingying I told you two about all those years ago, and she wanted to take you guys to her domain in the Soaring-Dragon Divine Domain."
"I’m sorry, Ancestor. I must refuse your request." Feng Jinqiu immediately rejected Feng Bingying.

Feng Xueying also rejected her. "I know you have good intentions for us, but there is no place better than Zhang Fei’s for us. Therefore, we will not go with you, and we will continue to stay at his place to improve ourselves."
"But—"

"You should give up and not force them to go with you." Feng Yao slightly released her aura, which caused Feng Bingying to shiver and unconsciously take a step back. "We are both of the same phoenix race, but we come from different realms, even though you also came from there. Furthermore, Zhang Fei is the current leader of my Phoenix Race, and we are his subordinates now."
Feng Bingying was shocked to hear that Zhang Fei was the current leader of the Phoenix Race. "How is that possible? How—"

"Didn’t you already know his true identity?" Feng Bingying nodded to Feng Yao. "Do you still think he is unfit to lead my Phoenix Race? Moreover, Feng Shizhu should have warned you not to disturb them, and she asked you to wait for him to bring them to your domain. Therefore, you should have obeyed your ancestor’s orders; otherwise, you are not worthy to lead the ice phoenix race."
Feng Bingying took a deep breath. "Who are you really? You are not an ordinary fire phoenix, right?"
"Heh." Feng Yao snorted softly. "My past name was Huo Yanling. Does that name sound familiar to you?"
"What!?" Feng Bingying exclaimed in shock and pointed her index finger at Feng Yao, stammering. "You... Are you really Empress Huo Yanling?"
Feng Yao smirked in response. "Is there a cultivator in this realm who dares to claim to be me? If any of them dares to use my identity, I’ll burn them alive."
Feng Bingying shook her head vigorously. "No! No one would dare use your identity! I... I never thought that you were the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling."
"My parents acknowledged Zhang Fei as their son-in-law, so you should know what you have to do, right?" Feng Yao asked with a sharp gaze.

Can we talk alone?"
"Feng Bingying, right?" Zhang Fei [5] turned to Luo Yunxiao and the others.
"You all go to your rooms first, and I’ll talk to her."
Feng Yao also spoke to her parents.
"I’ll accompany him."
After they left, Zhang Fei [5], Feng Yao, and Feng Bingying left the inn and went elsewhere.
When they arrived there, Feng Yao immediately threw an artifact, creating a small dome around them.
"No one will be able to see or eavesdrop on us."
"That’s good." Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to Feng Bingying.
"I’ve heard about your wishes from my parents-in-law, but I won’t allow them to go with you."
"Why?" Feng Bingying frowned.
"Didn’t my parents-in-law tell you about my relationship with Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu?" Feng Bingying frowned deeper when Zhang Fei [5] asked that.
"The two of them are not my official women yet, but they are no different from my woman because they always cultivate using my Yang Qi, and we help each other in the soul cultivation path.
Your domain may be the most suitable place for you and the other ice phoenixes, but the Qi and the cold there will never be able to match my Yang Qi.
Additionally, I have a place that is much better than your domain, and the cold there is much more extreme than yours, which is much more suitable for them."
Feng Bingying immediately denied him.
"I don’t believe you!
There is no place in this realm that is much colder than my domain!
At least, you can bring them here, and I will talk to them myself."
"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed.
"Little girl, you are too haughty!
You don’t know anything about him, so you shouldn’t look down on him or doubt his words."
Feng Bingying turned to Feng Yao.
"Who exactly are you?
Are you the fire phoenix from that realm?"
"I am the princess of the Phoenix Realm of the Three Mortal Realms." Feng Yao’s revelation took Feng Bingying aback for a moment.
"Summon them out and let her talk to them first."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the portal to the training room.
Soon, Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu emerged from it, and the Yang Qi within the bodies of the two ice phoenixes caused Feng Bingying to frown again.
"She is the Feng Bingying I told you two about all those years ago, and she wanted to take you guys to her domain in the Soaring-Dragon Divine Domain."
"I’m sorry, Ancestor.
I must refuse your request." Feng Jinqiu immediately rejected Feng Bingying.
Feng Xueying also rejected her.
"I know you have good intentions for us, but there is no place better than Zhang Fei’s for us.
Therefore, we will not go with you, and we will continue to stay at his place to improve ourselves."
"But—"
"You should give up and not force them to go with you." Feng Yao slightly released her aura, which caused Feng Bingying to shiver and unconsciously take a step back.
"We are both of the same phoenix race, but we come from different realms, even though you also came from there.
Furthermore, Zhang Fei is the current leader of my Phoenix Race, and we are his subordinates now."
Feng Bingying was shocked to hear that Zhang Fei was the current leader of the Phoenix Race.
"How is that possible?
How—"
"Didn’t you already know his true identity?" Feng Bingying nodded to Feng Yao.
"Do you still think he is unfit to lead my Phoenix Race?
Moreover, Feng Shizhu should have warned you not to disturb them, and she asked you to wait for him to bring them to your domain.
Therefore, you should have obeyed your ancestor’s orders; otherwise, you are not worthy to lead the ice phoenix race."
Feng Bingying took a deep breath.
"Who are you really?
You are not an ordinary fire phoenix, right?"
"Heh." Feng Yao snorted softly.
"My past name was Huo Yanling.
Does that name sound familiar to you?"
"What!?" Feng Bingying exclaimed in shock and pointed her index finger at Feng Yao, stammering.
"You...
Are you really Empress Huo Yanling?"
Feng Yao smirked in response.
"Is there a cultivator in this realm who dares to claim to be me?
If any of them dares to use my identity, I’ll burn them alive."
Feng Bingying shook her head vigorously.
"No!
No one would dare use your identity!
I never thought that you were the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling."
"My parents acknowledged Zhang Fei as their son-in-law, so you should know what you have to do, right?" Feng Yao asked with a sharp gaze.

chapters.title: Chapter 1108: Old Friends
paragraphs: Feng Bingying eventually gave up on bringing Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu with her. She immediately left them, but the phoenix princess asked her to join their group when they entered the Forbidden Land in three days, to which she agreed.
"Would you two like to go and check out that place?" Both phoenixes nodded to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately spoke to Feng Yao. "Help them register."
"Alright." Feng Yao contacted Yu Shan and asked him to register Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu as test participants. "Don’t you want to bring the others with you?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "I need to help all my women who haven’t reached the Five Celestial Realms, so I still need their help to supply me with their Yin Qi. My master and the others left the training space a long time ago, and they recently joined some sects in the Empyrean Main Domain, so I didn’t bring them here. Why did you deliberately reveal your past identity to some people?"

"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed. "My people have been inactive since my death, and I think it’s time for them to return to the surface. However, they won’t move without a leader, and they are always waiting for me to lead them again. I deliberately revealed my identity to several people, especially since I believed they would hear about my return."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Let’s go back to the inn; I still have many questions for you."

A while later, Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Yao were alone in the room, and he showed her the two map fragments of the Temple of Forgotten Flame. "Do you know anything about this map? At first, I guessed these two fragments were part of a map to the temple, but Yu Shan previously said that people from this sect had already explored the place before, which means my guess was wrong."

"The Temple of Forgotten Flame is Huo Ling’s home, and it has never been hidden." Feng Yao seriously examined the two map fragments. "We are familiar with the temple’s interior, and we’ve never found anything hidden inside. However, these map fragments couldn’t exist without a reason, and there might be something we missed. Where did you get these two?"

"I found one by accident, and Murong Mengying got the second in the Sun Tower. I’ve tried searching for the remaining four, but I haven’t managed to find any of them in the Three Mortal Realms, and I think they’re hidden in one of the domains in this realm." Feng Yao raised an eyebrow slightly before returning both items to Zhang Fei [5]. "Can you please help me find someone?"
"Tian Kongquan’s reincarnation, right?’

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Since you know everything that happened around me, you should already know that I encountered Tian Kongquan’s soul remnant. His words back then made me believe that he had long been reincarnated, so I wanted to look for him, mainly because of his past abilities."

"You’re wrong if you want to look for Tian Kongquan because of his past abilities, especially since he’s different from me. Even though he saw his future at the expense of his lifespan, he couldn’t bring his past abilities with him when he was reincarnated. He should have been reincarnated by now, but he wouldn’t be the same as the past him." Feng Yao immediately took out a communication device. "Even so, I will help you find his reincarnation, but I need the help of an old friend."
"An old friend?"

Feng Yao nodded at him and contacted the person she had mentioned before. "His abilities are almost similar to Tang Ying’s eye abilities, but his abilities are superior, and he can search for anyone wherever they are, even if they are in a distant domain."
"How long will it take for your friend to find his reincarnation?"

"I can’t say for sure because the population in this realm is much larger than the total population in the Three Mortal Realms, so we can only wait for him to contact me." Feng Yao looked out the window and informed him. "Your two old friends have just arrived, but they have already entered the Forbidden Land before, so they no longer need to undergo those tests. The Fairy King seems to have heard the news of your presence in this realm, and he sent several members of the fairy race here.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the map, where he found the names Tian Huangjin and Tianshi Shengjie. They didn’t come alone, but they led several people from both their races. He then activated his Nature Awareness ability to search for members of the fairy race, and he found ten of them. "Ten fairies, with the weakest among them being at the 1-Sun Celestial King Realm and the strongest at the 1-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm."
"Are you going to hide from them?"

"No." Zhang Fei [5] canceled his ability and closed the map. "I have decided not to act as I did in the past, and I will face those who deliberately come to find trouble with me. If they come with malicious intentions, I will fight them, and vice versa."

Feng Yao smiled to herself after hearing that, and she told Zhang Fei [5] the identities of the people who had just arrived at the Divine Samsara Sect, most of whom were those they should be wary of, especially since they would become their competitors in the Forbidden Land later.
*Knock... Knock...*
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed and immediately opened the door for their guests. "Long time no see, Huangjin and Shengjie."
Tian Huangjin and Tianshi Shengjie did not immediately respond to Zhang Fei [5]; instead, they exchanged confused glances, especially after they detected the change in his bone age and cultivation.
"Why are you two so shocked?" Zhang Fei’s question brought the two women back to their senses, and he led them in. "Is my change that surprising to you two?"
"Who wouldn’t be shocked by the change in your bone age?" Tianshi Shengjie asked back, shaking her head.

Tian Huangjin then asked. "How could you have aged so quickly? The last time we met, you were in your early twenties, but you’ve aged to your early forties now. Moreover, your cultivation skyrocketed from the Divine Expansion Realm to the Celestial Lord Realm in just five years."

"Only my family knows about my secret, so I won’t tell you anything, even though we are old friends." The two women’s lips twitched in response to Zhang Fei [5]’s answer, which made them even more curious about his change. "Why did you two lead so many people here?"
Tianshi Shengjie pulled Tian Huangjin to sit in front of him and Feng Yao. "Have you two heard about the strange events in the Forbidden Land?"
"Elder Yu Shan has already told me about it." Zhang Fei responded by nodding.

Tianshi Shengjie immediately continued. "Zhan Kuang and several others disappeared there, and they also detected the movement of several demon races there. Liang Huizhong contacted our leaders and asked them to send help, so our leaders sent the two of us here to investigate this matter."

"Why didn’t Long Wuzhao send someone else?" Tianshi Shengjie responded to Zhang Fei [5] with her forehead muscles bulging out, making him laugh. "Your Emperor has conveyed my request to you, huh? What is your answer to that?"
Tianshi Shengjie chose not to answer his question. "What about your Cursed Demon Heart?"
"Does your heart continue to influence you?" Tian Huangjin also asked.

Zhang Fei [5] touched his heart and released a bit of the baleful aura from it, shocking both women. "About four and a half years ago, I met a mysterious male fox, and I almost died in his hands. That event caused my Cursed Demon Heart to fully awaken, and I almost fell under its control. Fortunately, my grandmother came to my rescue, and she freed me from its control. I had eliminated the remaining soul of this heart’s old owner, and this heart has been in my complete control since then."
"Who is the mysterious male fox? Why does he want to kill you?" Both women asked with serious expressions.

Zhang Fei [5] chose not to reveal it to them. "He came to save Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing from me, but I was too arrogant to realize the difference in our strength. He attacked me after I attacked him first, and I was completely helpless in the fight with him, leaving me severely injured and almost dead. If not for the help of several of my wives, I might be dead now."
"Is she one of your wives?" Tian Huangjin asked, glancing at Feng Yao.
"She’s Feng Yao, and she helped Zhang Fei a lot when they lived in the Sky Jade Realm." Tianshi Shengjie then asked them. "How about we go together in three days?"
"Sure." Zhang Fei [5] immediately agreed.
After they discussed some matters, the three women left the room, and Zhang Fei [5] sat by the window, monitoring the constant arrival of people at the Divine Samsara Sect.

However, Zhang Fei [5] did not think much of them, and he was more looking forward to Qing Qiu’er coming to him, especially since he was still curious about her goal in giving the Forbidden Lotus Codex to him. He thought about meeting the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple, but he immediately decided against it. "Let’s wait for her."
