chapters.title: Chapter 1109: Visit The Alchemy Shop
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] decided to take a look at sector five, where the only alchemy shop was located. He found hundreds of types of herbs that were not yet available at the Sealed World Pearl there, but unfortunately, he couldn’t buy them without having the alchemy token.
Despite this, Zhang Fei [5] still entered the shop and checked the herbs one by one. As usual, Mei helps him by analyzing each herb, allowing him to duplicate them using his plant generation ability.
"Are you interested in buying them, young man?" An old man suddenly approached him.

Zhang Fei [5] skimmed the old man’s data that Mei had just displayed. ’His name is Luo Lianjin, and his cultivation has already reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, which means he is one of the strongest in the sect.’ "Senior, I’m interested in buying them, but Elder Yu Shan told me that I can’t buy them without the alchemy token, and I don’t have one because I’ve never taken the test before."

"If you’ve never taken the test before, then why don’t you take it now?" Luo Lianjin pointed to the back area. "If you want to take it, I’ll take you there, and I’ll personally assess your alchemy skills. Many rogue alchemists think that the alchemy token is not relevant, but it is important if you want to buy alchemy ingredients, especially the extremely rare ones."
"Extremely rare alchemy ingredients?"

"Yes." Luo Lianjin then led Zhang Fei [5] to one of the shelves containing several sealed boxes. The old man took one of them, unsealed the seal, and showed it to him. "This herb is rank 10 Xujiacao, and it is an important part in concocting the rank 10 Tyrant Body Pill."
"What are the benefits of the Pill, Senior?"
Luo Lianjin raised an eyebrow momentarily. "Do you really not know the effects of the Pill?"

"Senior, I ascended to this realm not long ago, and such a pill does not exist in the Three Mortal Realms." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer surprised Luo Lianjin. "Since I ascended to this realm, I haven’t traveled anywhere, and I’ve spent all my time in isolation."

Luo Lianjin nodded in understanding before explaining. "The Tyrant Body Pill is one of the best pills for a body cultivator, especially since it forcibly reshapes the user’s mortal body into a ’tyrant body’. If a body cultivator uses this pill, his or her raw strength will increase by 50%, making him or her capable of crushing mountain ranges. The user’s body strength will also increase by several levels, providing the opportunity to pass the lightning tribulation."

’Even though both of them are rank 10, the pill’s effect is inferior to the Unyielding Body Pill in the body cultivation shop. Unfortunately, I don’t have the ingredients to match it yet.’ Zhang Fei [5] then took out the list for concocting the pill and handed it to the old man. "Are these ingredients difficult to find, Senior?"

Luo Lianjin immediately read the list. "Among these five ingredients, the Snow Mammoth Tendon and the Nine Tribulations Spirit Dew are extremely rare herbs. I have only seen them once at the auction in the Forbidden Land, and each of them was sold at five hundred million golden jewels."
"Five... five hundred million golden jewels each!" Zhang Fei [5] stuttered in shock. ’Fuck! When will I be able to concoct the Pill if the price of two of the five ingredients is that expensive?’
Luo Lianjin nodded at him. "The buyer is the sect master of the War God Pavilion of the Heavenly Trial Domain, Dugu Yuanshen."
"War God Pavilion? The Heavenly Trial Domain?"

Luo Lianjin sighed helplessly because Zhang Fei [5] was still too ignorant about the Paradise Realm. "The War God Pavilion is a gathering place for fighter cultivators, and most of them are those who undertake two or more cultivation paths at once, such as the sword and body cultivation paths. If you want to hone your fighting abilities, the Heavenly Trial Domain is the best in this realm, where you will face various random trials. Additionally, the beasts there are much stronger than in the other domains, especially since that domain is one of the oldest in this realm."
"How do those beasts compare to the beasts in the Soaring-Dragon Divine Domain, Senior?"

"Oh? You already know about the Soaring-Dragon Divine Domain, eh?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Luo Lianjin. "All the beasts in that domain are the strongest in this realm, but you won’t be able to hunt them. If you act rashly and hunt them, the people of the beast races will kill you directly. Therefore, all humans avoid that domain, and most of them hunt beasts in the Heavenly Trial Domain instead."
Zhang Fei [5] then asked him another question. "What rank is the strongest beast in the Heavenly Trial Domain?"

"I once encountered a mythical-rank ape beast there, but I didn’t dare approach it because it was a giant beast with immense raw strength. According to rumors, there are several cultivators who have encountered several other mythical-rank beasts." Luo Lianjin then returned the box to its place. "So, do you want to take the test?"

Zhang Fei [5] sighed inwardly, especially since he would rather not show his alchemy abilities to the public. However, he had no other choice if he wanted to buy alchemy ingredients, and he eventually agreed. "I’ll take the test now, Senior. Can we just do one test? The pill-concocting test, naturally."

"You’re confident in your pill-concocting abilities, huh?" Luo Lianjin spoke with a raised eyebrow, to which Zhang Fei [5] responded with a smile. "If you are that confident in yourself, I will give you an exception. However, you must concoct at least five superior-grade pills in a single furnace within five hours; do you dare to accept this challenge?"
"Sure." Luo Lianjin carefully studied Zhang Fei’s expression before escorting him to another area.

Before long, they had arrived at an alchemy room, but Zhang Fei did not see a single alchemist there. Luo Lianjin then pointed to an abnormally sized alchemy furnace in the middle of the room. "Use that furnace to concoct the pills, and I’ll let you pass if you manage to complete my challenge."

"What if I use another method, Senior?" Luo Lianjin raised his eyebrows, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately activated his fire domain. "My alchemy master taught me to create this domain, and she forced me to concoct pills using it."

Luo Lianjin was completely shocked to hear that. "Did you know that concocting pills with such a method is very difficult? Let alone concocting pills, creating a domain is not easy, even for cultivators of this realm. You have just ascended from the Three Mortal Realms, but you already have a domain, and your flames are not ordinary flames either."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his nose. "Senior, I understand the difficulties you mentioned, but my alchemy master is very strict with me. At first, I failed hundreds of times, but I finally succeeded in concocting my pills. Since then, I have never used a furnace, and I always use my domain."
"Who is your alchemy master?"
"Her name is Feng Yao, but I’m sure you’ve never heard her name before."

"I’ve never heard her name before." Luo Lianjin then took out five types of herbs and handed them to him, which caused Zhang Fei [5] to frown slightly. "To become an expert alchemist, we can’t just rely on recipes that are already available. We must use our imagination and creativity to create new pills. You may never have seen these ingredients before, but I’ve already concocted a new type of pill using them. Although I can guarantee that they work well together, your abilities will determine the outcome."
"Did you give tests like this to other alchemists, senior?"

"I haven’t seen your alchemy abilities, but I can smell the scent of thousands of herbs from your body. Since you were confident in your abilities, I decided to give you the most difficult test." Luo Lianjin then walked to the side. "Five hours starting now."

[Haha! That old man underestimates you, Master. I’ve already checked these ingredients, and they are indeed compatible with each other. Moreover, you’ve been experimenting with many herbs for the past two decades, so this test is nothing more than a trivial matter to you.]

’That old man is also a God-Rank Alchemist like me and Lin Jingxia, and he also has no information about me, so it’s natural for him to underestimate my abilities.’ Zhang Fei [5] then started preparing the five ingredients at the same time.

Luo Lianjin, who watched from the side of the room, was quite surprised by Zhang Fei [5]’s actions. ’Who exactly is this kid? His understanding and familiarity with alchemy ingredients are equal to those of a senior alchemist like me! He’s clearly never seen those ingredients before, but he can immediately recognize their characteristics and prepare them correctly.’
Luo Lianjin remembered that Zhang Fei [5] had mentioned Yu Shan’s name before, so he immediately contacted the old man, asking for information about him.

Yu Shan shared some information about Zhang Fei [5] with Luo Lianjin, but the old man only provided him general information without mentioning Feng Yao and her parents. ’Hmm? He came to this domain with Luo Fenghan and his family, huh?’
After he finished preparing the herbs, Zhang Fei [5] started his alchemy, and Luo Lianjin watched him with complete seriousness on his face.

sentences.text: Zhang Fei [5] decided to take a look at sector five, where the only alchemy shop was located.
He found hundreds of types of herbs that were not yet available at the Sealed World Pearl there, but unfortunately, he couldn’t buy them without having the alchemy token.
Despite this, Zhang Fei [5] still entered the shop and checked the herbs one by one.
As usual, Mei helps him by analyzing each herb, allowing him to duplicate them using his plant generation ability.
"Are you interested in buying them, young man?" An old man suddenly approached him.

Zhang Fei [5] skimmed the old man’s data that Mei had just displayed. ’His name is Luo Lianjin, and his cultivation has already reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, which means he is one of the strongest in the sect.’ "Senior, I’m interested in buying them, but Elder Yu Shan told me that I can’t buy them without the alchemy token, and I don’t have one because I’ve never taken the test before."
"If you’ve never taken the test before, then why don’t you take it now?" Luo Lianjin pointed to the back area.
"If you want to take it, I’ll take you there, and I’ll personally assess your alchemy skills.
Many rogue alchemists think that the alchemy token is not relevant, but it is important if you want to buy alchemy ingredients, especially the extremely rare ones."
"Extremely rare alchemy ingredients?"
"Yes." Luo Lianjin then led Zhang Fei [5] to one of the shelves containing several sealed boxes.
The old man took one of them, unsealed the seal, and showed it to him.
"This herb is rank 10 Xujiacao, and it is an important part in concocting the rank 10 Tyrant Body Pill."
"What are the benefits of the Pill, Senior?"
Luo Lianjin raised an eyebrow momentarily.
"Do you really not know the effects of the Pill?"
"Senior, I ascended to this realm not long ago, and such a pill does not exist in the Three Mortal Realms." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer surprised Luo Lianjin.
"Since I ascended to this realm, I haven’t traveled anywhere, and I’ve spent all my time in isolation."
Luo Lianjin nodded in understanding before explaining.
"The Tyrant Body Pill is one of the best pills for a body cultivator, especially since it forcibly reshapes the user’s mortal body into a ’tyrant body’.
If a body cultivator uses this pill, his or her raw strength will increase by 50%, making him or her capable of crushing mountain ranges.
The user’s body strength will also increase by several levels, providing the opportunity to pass the lightning tribulation."
’Even though both of them are rank 10, the pill’s effect is inferior to the Unyielding Body Pill in the body cultivation shop.
Unfortunately, I don’t have the ingredients to match it yet.’ Zhang Fei [5] then took out the list for concocting the pill and handed it to the old man.
"Are these ingredients difficult to find, Senior?"
Luo Lianjin immediately read the list.
"Among these five ingredients, the Snow Mammoth Tendon and the Nine Tribulations Spirit Dew are extremely rare herbs.
I have only seen them once at the auction in the Forbidden Land, and each of them was sold at five hundred million golden jewels."
"Five... five hundred million golden jewels each!" Zhang Fei [5] stuttered in shock. ’Fuck!
When will I be able to concoct the Pill if the price of two of the five ingredients is that expensive?’
Luo Lianjin nodded at him.
"The buyer is the sect master of the War God Pavilion of the Heavenly Trial Domain, Dugu Yuanshen."
"War God Pavilion?
The Heavenly Trial Domain?"
Luo Lianjin sighed helplessly because Zhang Fei [5] was still too ignorant about the Paradise Realm.
"The War God Pavilion is a gathering place for fighter cultivators, and most of them are those who undertake two or more cultivation paths at once, such as the sword and body cultivation paths.
If you want to hone your fighting abilities, the Heavenly Trial Domain is the best in this realm, where you will face various random trials.
Additionally, the beasts there are much stronger than in the other domains, especially since that domain is one of the oldest in this realm."
"How do those beasts compare to the beasts in the Soaring-Dragon Divine Domain, Senior?"
"Oh?
You already know about the Soaring-Dragon Divine Domain, eh?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Luo Lianjin.
"All the beasts in that domain are the strongest in this realm, but you won’t be able to hunt them.
If you act rashly and hunt them, the people of the beast races will kill you directly.
Therefore, all humans avoid that domain, and most of them hunt beasts in the Heavenly Trial Domain instead."
Zhang Fei [5] then asked him another question.
"What rank is the strongest beast in the Heavenly Trial Domain?"
"I once encountered a mythical-rank ape beast there, but I didn’t dare approach it because it was a giant beast with immense raw strength.
According to rumors, there are several cultivators who have encountered several other mythical-rank beasts." Luo Lianjin then returned the box to its place.
"So, do you want to take the test?"
Zhang Fei [5] sighed inwardly, especially since he would rather not show his alchemy abilities to the public.
However, he had no other choice if he wanted to buy alchemy ingredients, and he eventually agreed.
"I’ll take the test now, Senior.
Can we just do one test?
The pill-concocting test, naturally."
"You’re confident in your pill-concocting abilities, huh?" Luo Lianjin spoke with a raised eyebrow, to which Zhang Fei [5] responded with a smile.
"If you are that confident in yourself, I will give you an exception.
However, you must concoct at least five superior-grade pills in a single furnace within five hours; do you dare to accept this challenge?"
"Sure." Luo Lianjin carefully studied Zhang Fei’s expression before escorting him to another area.
Before long, they had arrived at an alchemy room, but Zhang Fei did not see a single alchemist there.
Luo Lianjin then pointed to an abnormally sized alchemy furnace in the middle of the room.
"Use that furnace to concoct the pills, and I’ll let you pass if you manage to complete my challenge."
"What if I use another method, Senior?" Luo Lianjin raised his eyebrows, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately activated his fire domain.
"My alchemy master taught me to create this domain, and she forced me to concoct pills using it."
Luo Lianjin was completely shocked to hear that.
"Did you know that concocting pills with such a method is very difficult?
Let alone concocting pills, creating a domain is not easy, even for cultivators of this realm.
You have just ascended from the Three Mortal Realms, but you already have a domain, and your flames are not ordinary flames either."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his nose.
"Senior, I understand the difficulties you mentioned, but my alchemy master is very strict with me.
At first, I failed hundreds of times, but I finally succeeded in concocting my pills.
Since then, I have never used a furnace, and I always use my domain."
"Who is your alchemy master?"
"Her name is Feng Yao, but I’m sure you’ve never heard her name before."
"I’ve never heard her name before." Luo Lianjin then took out five types of herbs and handed them to him, which caused Zhang Fei [5] to frown slightly.
"To become an expert alchemist, we can’t just rely on recipes that are already available.
We must use our imagination and creativity to create new pills.
You may never have seen these ingredients before, but I’ve already concocted a new type of pill using them.
Although I can guarantee that they work well together, your abilities will determine the outcome."
"Did you give tests like this to other alchemists, senior?"
"I haven’t seen your alchemy abilities, but I can smell the scent of thousands of herbs from your body.
Since you were confident in your abilities, I decided to give you the most difficult test." Luo Lianjin then walked to the side.
"Five hours starting now."
[Haha!
That old man underestimates you, Master.
I’ve already checked these ingredients, and they are indeed compatible with each other.
Moreover, you’ve been experimenting with many herbs for the past two decades, so this test is nothing more than a trivial matter to you.]

’That old man is also a God-Rank Alchemist like me and Lin Jingxia, and he also has no information about me, so it’s natural for him to underestimate my abilities.’ Zhang Fei [5] then started preparing the five ingredients at the same time.
Luo Lianjin, who watched from the side of the room, was quite surprised by Zhang Fei [5]’s actions. ’Who exactly is this kid?
His understanding and familiarity with alchemy ingredients are equal to those of a senior alchemist like me!
He’s clearly never seen those ingredients before, but he can immediately recognize their characteristics and prepare them correctly.’
Luo Lianjin remembered that Zhang Fei [5] had mentioned Yu Shan’s name before, so he immediately contacted the old man, asking for information about him.
Yu Shan shared some information about Zhang Fei [5] with Luo Lianjin, but the old man only provided him general information without mentioning Feng Yao and her parents. ’Hmm?
He came to this domain with Luo Fenghan and his family, huh?’
After he finished preparing the herbs, Zhang Fei [5] started his alchemy, and Luo Lianjin watched him with complete seriousness on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 1110: Create A New Pill
paragraphs: Luo Lianjin nodded in satisfaction after Zhang Fei [5] extracted the essence of the five herbs, but he raised an eyebrow when he took out two other herbs. ’Phoenix Plume Herb and Crimson Feather Grass? What does he want to do with those two ingredients? Does he want to mix them with the other ingredients?’

When Luo Lianjin thought that, Zhang Fei [5] quickly extracted the essence of the Phoenix Plume Herb and the Crimson Feather Grass. ’So fast! He extracted their essence without even thinking for a second, as if he had done it too many times! Who exactly is Feng Yao? How did she teach this kid? Not only is his speed in processing the ingredients so fast, but his control over Qi is also surprising. His flames don’t waver in the slightest, even though he also has to maintain his fire domain. Even a senior alchemist like me would experience a slight waver in my flames if I prepared all of them at once while maintaining my domain.’

Zhang Fei [5] observed the essence of the seven herbs for a while before taking out another herb, which confused Luo Lianjin further. ’All these herbs are good, but the effect will be even more significant if I add the essence of the Heaven’s Cry Orchid herb to the mixture.’
Within seconds, Zhang Fei [5] had already extracted the essence of the herb. Thereafter, he combined the essence of all the herbs into one, and he used two different flames to mix them together.

On the side of the room, Luo Lianjin supported his chin with his hand, and his eyes were fully focused on those herb essences. ’Will he really succeed in concocting five superior-grade pills in one concoction? Let’s wait and see what kind of pill he will produce.’
Three hours later, Luo Lianjin’s nose twitched, smelling the scent of the pills that filled the room, indicating that Zhang Fei [5]’s pills were almost fully formed.
A while later, Zhang Fei [5] pulled his fire element back and canceled his fire domain. The five pills that floated before him caused Luo Lianjin to fall into a daze.
Even without looking closely, Luo Lianjin could already tell that the five pills were of superior grade and ranked at level 10, which meant Zhang Fei [5]’s alchemist rank was equivalent to his.

Luo Lianjin approached Zhang Fei [5], took one of the pills, and swallowed it directly. He closed his eyes, dissolved the pill with his qi, and spread it throughout his body. "What kind of Pill is this? It not only has a healing effect, but it also restores Qi."

"I don’t have a name for this pill yet." Zhang Fei [5] swallowed one pill to learn its exact effects. "Let’s just call it the Phoenix Restoration Pill, especially since I added the Phoenix Plume Herb to it."

"The five herbs I gave you earlier are indeed for concocting healing pills, and their effects are several levels higher than ordinary pills. The Phoenix Plume Herb and the Crimson Feather Grass further enhance the effects, and the restorative effect should come from the Heaven’s Cry Orchid herb." Luo Lianjin then opened his eyes and looked at Zhang Fei [5] in admiration. "I admire you, young man. You are still in your early forties, but you have already reached the god rank in alchemy. I don’t know how Feng Yao trained you, but she has already given birth to a monster in alchemy. Honestly, I want you to join this sect, and we can both help each other improve our abilities in alchemy. Regrettably, it’s impossible because you are an expert dual cultivator, especially with the many types of Yin Qi in your body."

’This old man isn’t bad.’ Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "Senior, I have been a dual cultivator since I first stepped onto the path of cultivation, and I will always be one for the rest of my life. As for alchemy, I learned it because I lacked strong backers and sufficient resources. Fortunately, I met my master, and she taught me a lot about alchemy, which gave me a great opportunity to improve myself."

"Alchemy will always play an important role in our cultivation, so your decision to become an alchemist in addition to a dual cultivator is the best." Luo Lianjin grabbed his arms. "Judging from your body stature, you are also a body cultivator, right? Although I am not a dual cultivator like you, I am an experienced man. Naturally, I understand that dual cultivation requires extraordinary physique and stamina, and you can only get both through the body cultivation path."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "I’m a body cultivator, but my body cultivation level is not as high as my alchemy."
"What’s your name? This old man is Luo Lianjin."
"Zhang Fei."
"Hmm?" Luo Lianjin raised his eyebrows. "Do you—"
"No." Zhang Fei [5] immediately denied. "Senior Luo, I already told you that I only recently ascended to this realm, so I have nothing to do with the Zhang Clan of the Starfall Martial Domain."
Luo Lianjin nodded in understanding. "Wait here for a while, and I will make your alchemy token first."
"Thank you, Senior."

Not long after Luo Lianjin went to the back room to make his alchemy token, Zhang Fei [5] saw another old man bringing a young man and a young woman into the room. "Who are you, young man? What are you doing here?"
The young man and the young woman also looked at Zhang Fei [5], but their gazes were filled with disdain, mainly because of his cultivation.

Zhang Fei [5] glanced briefly at the two of them while he read their data on the blue screen. ’Jiao Meili and Jiao Moli, huh? Their cultivation is at the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm.’ "Senior, I just finished my alchemy test, and Senior Lianjin is making my alchemy token in the back."
"Oh?" The old man was momentarily surprised before sniffing his scent. "How many types of herbs have you used before?"
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in response. "I’ve never counted their types, but I think there should be thousands of different types of herbs."

"You are truly a rare young man." The old man spoke, nodding his head. "I can smell at least two thousand types of herbs from your body, but I’m sure it’s more than that. Since my senior is making your alchemy token, you can wait here and watch these two alchemists from the Jiao Clan undergo their tests."
"Yes, Senior." Zhang Fei [5] walked to the side of the room, ignoring Jiao Meili and Jiao Moli’s sharp gazes.

The old man immediately gave Jiao Meili and Jiao Moli some pointers, especially regarding the tests. Unlike Zhang Fei [5], the old man gave them five different tests, which made both of them visibly annoyed.

Zhang Fei [5] leaned against the wall, crossed his arms in front of his chest, and watched the two alchemists. ’Their Jiao Clan should be one of the renowned clans in this realm, and their elders pamper them too much; otherwise, they wouldn’t look down on me like that.’

Sometime later, Luo Lianjin had returned to Zhang Fei [5] and handed him the alchemy token, which didn’t escape the attention of the old man, who was supervising Jiao Meili and Jiao Moli in their test. ’What the fuck? That kid is a god-rank alchemist? How could he have reached that stage in just forty years?’
"Thank you, Senior." Zhang Fei [5] immediately stored the token. "Since everything is finished, I will go to other sectors to have a look, Senior."
Luo Lianjin nodded at him. "Young man, I hope you are willing to come to the sect more often, and we will have a deeper discussion about alchemy."
"Absolutely! I will often come to you to discuss alchemy, Senior." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer satisfied Luo Lianjin.
After Zhang Fei [5] left, the old man approached Luo Lianjin. "Senior Luo, how is it possible for such a young man to have already reached god rank?"

Naturally, Jiao Moli and Jiao Meili could hear the old man’s question, which shocked them and disrupted their concentration. Both of them screamed in their minds. ’What the hell? Was the young man just now really a god-rank alchemist?’

"Haha." Luo Lianjin laughed and patted his shoulder. "Xuan Yun, one’s alchemy rank has nothing to do with age, but one’s talent plays a more important role in it. Even our master managed to reach the god-rank in just thirty years, remember? I asked that young man to concoct a pill using random ingredients, and I didn’t give him the recipe to concoct it, but he managed to concoct five superior-grade and rank 10 Phoenix Restoration Pills in one furnace."
"Phoenix Restoration Pill?"

Luo Lianjin nodded. "Of course, you’ve never heard the name of that pill before, especially since that young man created it on the spot. Thus, you should already understand his high talent in alchemy, right?"
"Why don’t you recruit him into our sect, Senior?"

Luo Lianjin shook his head. "Even though his talent in alchemy is extraordinary, he is primarily a dual cultivator, so this sect isn’t suitable for him. If my guess is correct, he will go to the Twin Flames Main Domain soon, but I don’t know which dual cultivation sect he will choose. You should monitor these two young alchemists, and I will return to my private quarters now."
"Yes, Senior."

chapters.title: Chapter 1111: Lotus Limbo World
paragraphs: After leaving the alchemy shop, Zhang Fei [5] went to the other two sectors to check out the blacksmith and array shops. The blacksmith shop had many new forging materials, but their prices were extremely high. In the array shop, he also found many items not listed in Duanmu Luolan’s description, especially since they were unavailable in the Three Mortal Realms.

Unfortunately, Zhang Fei didn’t have that many jewels, and he had to go through several tests to be able to purchase them. In the end, he decided to return to the inn, as he would rather not waste his time on those tests. Moreover, he had already shown his alchemy abilities to Luo Lianjin, so he would rather not attract more attention by showing off his abilities in blacksmithing and arrays.
Shortly after Zhang Fei [5] arrived in his room, a pink smoke entered the room, and it was immediately transformed into a woman who was none other than Qing Qiu’er.
"I had expected you to come straight to me, Senior Qing Qiu’er." Zhang Fei [5] calmly spoke.

Qing Qiu’er put on a seductive smile as she gracefully walked in front of him. "I don’t understand what happened to you, but I remember for sure that you were still in your early twenties when my avatar found you in the Star Tower, and your cultivation had just broken through to the Earth Realm at that time. However, you were already in your early forties, and your cultivation had already reached the Celestial Lord Realm."
"There are many things you don’t know about me after that day." Zhang Fei [5] then asked her. "What exactly is your purpose in giving the Lotus Forbidden Codex to me?"

"Hehe." Qing Qiu’er giggled, sat on his lap, and embraced his neck. I found a few things about you intriguing, so I intentionally used my lotus miasma to test your reaction. However, you were not affected by its effects, and only the two women with you were affected by it. Usually, men would pounce on me as soon as they saw my appearance, but you didn’t show the slightest reaction; not even your dick was erect."
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at her. "I’m different from those men, and I have more than a hundred women by my side. You are beautiful, stunning, and sexy, but everything about you can’t match them."
"Ouch!" Qing Qiu’er pressed one hand against her chest and wore a pitiful look. "Your words hurt my heart, little boy. Am I really that unattractive in your eyes?"

"Alright, stop playing around and answer my question." Qing Qiu’er immediately got off Zhang Fei [5]’s lap, pressed her palm against his chest, and forced his soul out of his body. He was not surprised by her actions, as he knew there was such a technique within the Forbidden Lotus Codex. "What are you going to do now?"
"Hmm?" Qing Qiu’er pointed her index finger at his soul and counted the number of white lotuses inside. "More than a hundred lotuses, eh? Why don’t you merge them into one?"
"Eh?" Zhang Fei [5] looked at her in surprise. "Can such a thing be done?"
Qing Qiu’er nodded at him before releasing her soul, and it immediately touched his soul. "Let me help you with that."

"These feelings." Zhang Fei [5] clenched both his hands into fists as he sensed a significant change in not only his soul but also his Qi flow.
Qing Qiu’er withdrew her soul power from Zhang Fei [5]’s soul before asking him. "How do you feel now? Merging them into one is much more beneficial, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Honestly, I never thought of such a method before, and the result is much better than letting all those lotuses fill my soul. Although my soul level has not changed, my soul power has become stronger after they merged together."

"How did you make your black lotus that big?"

"Turning other people’s souls into lotus?" Zhang Fei [5] frowned at that.

Qing Qiu’er nodded at Zhang Fei [5] before taking out a gourd and pulling out a man’s soul from it, which caused Zhang Fei to frown. She then showed him how to transform the soul into a black lotus, and she merged it with her black lotus afterwards. "This method is truly evil, and those righteous cultivators will hunt us down if they find out about this. However, I never sacrifice innocent people to strengthen my lotus, and the soul just now is the soul of one of my enemies."

"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Just like you, I repeatedly sacrificed the souls of my enemies to strengthen mine, but I used a different method than yours, and I merged their souls with mine directly."
Qing Qiu’er fell into a daze with her eyes blinking repeatedly. "How do you merge other people’s souls into your own directly?"

"Do you want to see it?" Qing Qiu’er thought for a moment before nodding to Zhang Fei [5], who then stood in front of her and touched her chest, causing her lips to curl upwards. However, her eyes widened in shock as soon as he replicated her soul. "This is the first method, and it won’t harm the soul’s owner. The second method is to absorb their soul directly, which will torture them until death."
"Where did you get this technique?" Qing Qiu’er asked him as she looked at her soul replica, which was completely similar to her original soul.

Zhang Fei [5] smiled faintly and merged Qing Qiu’er’s replica with his without explaining anything to her, causing her to raise an eyebrow. "Haven’t you been watching me since I arrived at the Star Tower? Thus, you should already know my other identity, right?"

"You were mistaken about that. My avatar never left that underground bedroom, so I only found out about you after you and those two women entered there." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding before turning his head into his demon head for a brief moment, shocking Qing Qiu’er. "Are you really a demon? Why can’t I detect any demon aura from you?"

"I am a human in this form, and I am a demon in my demon form." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer confused Qing Qiu’er. "I can’t explain the details to you, but I have two identities, both of which are real. Moreover, my demon identity is a transcendent lust demon, so the pink miasma you used at that time didn’t affect me. By the way, I remember you injected something into my body back then, but I never managed to trace it despite trying repeatedly."

Qing Qiu’er touched Zhang Fei [5]’s chest before extracting a tiny black lotus from his body, which shocked him. "You couldn’t detect it because it was only a tiny fragment of my black lotus, and I left it in your body to track you. I noticed your arrival in this realm about five years and two months ago, but I couldn’t go looking for you for several reasons, and I chose to wait for you to come to me. However, I didn’t expect that You Feiling would find you in this domain, so I rushed here after she informed me."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Back to my first question, what is your purpose in giving me the Forbidden Lotus Codex?"

"Try reading the last technique in the codex." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow at Qing Qiu’er. "You couldn’t read it back then because your soul level was too low, but you should be able to read it now."
Mei displayed all the techniques in the Forbidden Lotus Codex to Zhang Fei [5]. "The Lotus Limbo World, where yin and yang intertwine beneath lotus petals, and two souls unite and awaken as one."

"Yes." Qing Qiu’er nodded at him. "To open the Lotus Limbo World requires two cultivators with equal soul power, and both must have the two lotuses, which symbolize Yin and Yang. However, both must also have unwavering hearts and absolute trust toward each other; otherwise, they will not be able to open the door, let alone enter it."

chapters.title: Chapter 1112: Ashen Lotus Monastery Ruins
paragraphs: "So, what’s the catch?" Qing Qiu’er looked at Zhang Fei [5] in confusion. "I don’t know where you got the Forbidden Lotus Codex, and I’ve already benefited greatly from some of the sub-techniques within it. However, some of the effects are too good to be true, and the creator wouldn’t have put the ’forbidden’ word on it for no reason. I may not be as experienced as you in the world of cultivation, but I’m not stupid, and no technique is perfect. Since the creator put such a word on it, I’m sure it has hidden drawbacks or negative aspects, and you may not be aware of them yet."

Qing Qiu’er nodded in agreement with him. "In the past, I accidentally entered a portal that led me to a place called the Ashen Lotus Monastery Ruins, and I found a giant lotus there. Unlike our white and black lotuses, that lotus was half white and half black, just like a yin-yang. The lotus sucked me into it as I got close, and I was unconscious for several days. When I woke up, the lotus had disappeared, and the Forbidden Lotus Codex had been imprinted in my mind."
"Did you find any other clues there? Do you remember the location of the portal?" Zhang Fei [5] questioned her.

"That place is very small, and it’s completely empty." Qing Qiu’er’s answer made Zhang Fei [5] raise an eyebrow, as he couldn’t believe that there wasn’t any clue there. "As for the location of the portal, I found it in the Empyrean Main Domain, and your acquaintances from the Lotus Immortal Sanctuary should know something about it."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised to hear that. "If you put it that way, how come my parents-in-law know nothing about the Forbidden Lotus Codex?"

"Huh?" This time, Qing Qiu’er was surprised by his statement. "Are you really the son-in-law of Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi? As far as I remember, they don’t have a daughter, so how could you be their son-in-law?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded and explained it to her. "They have a daughter, but they never show her to the public. In fact, their daughter is my childhood friend, as she was born in the Three Immortal Realms."

"I see." Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding as she remembered something. "If I recall correctly, Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi disappeared for several hundred years in the past, but I don’t know the exact reason. If your story is true, their daughter should have been born around that time."
"That’s right." Zhang Fei [5] immediately asked Luo Yunxiao and the other two women to meet him.

Soon, Luo Yunxiao, Yan Jinwu, and Sima Huiqing arrived at the room. They were a little surprised by Qing Qiu’er’s presence there, but they also felt something familiar from her, which came from the black lotuses in their souls.
"Is she the one, husband?" Luo Yunxiao asked, walking behind Zhang Fei [5] with the other two.
"She is indeed Qing Qiu’er, the one who gave me the Forbidden Lotus Codex." Zhang Fei [5] then asked her. "Yunxiao, do you know anything about the Ashen Lotus Monastery Ruins?"
Qing Qiu’er looked at Luo Yunxiao in surprise. "Is she the daughter of Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi?"
"I am." Luo Yunxiao then asked. "Is there a connection between the Ashen Lotus Monastery Ruins and the Forbidden Lotus Codex?"
"She found the Forbidden Lotus Codex in that place."

Luo Yunxiao looked at Qing Qiu’er, who confirmed it with a nod. "The Ashen Lotus Monastery Ruins was once our sacred ground in the past, and my ancestors obtained the Lotus Heart Sutra, which became our main technique there. However, a great natural disaster in the past destroyed the place, causing the portal to disappear on its own. Since then, my ancestors have tried to find that place again, but they never succeeded, so they forgot about it. How did you find that place, Senior Qiu’er? Where is the portal located?"

"I don’t know the exact location of the portal." Qing Qiu’er immediately explained to them. "Back then, I entered that place by accident, and the portal disappeared as soon as I exited. Just like your ancestors, I’ve been trying to find the portal for decades, but I’ve never managed to find it again. Did your ancestors ever mention a giant Yin-Yang Lotus there? I got the Forbidden Lotus Codex from it, and your husband thinks there might be hidden flaws or negative aspects within it."

"I’m sure I’ve never heard of the giant Yin-Yang Lotus, but my father might know something about it. Shall I call him over?" After Zhang Fei [5] and Qing Qiu’er agreed, Luo Yunxiao immediately contacted Luo Fenghan, asking her to meet them. "He’ll be here soon."
Qing Qiu’er then observed Yan Jinwu. "What kind of beast are you?"
"Hehe." Yan Jinwu chuckled and a silhouette of a golden crow appeared behind her. "You can recognize my identity, right, senior?"
"You are such a lucky man! You even got a golden crow as your woman." Zhang Fei [5] simply smiled at Qing Qiu’er. "Do you have other female mythical beasts by your side?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "A fire phoenix, two vermilion birds, three golden foxes, and several others."
"What a lucky man!" Qing Qiu’er exclaimed while rubbing her forehead, but the bedroom door suddenly opened. She turned to Luo Fenghan, who had just arrived. "Long time no see, Fenghan."
Luo Fenghan was momentarily stunned when he saw Qing Qiu’er, but his reaction made Zhang Fei [5] and Luo Yunxiao realize the reason behind Huang Xiaoyi’s dislike of the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Luo Fenghan shook his head slightly before replying to her. "I didn’t expect you to actually come here to see my son-in-law, Qiu’er."

"I’ve been waiting for him to ascend to this realm for a long time, but I didn’t expect that he would ascend this quickly, let alone that he is your son-in-law." Qing Qiu’er then asked him. "Did your ancestors ever mention the giant Yin-Yang Lotus in the Ashen Lotus Monastery Ruins?"
Luo Fenghan was taken back for a moment. "Why are you suddenly asking about that place?"

"Father-in-law, she obtained the technique she gave me back then from the giant Yin-Yang lotus at that place." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer shocked Luo Fenghan. "We were just discussing that technique earlier, and I felt that there was something hidden within it; otherwise, the creator wouldn’t have used the ’forbidden’ word in front of the technique’s name. Since that place was once the sacred ground of your sect, we wanted to know if your ancestors ever mentioned the lotus."

Luo Fenghan didn’t expect the Lotus Forbidden Codex to have any connection to their former sacred ground. "Unfortunately, my ancestors never mentioned anything about the lotus, and the only technique they obtained there was our Lotus Heart Sutra, so I can’t help you with that. But how did you get into that place, Qiu’er? Do you know how to get back in there?"

"The portal disappeared by itself, and it never appeared again, no matter how hard I looked for it." Qing Qiu’er then asked. "Did your ancestors leave any descriptions of the areas of that place? When I was stranded in that place, I couldn’t find any room apart from the location of the lotus."

Luo Fenghan immediately took out a device and activated it, creating a small screen. Shortly after, several images appeared on the screen. "As you guys can see for yourselves, the Ashen Lotus Monastery Ruins is akin to a domain within a domain. Therefore, I find it strange that you couldn’t find another room, especially since it is truly vast and has so many different areas. Unfortunately, they didn’t leave behind details about those areas, and they only left this much information. However, they say that the place is filled with tranquility and peace, and our Lotus Heart Sutra is proof of that, so I think there should be nothing wrong with your Forbidden Lotus Codex."
"Did you hear that?" Qing Qiu’er asked Zhang Fei [5].

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Even so, I have a feeling there’s something else within that technique, especially the Lotus Limbo World. Therefore, I’m thinking of searching that place and confirming everything, but I’ll do that after we leave the Forgotten Land."

"How about you try using the last sub-technique with her?" Qing Qiu’er asked, pointing at Luo Yunxiao. "Your soul strengths are almost equal, and you two already have such a strong bond as husband and wife, so I’m sure you two can open that place and check it directly."

"No." Zhang Fei [5] refused with a shake of his head. "I would never take the risk of bringing my wife into a place with unknown origins, and I would prefer to find the ruins first before bringing anyone there."
Qing Qiu’er looked at Luo Yunxiao, who shook her head, leaving her helpless. "Have you ever used the other sub-techniques with them?

"Not yet." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in response. "For the past twenty years, we’ve focused on our cultivation and soul, and I haven’t tried the other sub-techniques with any of them. However, I’ve used the Lotus Soul Pact with my two sword spirits, so I can use the Soul Lotus Spirit Summon to summon them from my sword."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned the demon extermination sword. Soon, Jian Hei’an and Jian Guang’an appeared in front of them, shocking Qing Qiu’er. "Twin sword spirits."

Since that place was once the sacred ground of your sect, we wanted to know if your ancestors ever mentioned the lotus."
Luo Fenghan didn’t expect the Lotus Forbidden Codex to have any connection to their former sacred ground.
"Unfortunately, my ancestors never mentioned anything about the lotus, and the only technique they obtained there was our Lotus Heart Sutra, so I can’t help you with that.
But how did you get into that place, Qiu’er?
Do you know how to get back in there?"
"The portal disappeared by itself, and it never appeared again, no matter how hard I looked for it." Qing Qiu’er then asked.
"Did your ancestors leave any descriptions of the areas of that place?
When I was stranded in that place, I couldn’t find any room apart from the location of the lotus."
Luo Fenghan immediately took out a device and activated it, creating a small screen.
Shortly after, several images appeared on the screen.
"As you guys can see for yourselves, the Ashen Lotus Monastery Ruins is akin to a domain within a domain.
Therefore, I find it strange that you couldn’t find another room, especially since it is truly vast and has so many different areas.
Unfortunately, they didn’t leave behind details about those areas, and they only left this much information.
However, they say that the place is filled with tranquility and peace, and our Lotus Heart Sutra is proof of that, so I think there should be nothing wrong with your Forbidden Lotus Codex."
"Did you hear that?" Qing Qiu’er asked Zhang Fei [5].
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"Even so, I have a feeling there’s something else within that technique, especially the Lotus Limbo World.
Therefore, I’m thinking of searching that place and confirming everything, but I’ll do that after we leave the Forgotten Land."
"How about you try using the last sub-technique with her?" Qing Qiu’er asked, pointing at Luo Yunxiao.
"Your soul strengths are almost equal, and you two already have such a strong bond as husband and wife, so I’m sure you two can open that place and check it directly."
"No." Zhang Fei [5] refused with a shake of his head.
"I would never take the risk of bringing my wife into a place with unknown origins, and I would prefer to find the ruins first before bringing anyone there."
Qing Qiu’er looked at Luo Yunxiao, who shook her head, leaving her helpless.
"Have you ever used the other sub-techniques with them?
"Not yet." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in response.
"For the past twenty years, we’ve focused on our cultivation and soul, and I haven’t tried the other sub-techniques with any of them.
However, I’ve used the Lotus Soul Pact with my two sword spirits, so I can use the Soul Lotus Spirit Summon to summon them from my sword."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned the demon extermination sword.
Soon, Jian Hei’an and Jian Guang’an appeared in front of them, shocking Qing Qiu’er.
"Twin sword spirits."

chapters.title: Chapter 1113: True Yin-Yang Lotus
paragraphs: "You guys can talk, and I’ll take care of your preparations." Luo Fenghan hurriedly left the room.

Zhang Fei [5] then introduced the two sword spirits to Qing Qiu’er. "The black one is Jian Hei’an, and the white one is Jian Guang’an. Both of them are twin daughters, and their family was killed by Xereth. Before their father died, he forged this sword and used their souls as its spirits."

"I see." Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding. "Twin sword spirits will usually be detrimental to the sword, especially since its power will be halved. However, these two girls seem different, and the bond between them is profound. Moreover, you used the Lotus Soul Pact with them and tied their souls with yours, so I think it’s not a problem."

"They have assisted me all these years, and their strength has grown significantly in the past twenty years." Zhang Fei [5] then sent the two sword spirits back into the sword and stored it in his body again. "Why did you choose me? Back then, I was still too weak, and you didn’t know anything about me, but you decided to give the codex to me."

Qing Qiu’er smiled in response and pressed her index finger to his chest. "Are you still unaware of my purpose? The Lotus Limbo World, where yin and yang intertwine beneath lotus petals. Two souls unite and awaken as one, remember? It’s true that you were still weak back then, and I didn’t know much about you either. However, I was an expert soul cultivator, and I could sense that you were different from other men. Therefore, I chose you and gave you that technique, and I wanted to enter that place with you."

"After decades of being a cultivator, I’ve seen so much, so I won’t believe that your goal is that simple." Qing Qiu’er didn’t say anything in response to Zhang Fei [5]. "Moreover, we need unwavering hearts and absolute trust toward each other to enter that place, right? We just met today, and we don’t have either of those things between us, so we wouldn’t be able to do it even if we wanted to."

"That’s true." Qing Qiu’er gave a nod of agreement. "By the way, you don’t seem to know the correct way to utilize the black and white lotuses within our souls, so I’ll show you the proper method to do it. However, we can’t do it here because it will attract a lot of attention, so we have to do it somewhere completely secluded, and we’ll be bringing your three wives with us."
Zhang Fei [5] unhesitatingly enveloped the four women with his aura and then led them out of his room before departing from the Divine Samsara Sect.

Sometime later, they had arrived in a forest that was quite far from the sect or other cities, leaving Qing Qiu’er staring at Zhang Fei [5] in a daze. "What is the proper way to use the black and white lotuses within our souls?"

"Sit down first and release your souls, and I will guide you guys to do it." Zhang Fei [5] and the three women immediately followed Qing Qiu’er’s directions. "First, release the lotuses from your souls. Second, bring them closer to each other. Third, merge them into one and form the true Yin-Yang lotus."
"The True Yin-Yang Lotus?" They looked at Qing Qiu’er in confusion.

Qing Qiu’er nodded at them. "The basis of the Forbidden Lotus Codex is Yin and Yang, remember? The white and black lotuses are fragments of the true Yin-Yang Lotus, and to make them more effective is to merge them into one, like the one I discovered in that place. I find it difficult to explain the effect, so I suggest that you all try it yourselves; then, you will understand its extraordinary benefits."
"How do we get our lotuses out of our souls?" Luo Yunxiao asked in confusion.
Qing Qiu’er sat in front of them and demonstrated by releasing the black lotus from her soul. "Use your mind and soul to move the lotus out."
"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] and the three women immediately attempted to move the lotus, and they found it easy to do so. Four black lotuses and one pure, big, white lotus float in front of them.
"Eh? Why do you only have one lotus left, husband?" Luo Yunxiao asked.
Yan Jinwu also spoke to him. "Moreover, the size of your lotus has become much bigger than ours."
"Not only has the lotus become bigger, but I can feel the purity from it." Sima Huiqing looked at the white lotus.
Zhang Fei [5] pointed at Qing Qiu’er. "She merged all my white lotuses into one, and it became much stronger and purer. So, what should we do now?"

"Don’t do it all at once the first time." Qing Qiu’er grabbed Zhang Fei [5]’s hands and pushed her black lotus onto his white lotus. "Let’s try merging your lotus with mine first, but you have to accept my presence, or your lotus will reject mine. Once we succeed, you can merge it with theirs."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded and pushed his white lotus to Qing Qiu’er’s black lotus, but both of them were like magnets repelling each other.
"Don’t rush and accept my presence first."

Zhang Fei immediately calmed his mind and set aside his suspicions toward Qing Qiu’er. After he succeeded in doing so, his white lotus no longer rejected her black lotus, and the two slowly merged into one.

In a few minutes, the two lotuses had merged into one large black and white lotus. A huge Yin-Yang diagram immediately appeared above them, followed by the appearance of a white aura that enveloped Zhang Fei [5]’s body and a black aura that enveloped Qing Qiu’er’s body.

"These feelings." Zhang Fei [5] muttered under his breath, trying to understand the peculiar sensation that surfaced in his heart, linked to Qing Qiu’er’s presence. "Even though Yin and Yang are different, like day and night, they are fundamentally one, especially since both are the foundations of all things, including our cultivation."

Qing Qiu’er nodded at him. "Yang cannot exist alone without Yin, and vice versa. Yin and Yang must be balanced so that everything runs in order. If one dominates the other, it will shake and ultimately destroy the balance. When we achieve balance in both, we will be able to absorb Yin and Yang from various sources to accelerate our self-improvement. Now try to merge your white lotus with their three black lotuses, and we will begin our true dual-soul cultivation."
"Yes."
With the bond that had developed between them over the past two decades, Zhang Fei [5] and the three women had no difficulty in merging their lotuses together.

The Yin-Yang diagram above them became brighter and wider, with a white aura covering Zhang Fei [5]’s body and four black auras covering the bodies of the four women. They arranged positions with him in the middle and the four women surrounding him, and they immediately closed their eyes, channeling their Qi and soul power.

Zhang Fei [5]’s soul became like a bridge, allowing their soul power and Qi to continuously circulate between their five souls. Inside the pavilion, Zhang Fei, his other four clones, and their respective wives also did the same.

Since Zhang Fei and his five clones share a single soul, Qing Qiu’er could sense the flow of Qi and soul power from the many women within Zhang Fei [5]’s soul. She said nothing and focused on cultivating their souls, but a faint smile appeared on her alluring face.

In one of the rooms in the luxurious inn, Jiao Moli and Jiao Meili were sitting in front of an old man and an old woman. They told them about what they had heard in the alchemy shop, especially about Zhang Fei’s status as a god-rank alchemist.
"Are you two sure you heard correctly? How could a young man in his early forties possibly reach god rank?" the old woman asked doubtfully.
Jiao Meili answered her. "Elder Suyin, we heard the conversation between Senior Luo Lianjin and Senior Xuan Yun ourselves, so we wouldn’t be mistaken about it."

"Elders, that kid is truly a god-rank alchemist." Jiao Huanfeng and Jiao Suyin were still doubtful about Jiao Moli and Jiao Meili’s explanation. "Senior Luo Lianjin gave that kid a test to concoct pills using random ingredients, and he managed to achieve it after concocting five superior-grade Phoenix Restoration Pills in one furnace. We don’t know his name, but we think we’ll meet him at the entrance test tomorrow morning."
"What do you think about that kid, Huafeng?"

Jiao Huafeng shook his head. "I can’t say anything until I meet that kid, and since they don’t know anything about his identity, we’ll have to wait until tomorrow. Thereafter, I’ll inform our patriarch about him, and he’ll send others to investigate his background."
"Yeah." Jiao Suyin then stood up. "I will meet Luo Lianjin, and I hope he is willing to share information about that kid with me."
After Jiao Suyin left, Jiao Moli and Jiao Meili immediately left the room, leaving Jiao Huafeng behind.

"Who exactly is that kid? Who is his master?" Jiao Huafeng then took out a communication device to contact someone, and he informed that person about Zhang Fei [5]. A while later, he received an answer that made his expression turn strangely happy. "Hahaha! I will gain a lot if that person succeeds in capturing that kid."

chapters.title: Chapter 1114: The Truth Of Limbo World
paragraphs: [Daily quest I: Absorb 10,000,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1000 purple jewels.]
[Daily Quest II: Absorb 10,000,000 demon essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade demon cores.]
[Daily Quest III: Absorb 10,000,000 beast essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade beast cores.]
[Daily Quest IV: Killing 1000 beasts/demon beasts in the Celestial Lord or above.]
[Reward: Celestial daily pack x1]

When the four notifications appeared, Zhang Fei [5] immediately asked Qing Qiu’er and the other three women to stop. In that instant, the Yin-Yang diagram disappeared, and the Yin-Yang Lotus split into five more lotuses before returning to their respective souls.
After they returned their souls into their bodies, Zhang Fei [5] immediately spoke. "Incredible! We dual-soul cultivated for a few hours, but the results are like a few days of doing it."
"Hehe." Qing Qiu’er chuckled. "If you did it with them a long time ago, your soul level might have already surpassed the divine stage."
Zhang Fei [5] looked at her. "Who are the cultivators in this realm who have reached the Immortal Soul Level?"

"No one." All of them turned to Feng Yao, who suddenly appeared. "Do you think people won’t notice your actions even if you do them in a remote place like this? I previously detected your movements, so I came here and covered your aura from a distance."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed awkwardly. "Thank you, wife."

"Hey! My parents already consider you their son-in-law, but I’m not your wife yet." Zhang Fei [5]’s lips curled upwards, but Feng Yao ignored him and spoke to Qing Qiu’er. "You should give up on your plans to go to the Lotus Limbo World, especially since that place is different from what you think."
Qing Qiu’er raised an eyebrow. "Who exactly are you? How did you know about the Lotus Limbo World?"

"My past name was Huo Yanling." Qing Qiu’er’s eyes widened in shock as soon as Feng Yao said that name. "No one dares to claim to be one, so you don’t need to doubt my identity. The Forbidden Lotus Codex is indeed useful for cultivating your soul, but the Lotus Limbo World is a different case. The world is neither the world of the living nor the world of the dead, and the source of everything is stored there."
"The Yin and Yang, right?"

"You’re not wrong about that." Feng Yao replied with a nod. "The Lotus Limbo World was created by one of the hidden forces in this universe as a prison, and the force created it to imprison the souls of cultivators who tried to defy the Wheel of Reincarnation."
Qing Qiu’er seemed confused by that. "What do you mean by one of the hidden forces in this universe? What kind of force created the Lotus Limbo World?"

"I can’t explain anything to you about those hidden forces, and you have to find them yourself to know the truth." Feng Yao briefly glanced at Zhang Fei [5] before continuing. "One of those hidden powers is the Will of the universe; it didn’t create the Lotus Limbo World but another one. I can’t tell you guys about that, especially since it would immediately attack me if I mentioned it."

Unlike Qing Qiu’er, Zhang Fei [5], who had already encountered the Will of the Universe, immediately realized something. "You can’t tell us about that force, but you can tell us the truth about the Lotus Limbo World, right?"

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at him. "As I mentioned earlier, the Lotus Limbo World serves as a prison for the souls of cultivators who tried to defy the Wheel of Reincarnation. They thought that by doing so, they could achieve immortality, but true immortality never existed. All living beings can live extremely long lives by cultivating and reaching the highest possible level, which grants them an extremely long lifespan. Even so, their lifespans will still be exhausted, and they will die in the end."
"A true immortality never existed." Qing Qiu’er and the three women muttered to themselves as they looked at Feng Yao in shock.

Feng Yao continued straight away. "The Lotus Limbo World is a stagnant pocket dimension, where the Yin-Yang Lotus controls everything. There is no land inside, and a boundless black lake stretches without boundaries. Countless souls wander above it, and they will devour the soul power of any living creature that enters it. Once you enter that place, you can never leave again, and you will eventually join them. The only living being that has ever managed to enter and exit the place safely is the ten-tailed fox, Hu Tianlang."
"Oh? Did the old fox really enter that place in the past?" Zhang Fei [5] asked in surprise.

Qing Qiu’er looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a gaze full of questions, but he said nothing and waited for Feng Yao to answer him. "Hu Tianlang was born from both Yin and Yang, unlike the Primordial Genesis Beast, which was born from Yang, or the Primordial Nihility Beast, which was born from Yin. Inside that place, he encountered his rival, a fiercely deadly woman who was also born from both Yin and Yang, and she lived inside the Yin-Yang Lotus. By the way, the woman is not a living creature like us, and she is the guardian of that place. Fortunately, he possessed the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, which granted him complete control over Yin and Yang, allowing him to safely exit that place. Even so, he never went there again after that, especially since that woman was as powerful as him."
"Did you hear all of this from the old fox?"

"Do you think I would dare go in there without Yin-Yang abilities?" Feng Yao responded with a shake of her head. "To tell you the truth, I caught once a glimpse of that place, which happened during my first reincarnation."
"Wait!" Qing Qiu’er called out to them. "Who exactly are you two? Your conversation is too complicated and confusing, and I feel that neither of you are ordinary living beings."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "Feng Yao is not an ordinary living being, but I was born and grew up as an ordinary human in a mortal realm located in the Three Immortal Realms. As for my other identities, I got them because of an accident, but I don’t want to talk about that now."
"Is that true? Are you really an ordinary human?" Qing Qiu’er asked with a doubtful look.

Luo Yunxiao answered her immediately. "Zhang Fei and I were born on a planet called Earth, one of the planets in the lower realms of the Three Mortal Realms. He was born to two mortal parents, and we grew up together for several years, but we were separated when my parents brought me back to this realm. Therefore, you don’t need to doubt him."

"I see." Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding before questioning Feng Yao, "Then, who are you exactly? How do you know the ten-tailed fox? What do you mean by the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast? You previously mentioned your first reincarnation, but you also previously said that you are the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling."

"My identity is far beyond your understanding, so I won’t tell you anything." Qing Qiu’er wore an annoyed look, but Feng Yao determined not to say anything to her, leaving her to sigh softly. "The Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast were born during the Primordial Era, and both are extremely powerful. In fact, both are still alive today, but they are currently in hibernation because the universe can no longer accommodate their power."
"Huh?" Qing Qiu’er’s expression turned to shock upon hearing that. "Doesn’t that mean their existence could destroy this universe? How do you know about them?"

"Secret." Feng Yao winked at her. "Zhang Fei, I forbid you from going to the Lotus Limbo World before you evolve to the ten-tailed one. Even after you evolve to one, you should think twice about entering there because you are different from Hu Tianlang, and you don’t possess the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique. Once you enter there, that woman will definitely attack and capture you, and you will never be able to return."
Qing Qiu’er interrupted directly. "What does she mean by you evolving into ten tails? Do you have a connection with the ten-tailed fox?"

"I am the successor of the ten-tailed fox." Qing Qiu’er’s eyes sparkled like stars as soon as Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his complete fox form, but he hurriedly returned to his human form, disappointing her. ’She also likes fluffy things, huh?’ "By the way, it’s already midnight, so we should go back now, and we’ll talk again another time."
"Let’s go back." Feng Yao immediately took them all back to the inn.
When they arrived there, Zhang Fei [5] returned to his room, as did Feng Yao and the other three women. Meanwhile, Qing Qiu’er immediately went to see You Feiling, where they discussed some matters.

Early in the morning, Zhang Fei [5] and the others were already in the main hall of the Divine Samsara Sect, where hundreds of groups of cultivators gathered and listened to a male elder explain to them all the tests needed to enter the forbidden land, which consists of seven stages.

Although Zhang Fei [5] had decided to enter with the groups of Feng Bingying, Tian Huangjin, Tianshi Shengji, and Qing Qiu’er, they did not stand in the same line because that would only attract the attention of the other groups.
