In that instant, the Yin-Yang diagram disappeared, and the Yin-Yang Lotus split into five more lotuses before returning to their respective souls.
After they returned their souls into their bodies, Zhang Fei [5] immediately spoke.
"Incredible!
We dual-soul cultivated for a few hours, but the results are like a few days of doing it."
"Hehe." Qing Qiu’er chuckled.
"If you did it with them a long time ago, your soul level might have already surpassed the divine stage."
Zhang Fei [5] looked at her.
"Who are the cultivators in this realm who have reached the Immortal Soul Level?"
"No one." All of them turned to Feng Yao, who suddenly appeared.
"Do you think people won’t notice your actions even if you do them in a remote place like this?
I previously detected your movements, so I came here and covered your aura from a distance."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed awkwardly.
"Thank you, wife."
"Hey!
My parents already consider you their son-in-law, but I’m not your wife yet." Zhang Fei [5]’s lips curled upwards, but Feng Yao ignored him and spoke to Qing Qiu’er.
"You should give up on your plans to go to the Lotus Limbo World, especially since that place is different from what you think."
Qing Qiu’er raised an eyebrow.
"Who exactly are you?
How did you know about the Lotus Limbo World?"
"My past name was Huo Yanling." Qing Qiu’er’s eyes widened in shock as soon as Feng Yao said that name.
"No one dares to claim to be one, so you don’t need to doubt my identity.
The Forbidden Lotus Codex is indeed useful for cultivating your soul, but the Lotus Limbo World is a different case.
The world is neither the world of the living nor the world of the dead, and the source of everything is stored there."
"The Yin and Yang, right?"
"You’re not wrong about that." Feng Yao replied with a nod.

"The Lotus Limbo World was created by one of the hidden forces in this universe as a prison, and the force created it to imprison the souls of cultivators who tried to defy the Wheel of Reincarnation."
Qing Qiu’er seemed confused by that.
"What do you mean by one of the hidden forces in this universe?
What kind of force created the Lotus Limbo World?"
"I can’t explain anything to you about those hidden forces, and you have to find them yourself to know the truth." Feng Yao briefly glanced at Zhang Fei [5] before continuing.
"One of those hidden powers is the Will of the universe; it didn’t create the Lotus Limbo World but another one.
I can’t tell you guys about that, especially since it would immediately attack me if I mentioned it."
Unlike Qing Qiu’er, Zhang Fei [5], who had already encountered the Will of the Universe, immediately realized something.
"You can’t tell us about that force, but you can tell us the truth about the Lotus Limbo World, right?"
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at him.
"As I mentioned earlier, the Lotus Limbo World serves as a prison for the souls of cultivators who tried to defy the Wheel of Reincarnation.
They thought that by doing so, they could achieve immortality, but true immortality never existed.
All living beings can live extremely long lives by cultivating and reaching the highest possible level, which grants them an extremely long lifespan.
Even so, their lifespans will still be exhausted, and they will die in the end."
"A true immortality never existed." Qing Qiu’er and the three women muttered to themselves as they looked at Feng Yao in shock.
Feng Yao continued straight away.
"The Lotus Limbo World is a stagnant pocket dimension, where the Yin-Yang Lotus controls everything.
There is no land inside, and a boundless black lake stretches without boundaries.
Countless souls wander above it, and they will devour the soul power of any living creature that enters it.
Once you enter that place, you can never leave again, and you will eventually join them.
The only living being that has ever managed to enter and exit the place safely is the ten-tailed fox, Hu Tianlang."
"Oh?
Did the old fox really enter that place in the past?" Zhang Fei [5] asked in surprise.
Qing Qiu’er looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a gaze full of questions, but he said nothing and waited for Feng Yao to answer him.
"Hu Tianlang was born from both Yin and Yang, unlike the Primordial Genesis Beast, which was born from Yang, or the Primordial Nihility Beast, which was born from Yin.
Inside that place, he encountered his rival, a fiercely deadly woman who was also born from both Yin and Yang, and she lived inside the Yin-Yang Lotus.
By the way, the woman is not a living creature like us, and she is the guardian of that place.
Fortunately, he possessed the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, which granted him complete control over Yin and Yang, allowing him to safely exit that place.
Even so, he never went there again after that, especially since that woman was as powerful as him."
"Did you hear all of this from the old fox?"
"Do you think I would dare go in there without Yin-Yang abilities?" Feng Yao responded with a shake of her head.
"To tell you the truth, I caught once a glimpse of that place, which happened during my first reincarnation."
"Wait!" Qing Qiu’er called out to them.
"Who exactly are you two?
Your conversation is too complicated and confusing, and I feel that neither of you are ordinary living beings."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that.
"Feng Yao is not an ordinary living being, but I was born and grew up as an ordinary human in a mortal realm located in the Three Immortal Realms.
As for my other identities, I got them because of an accident, but I don’t want to talk about that now."
"Is that true?
Are you really an ordinary human?" Qing Qiu’er asked with a doubtful look.
Luo Yunxiao answered her immediately.
"Zhang Fei and I were born on a planet called Earth, one of the planets in the lower realms of the Three Mortal Realms.
He was born to two mortal parents, and we grew up together for several years, but we were separated when my parents brought me back to this realm.
Therefore, you don’t need to doubt him."
"I see." Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding before questioning Feng Yao, "Then, who are you exactly?
How do you know the ten-tailed fox?
What do you mean by the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast?
You previously mentioned your first reincarnation, but you also previously said that you are the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling."
"My identity is far beyond your understanding, so I won’t tell you anything." Qing Qiu’er wore an annoyed look, but Feng Yao determined not to say anything to her, leaving her to sigh softly.
"The Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast were born during the Primordial Era, and both are extremely powerful.
In fact, both are still alive today, but they are currently in hibernation because the universe can no longer accommodate their power."
"Huh?" Qing Qiu’er’s expression turned to shock upon hearing that.
"Doesn’t that mean their existence could destroy this universe?
How do you know about them?"
"Secret." Feng Yao winked at her.
"Zhang Fei, I forbid you from going to the Lotus Limbo World before you evolve to the ten-tailed one.
Even after you evolve to one, you should think twice about entering there because you are different from Hu Tianlang, and you don’t possess the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique.
Once you enter there, that woman will definitely attack and capture you, and you will never be able to return."
Qing Qiu’er interrupted directly.
"What does she mean by you evolving into ten tails?
Do you have a connection with the ten-tailed fox?"

"I am the successor of the ten-tailed fox." Qing Qiu’er’s eyes sparkled like stars as soon as Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his complete fox form, but he hurriedly returned to his human form, disappointing her. ’She also likes fluffy things, huh?’ "By the way, it’s already midnight, so we should go back now, and we’ll talk again another time."
"Let’s go back." Feng Yao immediately took them all back to the inn.
When they arrived there, Zhang Fei [5] returned to his room, as did Feng Yao and the other three women.
Meanwhile, Qing Qiu’er immediately went to see You Feiling, where they discussed some matters.

Early in the morning, Zhang Fei [5] and the others were already in the main hall of the Divine Samsara Sect, where hundreds of groups of cultivators gathered and listened to a male elder explain to them all the tests needed to enter the forbidden land, which consists of seven stages.

Although Zhang Fei [5] had decided to enter with the groups of Feng Bingying, Tian Huangjin, Tianshi Shengji, and Qing Qiu’er, they did not stand in the same line because that would only attract the attention of the other groups.

chapters.title: Chapter 1115: Jin Nanqing
paragraphs: "Elders! Look over there, he’s that young god-rank alchemist." Jiao Huanfeng and Jiao Suyin immediately turned their attention towards the direction Jiao Meili was pointing. Jiao Meili was pointing, and their gazes fell on Zhang Fei [5], who was chatting with Luo Yunxiao and the others in one of the rows of people.

As experienced alchemists, both Jiao Huanfeng and Jiao Suyin could smell a strong scent of herbs coming from Zhang Fei [5], even though they were quite far away. However, both people were shocked when they saw Luo Fenghan and his family members with him. "Did Luo Lianjin tell you anything about that kid yesterday?"

"That old bastard was unwilling to reveal that kid’s true identity." Both Jiao Huanfeng and Jiao Suyin watched them seriously, but they seemed curious about Luo Yunxiao’s familiarity with Luo Fenghan, and they felt that their faces were quite similar. "Have you ever heard that Luo Fenghan has a daughter? Why does that little girl’s face look similar to his face?"

"No." Jiao Huanfeng shook his head. "Back then, I attended the wedding of Luo Fenghan’s two sons, but I didn’t see that little girl there. To my knowledge, there has never been any news mentioning that he had a daughter prior to this."

Jiao Suyin nodded in understanding before turning to the people behind them. "Jiao Yunbai, I want you to keep an eye on the young woman by Luo Fenghan’s side, and I want you to find out as much detailed information about her as possible."
"Yes, Elder." The young man looked at them before licking his lips. ’Haha! That woman is truly beautiful and sexy!’
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow and looked at the Jiao Clan’s group.
Luo Yunxiao noticed Zhang Fei [5]’s reaction. "What happened, husband? Do you know them?"
"They—"

Luo Fenghan spoke to them directly. "They are from the Jiao Clan, and they are quite skilled in alchemy, with ten god-rank alchemists in their clan. Did you meet them during the alchemy test yesterday?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him as he activated his natural awareness ability. "Jiao Moli and Jiao Meili also took the test here, and we met there, so they should already know my identity as a god-rank alchemist. Are Jiao Huanfeng and Jiao Suyin important elders in the Jiao Clan, fathers-in-law? I can sense something missing from them, and they are clearly targeting me, especially the old man."

Luo Fenghan nodded at him. "They were two of the ten important elders in the Jiao Clan, and Jiao Huanfeng was the leader of those elders. That old man was notorious for his bad behavior, particularly towards young and talented alchemists. Since they already know your identity as a god-rank alchemist, you shouldn’t be surprised if he targets you, especially since you’re the youngest alchemist to reach that rank."

"You’re wrong about that." Feng Yao joined in their conversation. "The youngest god-rank alchemist in this era is Jin Nanqing, and he is Luo Lianjin’s master. That little brat should be in this sect now, and I believe he will appear soon specifically to meet Zhang Fei."
’Empress Huo! You’re the only person who dares to call Jin Nanqing a little brat!’ Luo Fenghan inwardly muttered while wearing a bitter smile.
"Who is the top female alchemist in this realm?" Zhang Fei [5] curiously asked.

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled and teased him. "Are you thinking of courting her? Why don’t you take Lin Jingxia as your wife? Her talent in alchemy is not inferior to that woman, but unfortunately, she was born in the three mortal realms. If she were born in this realm, I’m sure she would have long surpassed her and Jin Nanqing, and she would have become the best alchemist in this realm."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] simply laughed at that.

Feng Yao immediately told him. "Huo Lanyin is the best female alchemist in this realm, but you have to know that this realm is different from the Three Mortal Realms, and the abilities of the alchemists here are not that different. Apart from her and Jin Nanqing, there are eight other alchemists whose abilities are almost equal to them."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] turned to her. "Did Huo Lanyin have a relationship with you in the past?"
"Yes." Feng Yao admitted it directly. "Huo Lanyin comes from my Huo Clan, but she is two generations below me, and she lives in my palace in the Blazing Nirvana Domain."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "How about you bring Lin Jingxia to your domain? If she trains in alchemy with you and Huo Lanyin, her abilities will be further honed, and she will be able to surpass them."

"I don’t have a problem with that, but you should discuss this matter with Lin Jingxia first. If she agrees, I will take her to my domain when I’m ready to go back there." Feng Yao then looked at a middle-aged man who had just appeared in the ranks of the elders of the Divine Samsara Sect. "That little brat is Jin Nanqing."
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Jin Nanqing, who was also looking at him. The middle-aged man sent him a voice transmission and invited him to meet, to which he immediately agreed.
Zhang Fei [5] asked him to meet inside the Forbidden Land, and Ji Nanqing agreed to that. "He will meet us there."

"That’s a good choice, so you won’t stand out too much in these people’s eyes." Feng Yao suddenly sensed someone’s hot gaze on her, and it was all too easy for her to find its owner. She faintly smiled and shot something at the owner, which immediately entered that person’s body. ’Heh! You’re lucky I’m in a good mood, or else I will kill you right here right now.’

Not long after, the sect master of the Divine Samsara Sect, Liang Huizhong, arrived at the location. He provided some information and pointers for the participants before asking the elders to lead the participants to begin their tests.

Yu Shan immediately approached Zhang Fei [5]’s group, especially since he was the one in charge of escorting them. He was a little surprised when he saw Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu among them, and he immediately recognized their identities as ice phoenixes because of the cold aura emanating from their bodies.

Yu Shan could sense Zhang Fei [5]’s Yang Qi within Feng Xueying and Feng Jinqiu’s bodies, especially since they had cultivated using it in the past two decades or so. ’This little kid is really lucky! Not only does he have Empress Huo as his wife, but he got two ice phoenixes as his wives too.’ "Let’s head to the test ground."
Sometime later, they arrived at an open field with a device in the middle, which was almost identical to Zhang Fei [5]’s training space. "Is the device what I think, Feng Yao?"

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at him. "Just like the Xianjin Realm, the Sky Pillar Domain is filled with modern equipment, and the device in the middle is one of their creations. I’m sure you will enjoy that domain, particularly because it is quite similar to Earth."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "I’ll go to that domain later, especially since I need some modern equipment."

"I’ll start the test now, and you guys can take your turn doing it." Yu Shan immediately walked to the center and activated the device, summoning ten beast statues. "As previously explained, the first test is the silent step, and you only need to cross to the far side without waking more than three statues. However, the gravity in this place is two times heavier than the surrounding area, so your steps will be very heavy."
"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled and got ready. "Husband, I’ll do it first."
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
Yu Shan immediately spoke to her. "If you’re ready, you—"
Swoosh
"Huh?" Yu Shan was shocked when Luo Yunxiao had crossed to the far side. ’What the hell? How can she move that fast? Does she really not feel the change in gravity?’
Luo Yunxiao stood at the far side and asked him, "Did I pass, Elder Yu?"
"You passed." Yu Shan looked at the others. "Next."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately asked. "Elder Yu, can we cross there at the same time?"

"Hmm?" Yu Shan frowned at that, but he could see that Zhang Fei [5] and the others were very confident, except for Luo Fenghan’s two sons and daughters-in-law. "Usually, I won’t allow that, but you guys can try it if you are confident about passing this first test."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Yan Jinwu and the others. "Brothers-in-law and sisters-in-law, we will be waiting for the four of you there."
Zhang Fei [5], Yan Jinwu, Sima Huiqing, Feng Xueying, and Feng Jinqiu moved at the same time. In just a few seconds, they had already arrived at Luo Yunxiao’s side, leaving Yu Shan shocked again.
Before Yu Shan recovered from his shock, Feng Yao had already led her parents through the area, and they also had no difficulty passing the first test.

Yu Shan massaged his forehead as he saw them standing relaxed at the end of the area. ’How exactly do they train their speed? Apart from Empress Huo, their speed was simply abnormal!’ "Fenghan, it’s your two sons’ and two daughters-in-law’s turn."
"I will be waiting for you at the end of the line." Luo Fenghan moved to the other side.

chapters.title: Chapter 1116: Pass All The Tests
paragraphs: With considerable difficulty, Luo Zhenyu, Luo Jiaxuan, and Cheng Mengyao passed the first test. Among them, only Bing Xingying managed to pass it with ease.

Yun Shan removed the beast statues and activated the device once again, causing a five-meter-tall incense stick to appear there. "The second test is called the Spiritual Endurance, and you only need to maintain the stability of your Qi against the pressure. If your Qi spirals out of control, you will fail this test. You can sit around the incense, and I will start the test."

After they did that, Yu Shan activated the device once again. Instantly, a powerful pressure pressed down from the sky, causing several of them to fall to the ground, except for Zhang Fei [5], Luo Yunxiao, Feng Xueying, Feng Yao, and Bing Xingying.

Luo Zhenyu, Luo Jiaxuan, and Cheng Mengyao faced the worst conditions. They had difficulty maintaining their sitting position, and the Qi within their bodies began to churn under the pressure, forcing them to hastily control it.
Despite their past experience and rigorous training, Feng Tian, Feng Jiu, Sima Huiqing, Yan Jinwu, and Feng Jinqiu also faced a little difficulty withstanding the pressure.

Yu Shan raised an eyebrow when he saw Zhang Fei [5]’s expression was so calm that he could converse with Feng Yao and Luo Yunxiao without any difficulty, and the Qi within his body was too calm in the face of such a powerful pressure. ’How can a kid who has just ascended to this realm be so calm like this? His cultivation, speed, and calmness are truly extraordinary. Jin Nanqing told me that he is a god-rank alchemist, which means he is the youngest in his generation to reach that stage. Additionally, he mentioned yesterday that he is a blacksmith and an array master, and I suspect that he has also reached the peak rank in both fields. If that’s true, he’s the only cultivator who managed to achieve all that at such a young age.’

Luo Fenghan stood on the side of the area, repeatedly shaking his head as he observed that Luo Zhenyu, Luo Jiaxuan, and Cheng Mengyao were having difficulty controlling their Qi. He didn’t think much of Bing Xingying, especially after learning that she was a clone of the void spirit. ’I guess I’ll have to train them harder, or else they’ll fall even further behind.’
As time passed, Feng Tian, Feng Jiu, Sima Huiqing, Yan Jinwu, and Feng Jinqiu eventually managed to stabilize themselves and adapt to the pressure, allowing their Qi to flow calmly and steadily.

Bing Xingying glanced at her husband and the others, then briefly looked at Yu Shan before using her abilities to envelop the three of them in a thin layer of void qi, which allowed them to breathe calmly and start controlling their Qi.
A few hours later, the incense finally burned out, and all of them successfully passed the second test, even though some of them had cheated.

Yu Shan could only shake his head and activate the device again, summoning a giant mirror. "The third test is the True Self, and you must face your heart demon. If any of you try to deny and escape your heart demon, this mirror will suck your soul into it, and your soul will be imprisoned within it until you overcome it. If you afraid of it, you can withdraw now."
"Demon heart, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] muttered, recalling the same challenge at the Star Tower years ago. "Please start it, Elder Yu."

"Do you two really not have demon hearts?"

"Yes."

"She is my alchemist master." Yu Shan was not surprised when Zhang Fei [5] pointed at Feng Yao, especially since Empress Huo Yanling was the best alchemist in the past. "I learned about blacksmithing and formation arrays from several seniors from the Three Mortal Realms, and I deepened my mastery in formation arrays from one of my wives, who had also reached rank 10."

Luo Yunxiao then spoke. "Elder Yu, my husband is a maniac when it comes to learning new things, but not many things can pique his interest. If he finds something that truly interests him, he will try his best to learn it as deeply as possible."
"Do you also master anything else besides all that?" Yu Shan asked Zhang Fei [5] again.
Feng Yao spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "Just show him, since others can’t peek in here with me, and I’m sure he won’t tell anyone."
*Thud*

Yu Shan fell on his butt after Zhang Fei [5] activated his eleven domains. His old eyes widened in shock, and his fingers pointed forward tremblingly. "The fire, darkness, light, wind, ice, water, lightning, and wood elemental domains. What... what are the other three domains?"
"Sword, soul, and dual cultivation domains." Yu Shan looked at Zhang Fei [5], who immediately dispelled all his domains. "Please keep everything to yourself, Elder Yu."

"I know." Yu Shan looked at Luo Yunxiao and the others, who were laughing to themselves. He sighed softly before speaking to them. "With you and Empress Huo by their side, I think the remaining tests are useless to them, and I’m sure all of you will be fine inside. Therefore, I will stop this test here, and all of you will enter the Forbidden Land in two days."
"Are you sure it won’t be a problem for you, little kid?" Feng Yao asked him.
Yu Shan nodded at her. "Don’t worry, Empress. I will take care of everything, and they won’t know about everything that happens in this place."

chapters.title: Chapter 1117: Void Seed’s Location
paragraphs: Just as Luo Fenghan was about to follow Zhang Fei [5] and the others away, Yu Shan stopped him. "Where did you meet that young monster?"

"Do you remember when Xiaoyi and I disappeared hundreds of years ago, Elder Yu?" Yu Shan nodded to Luo Fenghan. "Back then, we went to the Three Mortal Realms. We met Zhang Fei’s mother, who was still pregnant with him at the time. We wanted to take him with us at that time, but his family were just mortals who had never known cultivation, so we abandoned our plans. However, fate took another direction, and he managed to become a cultivator by chance. He built his strength and learned everything with the help of other cultivators, and they have been his allies ever since. He found us because Feng Yao told him about us, and she took him to us when he ascended to this realm. By the way, you have to keep everything about him to yourself, or else those jealous cultivators will attack him."
Yu Shan nodded to him. "Don’t worry, my mouth is tightly sealed. I will never let a talented cultivator like him die young, and I will look forward to the day he stands at the pinnacle."

"Hahaha." Luo Fenghan laughed at that. "To be able to stand at the pinnacle of the cultivation world, he must surpass many cultivators first, whether righteous or heretic ones. The strongest of the righteous cultivators is the Dragon Emperor, Long Wuzhao. The strongest of the heretic cultivators is the Celestial Demon God, Mo Shentian. If he succeeds in surpassing them, all the cultivators in this realm will respect him, including us."

"That’s true," Yu Shan replied with an affirmative nod. "Speaking of Mo Shentian, he hasn’t appeared since his battle with Long Wuzhao, leading everyone to suspect that his injuries were too severe and he hasn’t recovered yet. Alright, you should leave now, and we will enter the Forgotten Land in two days."
"Yeah." After Luo Fenghan left, Yu Shan immediately disappeared from the place to report the test results of Zhang Fei [5] and the others.

When they returned to the hall, Beiming Youhuang and her disciples were already waiting for them. Unlike Zhang Fei [5] and the others, Hua Xiang’er had already entered the Forbidden Land; thus, she no longer needed to undergo those tests. "How did you guys finish so quickly?"
"Hehe." Luo Yinxiao giggled and pointed at Feng Yao. "We were able to finish faster because of Big Sis Yao. By the way, we have to go now, especially since some people started watching my husband."
"The Jiao Clan." Luo Yinxiao nodded to Beiming Youhuang, and they immediately left the place after Luo Fenghan returned.

After they arrived at the inn, Zhang Fei [5] decided to send Luo Yunxiao, Feng Xueying, and Feng Jinqiu back to the training space. Additionally, he sent Feng Tian and Feng Jiu there too, so they could prepare themselves a little longer.

Zhang Fei [5] didn’t send Sima Huiqing and Yan Jinwu back there, especially since both of them were his wives. Just as he was about to dual cultivate with them, Luo Fenghan suddenly brought his two sons and daughter-in-law into his room. "Son, can you take them to your private training ground?"

"Alright, I’ll send them there." Luo Fenghan was relieved that he didn’t refuse his request, and Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened a portal there. However, he stopped Bing Xingying as she was about to enter. "Help me with something first, sister-in-law."
"What can I do for you?" Bing Xingying asked.
"I need your help to enter the void." Zhang Fei [5]’s request surprised both Luo Fenghan and Bing Xingying. "I need some items, and only that person can help me find them."
"Who are you referring to, son?" Luo Fenghan curiously asked.

"I apologize, but I promised that person not to tell anyone, so I can’t tell you that person’s identity, father-in-law." Zhang Fei [5] spoke to Bing Xingying again. "Take me to the void now, sister-in-law."
"Alright." Bing Xingying sliced the air, creating a hole big enough for Zhang Fei [5] to enter. Thereafter, she entered the training space, and he entered the void after closing the portal.
Luo Fenghan released a soft sigh. "Are you two going to be okay here?"
"I will protect them." Luo Fenghan nodded to Feng Yao and left the three women directly.
"Brother-in-law." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Bing Xingying’s real body. "How did you meet that person?"
"She summoned me when I was stranded in the space rift years ago, and I’ve met her twice since then." Zhang Fei [5] immediately released his aura to summon the will of the universe.
In a matter of seconds, Zhang Fei [5] and Bing Xingying were standing in front of the gate leading to the Era of The Beginning, surprising the void spirit.

"Let’s go in." Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the gate and led his sister-in-law inside. Throughout the journey to the final room, Bing Xingying observed all the statues inside. "Have you never been to this place before?"
"She’s never taken me here before." Bing Xingxing replied with a shake of her head. "What exactly is this place? Why are there so many statues of all races here?"

"She called this place the Era of The Beginning, where history since the creation of this universe is stored. Most of the statues you see here are the first living beings who were born in this universe, as well as those who were born after them." Bing Xingxing looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a look of shock, never expecting that her brother-in-law knew so many things that no one else knew. "She brought me here because I am the successor of the ten-tailed fox, and she wanted me to bring peace back to this universe."
Bing Xingying fell into a daze for a while before asking him. "Will peace really return to this universe, brother-in-law? Isn’t that task too heavy for you?"

"The task is too heavy for me, and I have always rejected it in the past. However, I’ve thought about it a lot in the past two decades, and I decided to accept my destiny as the peace bringer for the sake of myself and everyone else." Zhang Fei [5] turned his head to her. "Even though I’ve decided that, I can’t do everything by myself, especially since I have to face so many people who don’t understand the importance of peace. Therefore, I need many allies to help me, so I hope you’re willing to help me in my fight to bring peace back, sister-in-law."
Bing Xingying nodded slightly. "As long as peace can return to this universe, I will use my void abilities to help you in facing them."
"Thank you."
Before long, they arrived at the last room, and Bing Xingying immediately ran to the woman who was waiting for them there. "Big Sister."
{You finally met him, Xingying.} The woman looked at Zhang Fei [5]. {Did you want to ask me about the location of those demon items?}
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Aside from those five items, I also want to know the location of the void elemental seed."

Bing Xingying looked at Zhang Fei [5] in surprise, and the woman spoke to him directly. {The void elemental seed is located within the void core, and the only person who can help you reach that location is Xingying. Unfortunately, she was still too weak right now, so she couldn’t enter that place yet. If you want to get the seed, you have to help her recover and strengthen herself, and she will take you there once she is truly strong.}
"Not even a cultivator with the void element like Zhe Wuming can enter that place?"

The woman shook her head. {Zhe Wuming does possess the void element, and his comprehension of it is quite high. However, his body is a mortal one, and he will disintegrate if he tries to enter that place. Unlike him, Xingying is the void spirit born from the void itself, so she can enter that place.}
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Please tell me the location of those five demon materials, and I will find them to break through to the Demon Monarch Rank."

The woman flicked her finger, and some information appeared in Zhang Fei [5]’s mind afterward. She then warned him. {There have been major changes in the Forbidden Land, and demons from several races are roaming there. Most of them are powerful, so you must be careful of them. Additionally, Taotie and the other three evil mythical beasts are starting to move again, and you will encounter their subordinates there.}
Zhang Fei [5] nodded to her. "Thank you for your warning. By the way, please send me back now."
The woman flicked her finger again, and Zhang Fei [5] disappeared. "Will my brother-in-law succeed in bringing peace back to this universe, Big Sister?"
{Zhang Fei will succeed and ensure that this universe will be safe once again. You must return now, and you must help him retrieve the void elemental seed in the future.}
"Yes, Big Sis."

After he returned to the inn, Zhang Fei [5] did not dual cultivate with Sima Huiqing and Yan Jinwu, especially since Feng Yao was there. Instead, he dual-soul cultivated with them because the phoenix princess’s soul simply surpassed theirs, and they did so until the day the portal of the Forbidden Land opened.

If you want to get the seed, you have to help her recover and strengthen herself, and she will take you there once she is truly strong.}
"Not even a cultivator with the void element like Zhe Wuming can enter that place?"
The woman shook her head. {Zhe Wuming does possess the void element, and his comprehension of it is quite high.
However, his body is a mortal one, and he will disintegrate if he tries to enter that place.
Unlike him, Xingying is the void spirit born from the void itself, so she can enter that place.}
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"Please tell me the location of those five demon materials, and I will find them to break through to the Demon Monarch Rank."
The woman flicked her finger, and some information appeared in Zhang Fei [5]’s mind afterward.
She then warned him. {There have been major changes in the Forbidden Land, and demons from several races are roaming there.
Most of them are powerful, so you must be careful of them.
Additionally, Taotie and the other three evil mythical beasts are starting to move again, and you will encounter their subordinates there.}
Zhang Fei [5] nodded to her.
"Thank you for your warning.
By the way, please send me back now."
The woman flicked her finger again, and Zhang Fei [5] disappeared.
"Will my brother-in-law succeed in bringing peace back to this universe, Big Sister?"
{Zhang Fei will succeed and ensure that this universe will be safe once again.
You must return now, and you must help him retrieve the void elemental seed in the future.}
"Yes, Big Sis."
After he returned to the inn, Zhang Fei [5] did not dual cultivate with Sima Huiqing and Yan Jinwu, especially since Feng Yao was there.
Instead, he dual-soul cultivated with them because the phoenix princess’s soul simply surpassed theirs, and they did so until the day the portal of the Forbidden Land opened.

chapters.title: Chapter 1118: The Forbidden Land
paragraphs: Two days passed quickly, and the portal to the Forbidden Land almost opened. Zhang Fei [5] took Luo Yunxiao, Feng Xueying, Feng Jinqiu, Luo Zhenyu, Luo Jiaxuan, Cheng Mengyao, and Bing Xingying out of the training room.

For the past two days, Zhang Fei [5] hadn’t left his room even once, fully focused on his dual-soul cultivation. Qing Qiu’er joined them, as she still harbored a desire to go to the Lotus Limbo World, despite the phoenix princess’s warning to forget about it.

After Qing Qiu’er returned to her sect members, Luo Feng and Beiming Youhuang led Zhang Fei [5] and the others to the location of the portal to the Forbidden Land, where hundreds of groups of cultivators had gathered. However, there weren’t as many of them as there were during the entrance test, mainly because many of them failed to complete their test.
Zhang Fei [5] could feel the gazes of the people from the Jiao Clan on him, but he pretended not to notice and focused more on reading the statuses of the cultivators present.

Zhang Fei [5] saw many familiar faces there, such as Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing, whom he had met in the Moon Illusion Domain when he had broken through to the Five Celestial Realms. Both of them were leading groups of people from the Zenith Sect and the Spring Breeze Sect.

Zhang Fei [5] also saw several people from the Empyrean Main Domain, such as Fan Ning, Ru Yan, Zhi Yuan, Chen Qi, Qin Wuzhang, and Jiang Yuhei, who were the ancestors of the Fan, Ru, Zhi, Chen, Qin, and Jiang main clans. They decided to lead their respective members, especially after they heard that Luo Fenghan brought him to that place.

The sect masters of the Azure Immortal Peak, the Hidden Moon Sect, the Nine Sword Hall, the Eternal Heaven Sect, and the Star Cloud Pavilion were also present there, leading their respective sect members. To Zhang Fei [5]’s surprise, his acquaintances who had joined those sects were also present, such as Lin Jingxia, Hun Di, Zhe Wuming, and several other seniors.
Zhang Fei [5] also saw two people he hadn’t seen in a long time: Tian Shuixiang and his wife, Ye Zhiye. Both of them decided to join his group, especially since they were the only two of them.
"Long time no see." Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye greeted them.
"Long time no see." Zhang Fei [5] asked them directly. "Why did you two come here? Don’t the people here recognize you two?"

"The Forbidden Land is a sacred place in this realm, and we haven’t been there in a long time, so we wanted to try entering again. Moreover, our disguises are neat, and no one will recognize our true identities." Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye were surprised after they checked his cultivation. "When did you bring them all to this realm? When did you break through to the Five Celestial Realms?"

"We arrived more than five years ago, but we focused on our seclusion, and I broke through to this stage a few days ago." Zhang Fei [5] then asked them again. "What have you two been doing for the past years? Have you returned to your domains?"

"Hehe." Ye Zhiye chuckled. "We didn’t return to our domains, and we entered into seclusion in another domain since we came here. Our old friend informed us that the Forbidden Land would open, so we stopped our seclusion and came here, but we didn’t expect that you all were already in this realm. Where do you guys stay now?"
Zhang Fei [5] pointed at Luo Fenghan. "He is my father-in-law and the Sect Master of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, so we live in the Empyrean Domain."
"You haven’t been to this realm long, but you’ve already found a new wife here." Ye Zhiye looked at Luo Yunxiao. "She’s the one, right?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Yunxiao is my childhood friend, and I hastily ascended to this realm because of her. By the way, my master and the others chose to join the sects in the Empyrean Main Domain."
"I met them when we got here yesterday." Tian Shuixiang then looked at Feng Jiu and Feng Tian. "You two cultivate so fast."

"Haha." Feng Jiu softly laughed and embraced her daughter. "Yao’er took us to a special place for fire cultivators, and we cultivated there for many years; thus, our cultivation progressed rapidly, but we are still weaker than the two of you, right?"
Feng Tian then asked him. "What cultivation level are you at now?"

"They have reached the 1-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm now." Feng Yao’s answer shocked her parents. "They have been suppressing their cultivation for too long in disguise in the Three Mortal Realms, so you two shouldn’t be surprised if they have reached that stage by now."
Both Feng Jiu and Feng Tian nodded in understanding. "Son, aren’t you going to invite Hun Di and the others to join us?"
"Eh?" Ye Zhiye was surprised and asked Feng Jiu. "Since when is he your son-in-law?"

"Since I handed over the Phoenix Race to him." Feng Jiu then sighed softly and put on a pitiful look. "Unfortunately, my daughter is still not willing to accept him as her husband, even though I have long wanted a grandchild."

Feng Yao chose not to comment on that and glared at Zhang Fei [5], who smiled playfully at her. He then answered Feng Jiu, "I originally wanted to invite them to join us, but they’ve become disciples of those sects, so I canceled my intention. Moreover, they are experienced cultivators, so I’m sure they’ll be fine. Additionally, I can track them easily, and I’ll rescue them if they encounter any serious problems."
"Have you told them about the information you received two days ago?" Feng Yao questioned him.

"The situation is quite dire over there, so I informed them via telepathy earlier." Zhang Fei [5] then told Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye about the movements of several demon races in the Forbidden Land, which shocked them. "I still don’t have any information about the identities of the demon races roaming around in there, so I can’t confirm whether the two demon races are also in there. Additionally, my information tells me that Taotie and the three evil mythical beasts have started moving again, and they have also sent their subordinates there, so we must be fully alert."
"Then—"
*Dong... Dong... Dong*

The sound of three gongs suddenly echoed throughout the area, and the sect master of the Divine Samsara Sect, Liang Huizhong, landed at the front of the line, followed by the elders of the sect, including Yu Shan. Behind them, dozens of disciples from the sect lined up neatly, waiting for his order.

Liang Huizhong ordered the elders to gather with groups of cultivators according to their respective assignments. Naturally, Yu Shan immediately joined Zhang Fei [5]’s group, but the presence of Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye among them surprised him a little. "Who are they?"

"They are our old friends, and they have been inside before; therefore, I invited them to join us." Zhang Fei [5] then introduced Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye to Yu Shan, and he also informed him about the information he had obtained regarding the situation inside. "Elder Yu, I know you are part of this sect, but you must not tell them this information, especially since they will suspect us."

Yu Shan nodded in understanding before explaining many things to them, especially about the locations within the Forbidden Land. What interested Zhang Fei [5] the most was the auction and the Temple of the Forgotten Flame, and he was impatient to go to those two places. Additionally, he was also impatient to meet the mysterious merchant, who appears there once every hundred years.
After they waited for some time, a powerful Qi wave swept toward all the cultivators present, indicating that the Forbidden Land had opened.
Liang Huizhong ordered his vice sect master to lead their sect members into the Forbidden Land, followed by groups of other cultivators.

Zhang Fei [5]’s group did not immediately follow them; he asked Yu Shan to wait for the rest of the group to enter first. After all the groups disappeared, they immediately moved to enter the Forbidden Land.
However, something unexpected suddenly happened, and the portal leading to the Forbidden Land was sealed from the inside, panicking Liang Huizhong and several people waiting outside.
"What happened, Sect Master? Why did this portal suddenly seal from the inside? Who did it?" An old man asked with a serious expression.
Liang Huizhong didn’t answer him and tried to open the seal forcefully, but a powerful counterattack knocked him quite far back. "Shit! Those demons created this seal!"
"Demons?"

"Yes." Liang Huizhong returned to his previous position. "If my guess is correct, people from the Celestial Demon Race and the Asura Demon Race are inside; otherwise, they wouldn’t be able to create such a powerful seal! I’ll contact the Golden Dragon Emperor now, especially since only he can defeat those demons."
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Forbidden Land, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]

Zhang Fei [5] smiled as the notification appeared, as he prevopusly thought that the gate would be useless in the Forbidden Land. ’This way, I don’t have to bother going to the sect, and I can come back here whenever we want.’ "So, where are we going first, Elder Yu?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1119: Two Sword Spirits’ Abilities
paragraphs: "We—"

"Before you explore other areas, you should be aware that someone has sealed this place from within." They turned to Feng Yao, who immediately attacked the exit. However, the seal deflected her attack, shocking Yu Shan. "It is clearly a demon seal, and—"
"The Calamity Demon Race is the mastermind behind this seal." Tian Shuixiang continued Feng Yao’s words.

"You’re right." Feng Yao then looked at other areas. "Nearly all demon races are present, with the exception of the Seven Emotions Demon Race. Qi Qingxiu rarely appears or attacks humans, and she mostly only attacks those who disturb her and her demon race."
"The situation would be even more chaotic if the Seven Emotions Demon God, Qi Qingxiu, were also here." Ye Zhiye spoke in a gloomy tone.

Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei [5], who had already used the Nature Awareness ability to check the entire area of the place. He discovered countless demons lurking throughout the Forbidden Land, but he found it strange that they didn’t attack the local residents. "There are hundreds of thousands of demons here, but the strongest among them are about fifty demons, who seem to be their leaders."
"Hundreds of thousands of demons?" Yu Shan muttered under his breath with a shocked expression. "How do you know their exact number, young man?"

"Elder Yu, I have a contract with a fairy, and our contract grants me a special ability, which allows me to distinguish the Qi of all living beings." Zhang Fei [5] pointed ahead. "You guys can’t see it, but I can see countless Qi threads right before my eyes. These black Qi threads belong to the demons, and there are hundreds of thousands of them, which corresponds to the number of demons present."
The more he got to know Zhang Fei [5], the more speechless Yu Shan became, and he felt that he was much more mysterious than he had previously estimated.
Zhang Fei [5] then asked Feng Yao a question. "You should be able to break the seal, right?"

"Do you need to ask a question you’re already sure of the answer to?" Feng Yao looked toward the seal again. "I can easily break the seal, but I won’t do it now. Moreover, you need those demons to improve yourself, so let’s let them come to us, and we’ll slaughter them."

"Yeah, you’re right." Zhang Fei [5] tried to open the portal to the training space, and the result was as he expected, as the portal opened. He then opened the gate to one of the realms, and it also opened, meaning the seal was only sealing the portal out of that place. "This way, we don’t need to worry about the exit, especially since I can take us out of this place whenever I want."
"Wait a minute! Have you also mastered the space element, young man? Otherwise, you wouldn’t be able to create the portal and the gate, right?" Yu Shan questioned him.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in response. "Elder Yu, I don’t have the space element, but the abilities of my other identity are closely related to the space element."

"Another identity?" Yu Shan’s eyes widened, and his jaw dropped open after Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his complete fox form with nine tails behind him. "Fox... fox beast... let alone a nine-tailed fox!"
Zhang Fei [5] returned to his human form directly. "My fox’s identity is the Heavenly Fox."
"A Heavenly Fox? Why have I never heard of that fox race before?" Yu Shan asked in confusion.

"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed. "The Heavenly Fox race only existed in the Three Mortal Realms before, so it’s natural that you’ve never heard of them. However, three of them have already ascended to this realm, and one of them is Zhang Fei. The other two are the two ancestors of that race, Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian."
"Speaking of Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian, do you know their whereabouts?" Zhang Fei [5] asked her.
Feng Yao nodded at him. "They should be in the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain, which was the home realm of all the fox race in the past."
"Didn’t that domain disappear long ago, Empress Huo?" Yu Shan asked.

"The Illusion Spirit Fox Domain never disappeared, and it was sealed by the ten-tailed fox to keep it safe from those evil beasts." Yu Shan naturally knew about the legend of the ten-tailed fox, but he did not have as profound knowledge as Feng Yao’s. "In fact, the heavenly fox race is the direct descendant of the ten-tailed fox, and Hu Tianliang created that fox race by splitting himself into two foxes, which are Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian."
"Even though I am a heavenly fox, I have no relationship with them." Zhang Fei [5] answered Yu Shan, who looked at him. "Do you know the location of the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain?"

Feng Yao nodded at him again. "I know, but you don’t need to think about them for now, and you’ll meet them when the time comes. For now, we’ll focus on exploring this place, and you might find something interesting here."
"So, where is our first destination?" Luo Yunxiao asked.

"There." Zhang Fei [5] pointed in one direction. "I’ve been wanting to go to the Temple of Forgotten Flame to check on some things, so we’ll go there first. However, there are dozens of demons there, so you guys have to be careful."
"Are those demons strong, husband?" Yan Jinwu asked.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "The weakest among them has reached the 1-Sun Celestial Lord, and the strongest has reached the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor. You don’t need to be afraid of them, but Huiqing must be careful of them."
"I’ll be careful." Sima Huiqing replied with a nod.
"Then—"
*Thud... Thud...*

All of them looked at Qing Qiu’er, who had just arrived with the disciples from the Moonlit Passion Temple. "At first, I wanted to take them to another area, but I sensed an unusual change in this place. Therefore, I brought them back and looked for you guys, and I think we should go together as we originally planned."
Unlike You Feiling and Su Yao, the other disciples looked at Zhang Fei [5], wondering about his relationship with their sect master.
’Since when did they have a relationship with each other?’ Yu Shan inwardly wondered as he looked at Zhang Fei [5] and Qing Qiu’er in turn.
*Thud... Thud...*

Feng Bingying and several female ice phoenixes landed in front of them. "We encountered some demons from the Heavenly Fiend Demon race, and we’ve already killed them, but there are still many more. Therefore, I brought them here to look for you, and we will go together."

"Since you guys have arrived, we will leave now, and our first destination is the Temple of Forgotten Flames." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly summoned the demon extermination sword, confusing them. "Here they come."

Dozens of demons appeared in the sky above them, and Zhang Fei could recognize their race, especially since their demon forms were identical to those of Oz the First and Oz the Second, who were of the Celestial Demon Race.
"The Celestial Demon Race." Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye frowned. "Let’s fight them."
"Their cultivation is only at the 1-Sun Celestial Lord, so there’s no need for us to make a move." Feng Yao turned to Zhang Fei [5]. "Show me your progress after two decades of seclusion."

Zhang Fei [5] said nothing and stepped forward, followed by the appearance of Jian Hei’an and Jian Guang’an, shocking Yu Shan, the members of the Moonlit Passion Temple, and those female ice phoenixes.

Seeing Zhang Fei [5]’s small figure, those demons looked down on and laughed contemptuously at him. One of them moved to attack him, but his movements slowed down and his body turned sluggish, especially after he activated demonic force manipulation.
Zhang Fei [5] casually floated in front of the demon, grabbed his head, and used his demon-absorbing ability. "Arghhhhh!"
Seeing their comrade in such pain, the other celestial demons moved to attack Zhang Fei [5]. However, a sword domain suddnly enveloped them. "Hei’an and Guang’an."
Both Jian Hei’an and Jian Guang’an made their moves, and the demons were sliced in half before they could use their abilities, causing their black blood to spray all around within the sword domain.
Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Shu Yan, Feng Bingying, and all their members were stunned and frightened by the brutal actions of the two female sword spirits.

Yu Shan took a deep breath after seeing the two female sword spirits wipe out dozens of celestial demons in the blink of an eye, but he was more curious about Zhang Fei [5]’s ability that caused the first demon to die withered. ’Isn’t that technique a heretic technique? Why did he use such a technique?’
Luo Fenghan and his family were also shocked by their abilities. ’A sword domain and two sword spirits is truly a deadly combination.’

Zhang Fei [5] deactivated his sword domain and returned the demon extermination sword to his body, and the female sword spirits disappeared from their sight. He then enveloped them with his aura, confusing them. "Let’s go to our first destination."

In a matter of seconds, they had arrived in front of the Temple of Forgotten Flame. Huo Ling immediately came out of Feng Yao’s body, surprising all of them, except for Zhang Fei [5] and his three wives.
"Do you miss your home, Ling’er?" Feng Yao softly asked.

The more he got to know Zhang Fei [5], the more speechless Yu Shan became, and he felt that he was much more mysterious than he had previously estimated.
Zhang Fei [5] then asked Feng Yao a question.
"You should be able to break the seal, right?"
"Do you need to ask a question you’re already sure of the answer to?" Feng Yao looked toward the seal again.
"I can easily break the seal, but I won’t do it now.
Moreover, you need those demons to improve yourself, so let’s let them come to us, and we’ll slaughter them."
"Yeah, you’re right." Zhang Fei [5] tried to open the portal to the training space, and the result was as he expected, as the portal opened.
He then opened the gate to one of the realms, and it also opened, meaning the seal was only sealing the portal out of that place.
"This way, we don’t need to worry about the exit, especially since I can take us out of this place whenever I want."
"Wait a minute!
Have you also mastered the space element, young man?
Otherwise, you wouldn’t be able to create the portal and the gate, right?" Yu Shan questioned him.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in response.
"Elder Yu, I don’t have the space element, but the abilities of my other identity are closely related to the space element."
"Another identity?" Yu Shan’s eyes widened, and his jaw dropped open after Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his complete fox form with nine tails behind him.
"Fox... fox beast... let alone a nine-tailed fox!"
Zhang Fei [5] returned to his human form directly.
"My fox’s identity is the Heavenly Fox."
"A Heavenly Fox?
Why have I never heard of that fox race before?" Yu Shan asked in confusion.
"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed.
"The Heavenly Fox race only existed in the Three Mortal Realms before, so it’s natural that you’ve never heard of them.
However, three of them have already ascended to this realm, and one of them is Zhang Fei.
The other two are the two ancestors of that race, Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian."
"Speaking of Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian, do you know their whereabouts?" Zhang Fei [5] asked her.
Feng Yao nodded at him.
"They should be in the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain, which was the home realm of all the fox race in the past."
"Didn’t that domain disappear long ago, Empress Huo?" Yu Shan asked.

"The Illusion Spirit Fox Domain never disappeared, and it was sealed by the ten-tailed fox to keep it safe from those evil beasts." Yu Shan naturally knew about the legend of the ten-tailed fox, but he did not have as profound knowledge as Feng Yao’s.
"In fact, the heavenly fox race is the direct descendant of the ten-tailed fox, and Hu Tianliang created that fox race by splitting himself into two foxes, which are Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian."
"Even though I am a heavenly fox, I have no relationship with them." Zhang Fei [5] answered Yu Shan, who looked at him.
"Do you know the location of the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain?"
Feng Yao nodded at him again.
"I know, but you don’t need to think about them for now, and you’ll meet them when the time comes.
For now, we’ll focus on exploring this place, and you might find something interesting here."
"So, where is our first destination?" Luo Yunxiao asked.
"There." Zhang Fei [5] pointed in one direction.
"I’ve been wanting to go to the Temple of Forgotten Flame to check on some things, so we’ll go there first.
However, there are dozens of demons there, so you guys have to be careful."
"Are those demons strong, husband?" Yan Jinwu asked.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"The weakest among them has reached the 1-Sun Celestial Lord, and the strongest has reached the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor.
You don’t need to be afraid of them, but Huiqing must be careful of them."
"I’ll be careful." Sima Huiqing replied with a nod.
"Then—"
*Thud...
Thud...*
All of them looked at Qing Qiu’er, who had just arrived with the disciples from the Moonlit Passion Temple.
"At first, I wanted to take them to another area, but I sensed an unusual change in this place.
Therefore, I brought them back and looked for you guys, and I think we should go together as we originally planned."
Unlike You Feiling and Su Yao, the other disciples looked at Zhang Fei [5], wondering about his relationship with their sect master.
’Since when did they have a relationship with each other?’ Yu Shan inwardly wondered as he looked at Zhang Fei [5] and Qing Qiu’er in turn.
*Thud...
Thud...*
Feng Bingying and several female ice phoenixes landed in front of them.
"We encountered some demons from the Heavenly Fiend Demon race, and we’ve already killed them, but there are still many more.
Therefore, I brought them here to look for you, and we will go together."
"Since you guys have arrived, we will leave now, and our first destination is the Temple of Forgotten Flames." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly summoned the demon extermination sword, confusing them.
"Here they come."

Dozens of demons appeared in the sky above them, and Zhang Fei could recognize their race, especially since their demon forms were identical to those of Oz the First and Oz the Second, who were of the Celestial Demon Race.
"The Celestial Demon Race." Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye frowned.
"Let’s fight them."
"Their cultivation is only at the 1-Sun Celestial Lord, so there’s no need for us to make a move." Feng Yao turned to Zhang Fei [5].
"Show me your progress after two decades of seclusion."

Zhang Fei [5] said nothing and stepped forward, followed by the appearance of Jian Hei’an and Jian Guang’an, shocking Yu Shan, the members of the Moonlit Passion Temple, and those female ice phoenixes.
Seeing Zhang Fei [5]’s small figure, those demons looked down on and laughed contemptuously at him.
One of them moved to attack him, but his movements slowed down and his body turned sluggish, especially after he activated demonic force manipulation.
Zhang Fei [5] casually floated in front of the demon, grabbed his head, and used his demon-absorbing ability.
"Arghhhhh!"
Seeing their comrade in such pain, the other celestial demons moved to attack Zhang Fei [5].
However, a sword domain suddnly enveloped them.
"Hei’an and Guang’an."
Both Jian Hei’an and Jian Guang’an made their moves, and the demons were sliced in half before they could use their abilities, causing their black blood to spray all around within the sword domain.
Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Shu Yan, Feng Bingying, and all their members were stunned and frightened by the brutal actions of the two female sword spirits.

Yu Shan took a deep breath after seeing the two female sword spirits wipe out dozens of celestial demons in the blink of an eye, but he was more curious about Zhang Fei [5]’s ability that caused the first demon to die withered. ’Isn’t that technique a heretic technique?
Why did he use such a technique?’
Luo Fenghan and his family were also shocked by their abilities. ’A sword domain and two sword spirits is truly a deadly combination.’
Zhang Fei [5] deactivated his sword domain and returned the demon extermination sword to his body, and the female sword spirits disappeared from their sight.
He then enveloped them with his aura, confusing them.
"Let’s go to our first destination."
In a matter of seconds, they had arrived in front of the Temple of Forgotten Flame.
Huo Ling immediately came out of Feng Yao’s body, surprising all of them, except for Zhang Fei [5] and his three wives.
"Do you miss your home, Ling’er?" Feng Yao softly asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1120: Temple Of The Forgotten Flame
paragraphs: From the outside, the Temple of Forgotten Flame looks like a massive, fortress-like structure built primarily from dark stone with sections reinforced by weathered golden plates.

The temple has a dark, heavy presence, with no ornamental carvings—its design focuses on durability and containment rather than beauty. The whole structure stood on a wide stone platform, isolated from the surrounding terrain, and was accessible only by a single, wide stairway leading up to the main doors.

Its multi-tiered and symmetrical shape resembles a stepped ziggurat with wide, rectangular terraces at each level. The walls were thick and smooth, with only narrow vertical slits that served as windows for ventilation and minimal light.

The main entrance was a tall rectangular gateway framed with dark metal and fitted with heavy golden doors. Several angular buttresses run along the sides for structural support, giving the temple a rigid, utilitarian silhouette. The roof sections of each tier were flat and edged with low parapets, and a dead flame symbol was located in the middle.

Although it looks like a multi-story building, the temple was constructed as a vertical descent rather than an outward complex, with stairs descending around the stone shaft to the bottom. It has five floors in total, starting with the main area of the temple, and the last floor was once the resting place of the Primordial Flame, better known as the Eternal Flame by cultivators in the current era.
"I’m home." Huo Ling muttered softly as she looked at the temple with a longing gaze.
Huo Ling’s words and Feng Yao’s question confused her with Luo Fenghan and the others, especially since they still didn’t know her true identity.
Huo Ling frowned as hundreds of demons suddenly appeared, surrounding them. She frowned deeper when some of them came out of the temple, carrying some golden metal on their shoulders.
Luo Fenghan and the others were prepared to face them, but Feng Yao stopped them directly. "Stay still! This is Ling’er’s business."
"But—"
"Listen to her, father-in-law." Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to Huo Ling. "We will not interfere in this matter."
Huo Ling walked toward the entrance, followed by the emergence of hot, deep red flames that enveloped her body. Her expression was extremely serious, and her eyes were filled with killing intent.

"How dare lowly and imbecile creatures like you set foot in my sacred home! Since you dare to destroy my home, you don’t need to leave, and I will bury you all here!" After saying that, hundreds of deep red flames shot out from Huo Ling’s body and attacked those demons, instantly incinerating them to ashes.
*Gulp*

Yu Shan, Luo Fenghan, and all the other witnesses swallowed their saliva. Some of those demons were quite powerful with their cultivation at the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor, yet one attack from Huo Ling reduced them to ashes.
Even Feng Tian and Feng Jiu, who had known and lived with Huo Ling for the past few years, were also shocked by her strength, especially since they had never seen her fight before.

Huo Ling did not move from her spot, and her deep red eyes looked in several directions. She shot other deep red flames in several directions, killing all the demons that were moving towards their location. She created a deep red flame sphere that enveloped the area from the temple to several miles away, preventing anyone from approaching.
"Master, let’s go." Huo Ling immediately ran up the stairway leading up to the main doors.
"Why are you all stunned?" Feng Yao and Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly followed Huo Ling without giving them any explanation.

Qing Qiu’er was the first to react. "Who exactly is that woman? I couldn’t sense her cultivation, and her attacks just now were simply powerful! Even if I used all my strength, I wouldn’t be able to kill those demons at once."

"Her flames were not ordinary flames, and they horrified me. Even if I used my ice element, her flames would definitely melt my ice," Feng Bingying spoke with a serious tone, followed by nods of agreement from the other female ice phoenixes.
Yu Shan turned to Luo Fenghan. "Have you met that woman before?"
"No." Luo Fenghan replied with a shake of his head. "I’ve met Feng Yao several times, but I’ve never met that woman."

"Huo Ling is a flame spirit." All of them turned to Bing Xingying directly. "This temple was the home of the Eternal Flame in the past, and since she said that this place was her home, I suspected that she was the flame itself."
"What?" All of them exclaimed in shock. "Are you sure Huo Ling is the Eternal Flame, Xingying?"

"Huo Ling is indeed the Eternal Flame." They all turned their gazes to Luo Yunxiao, who had already pulled Sima Huiqing and Yan Jinwu to catch up with their husband. "We should go in now, and you will learn her identity soon."
"Let’s follow them." Beiming Youhuang spoke as she led Hua Xiang’er to follow them, followed by Luo Fenghan and the others.

When they arrived inside, they could see that the floor was more like an entry hall. However, the place had been abandoned for a long time and was unkempt, especially after the appearance of the Eternal Flame, making it look very messy. Many parts of the temple walls were destroyed, and many small beasts made their nests in several areas.
Feng Yao walked behind Huo Ling and hugged her. "How long has it been since we last came to this place?"
"Several million years." Huo Ling leaned against her chest. "I miss this place so much, Master."
"I know." Feng Yai released Huo Ling from her embrace, took her hand, and led her down to the second floor below. "Let’s go there."
"Yeah."
Zhang Fei [5] followed them, but Luo Yunxiao suddenly hugged his arm. "Husband, look at them; they are more like lovers, right?"
"You’re right." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Feng Yao and Huo Ling with a faint smile on his face. Let’s follow them.
On the second floor, they saw many stone bookshelves lining the room, but they were no longer intact.

On the third floor, they saw a prayer room with many carvings around the walls. One of the carvings showed that all living creatures worship the flame, be they humans, beasts, natural races, or demons.
On the fourth floor, the area was more like a work and living area, with many stone tables and beds inside.
When they arrived at the ground floor, they were faced with a spacious room, with a large altar made of dark stones and golden metals, like the building of the temple.

Feng Yao promptly led Huo Ling to the altar. "The first time we met, you were still small, and your flame wasn’t as hot as it is now. Millions of years have passed since then, and you have become truly powerful. I thought—"

"No." Huo Ling rejected Feng Yao before jumping onto the altar, and she sat there with her eyes closed. "Master, I understand your wishes, but you must understand mine. This domain will recover once I reactivate this altar, but I won’t be able to leave again if I do that now. I still want to stay by your side and accompany you, so I won’t do it, and I will do it when the time comes."
"What do you mean by that, Huo Ling? What time are you waiting for?" Zhang Fei [5] asked as he approached them.

"You’re just an outsider, so it’s none of your business." As usual, Huo Ling responded coldly to Zhang Fei [5]. However, she did something unexpected by flicking a small flame at him, which immediately entered his body and burned his clothes.
[Ding]
[The host obtained the Eternal Flame. Fire count: 7.]
[The host’s fire strength has increased by 700%.]
"Oh, my god!" Feng Jiu hurriedly closed her eyes, as did Feng Xueying, Feng Jinqiu, Feng Bingying, and the other women.

Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Su Yao, and the female disciples of the Moonlit Passion kept their eyes open, and they stared at Zhang Fei [5]’s dick. They gulped hard upon seeing the large size of his sleeping dick.
Luo Fenghan, Luo Zhenyu, Luo Jiaxuan, Tian Shuixiang, Yu Shan, and the male disciples of the Moonlit Passion Temple felt jealous of Zhang Fei [5] because of it.
’She always acts as she pleases.’ Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly put on a change of clothes. "Why did you suddenly give a fragment of your flame to me?"

"No reason." Huo Ling then pulled Feng Yao onto the altar and boldly kissed her, stunning Feng Tian and the others. "My master is mine, and I will never hand her over to anyone, including you. If you dare to force her to be your wife, I will beat you to death."
"Pfft! Hahaha!" Luo Yunxiao laughed out loud. "Apparently, you have a tough competitor to get Big Sis Yao as your wife, husband."

"Isn’t that easy, Sister Yunxiao? Our husband only needs to take them as his wives, and—" Yan Jinwu stopped speaking and jumped away, especially since Huo Ling shot her flames at her, causing them to hit her previous spot.

"Shut your mouth, little golden crow." Huo Ling fiercely glared at her. "If you dare say something like that again, I’ll burn you alive. I am the Eternal Flame, and my flame surpasses your golden sun flame, so you better not doubt my words if you don’t want to die."

chapters.title: Chapter 1121: The Forbidden Land’s Natives
paragraphs: "Patriarch Fengyi! Something urgent happened!"
In the main ancient city of the Forbidden Land, a tall, thin young man shouted as he ran into a house made of the same material as the Temple of Forgotten Flame.

Inside the house, an old man with shoulder-length, deep red hair was observing every area of the Forbidden Land through several crystal balls floating in front of him. "What makes you so hasty like this, Xuanyuan Leizu?"
"Patriarch, something happened in the temple! You will be shocked after checking it out!" Xuanyuan Leizu answered breathlessly.

Xuanyuan Fenglei waved his hand directly, and the display in one of the crystal balls changed to the area in the temple. His expression changed as soon as he saw the deep red flame sphere that enveloped the area. "Could this really be happening?"

"Right? The deep red flame sphere should belong to the Eternal Flame, Patriarch! I’m sure the flame has returned there!" Xuanyuan Leizu shouted with excitement. "We previously saw hundreds of deep red flames shoot out from that area and incinerate all the demons that were roaming around there. After we saw that, I rushed back here to inform you. Brother Tong and Sister Yushi were waiting there, but no one could enter the sphere."
"Yes." Xuanyuan Fenglei nodded slightly. "Only the Eternal Flame could create that deep red flame sphere. Since the sphere covered that area of the temple, it indicates that the flame has returned."
Xuanyuan Leizu then asked. "What should we do now, Patriarch? I’m sure the other demons will flock to the temple soon, especially since the Eternal Flame killed hundreds of them in two attacks."

"We don’t need to worry about those demons." Xuanyuan Fenglei then faced him. "The cultivators of this era called the flame the Eternal Flame, but they were mistaken. The Eternal Flame’s true identity was the Primordial Flame, and it had existed since the Primordial Era. Even if ten demon gods came here to harass it, they would never be its match, and it would incinerate them like their subordinates."

As a native of the Forbidden Land, Xuanyuan Leizu naturally knew about it long ago. "Are we going to welcome the return of the Primordial Flame, Patriarch? Our ancestors always waited for it to return until the end of their lives, but it disappeared for several million years, which caused us and this domain to suffer for so long. However, it has returned to our domain, and this domain will awaken soon with its return."

"Of course, we will welcome the return of the Primordial Fire, but not now." Xuanyuan Fenglei pulled the crystal before him. "The flame has formed the sphere, indicating its aversion to disturbance. We will prepare a ceremony to welcome its return, and we will beg it to reactivate the altar, which will awaken our domain. Once our domain is awakened, our race, which has been in decline for millions of years, will also awaken and regain our true strength at that time."
"Do I need to inform the elders now?"

Xuayuan Fenglei nodded at him. "Go and tell them that the Primordial Flame has returned to our domain, but you must tell them that I forbid them from approaching the temple area. Otherwise, they will die if the flame feels disturbed by them. Also, order Xuanyuan Tong and Xuanyuan Yushi to return."
"Yes, Patriarch!" Xuanyuan Leizu immediately left the house as he contacted the two people, relaying their patriarch’s order to them.

Xuayuan Fenglei let out a soft breath before going to the side of one of the walls, which immediately opened itself, revealing stairs descending downwards. He quickly descended the stairs until he reached a room with a portal in the center, and then he vanished from that location after activating the portal.

A while later, Xuayuan Fenglei had arrived on top of a mountain filled with tall, dense trees. As he stepped closer, the trees moved aside by themselves, revealing a fairly wide path with a cave at the end .

Xuayuan Fenglei hurriedly entered the cave, the interior of which was spacious enough to accommodate hundreds, if not thousands, of people. Inside, three old men and three old women sat motionlessly, seemingly in deep meditation.
"What brings you here, Fenglei? Are those demons starting to attack our cities?" One of the old men asked without opening his eyes.

"Ancestor Zhuanxu, I didn’t come here because of those demons. Many of them are powerful indeed, but none of them can break through the ancient barriers that protect all our cities." Xuayuan Fenglei immediately took out the crystal balls. "Ancestors, please open your eyes and look at this; I believe you will all be overjoyed after seeing this information."

Hearing that, Xuanyuan Zhuanxu and the others stopped their cultivation before opening their eyes. Their expressions changed as soon as they saw the deep red flame sphere in the crystal ball, and they immediately realized that the Primordial Flame had returned to their domain. "Brothers and sisters, it appears that our millions of years of waiting since the era of our ancestors has finally come to an end today."
"That’s true." The others nodded in agreement with Xuanyuan Zhuanxu, while one of the old women directed a question to Xuanyuan Fenglei. "When did the Primordial Flame return to our domain?"

Xuanyuan Fenglei answered the old woman directly. "The portal opened not long ago, so the Primordial Flame only returned today, Ancestor Changyi. Previously, those demons invaded the temple, and they plundered the remaining materials there. But the Primordial Flame appeared out of nowhere, incinerated them, and then created the flame sphere."
"I see." Xuanyuan Changyi then asked the others. "Shall we go there and meet the Primordial Flame?"

"No." Another old woman rejected Xuanyuan Changyi’s idea immediately. However, it has returned to our domain, and this domain will awaken soon with its return."
