chapters.title: Chapter 1122: Searching For The Temple’s Secret
paragraphs: Tian Huangjin, who was leading her race members to look for Zhang Fei [5], immediately stopped as soon as Xuanyuan Zhuanxu appeared in front of them. She immediately cupped her hands at the old man. "Are you a native of this domain, Senior?"
"What is your purpose in coming to my domain this time?" Xuanyuan Zhuanxu looked at the people behind Tian Huangjin before asking her again. "Why did you bring so many troops?"

One of the winged race members wanted to speak to Xuanyuan Zhuanxu, but Tian Huangjin quickly stopped him. "Senior, Liang Huizhong contacted our leaders after he detected the movement of the demon races in this domain, and one of the elders of the Samsara Divine Sect disappeared along with several others around the temple. Therefore, my leader sent us here to investigate the reason behind the presence of those demons, and he also asked us to search for people from that sect."

"Those people are no longer in this domain, and the demons took them away long ago." Tian Huangjin and the others looked distrustful of Xuanyuan Zhuanxu. "It’s up to you whether you want to believe me or not, but I’ve told you the truth. After all, the portal to enter this domain is not only located in the Divine Samsara Sect, but there are several other portals out there, and those demons use one of them to get here. You guys can look for them if you like, but I hope you won’t cause chaos in my domain because of your enmity with those demons. If you do, I won’t hesitate to kill you all, whether they are from your race or those demons."

"Don’t worry, we only came here to search for those people, and we are not going to war with the demons." Tian Huangjin then asked him. "Do you know the whereabouts of the young man with several mythical beasts by his side, Senior?"
Xuanyuan Zhuanxu momentarily raised an eyebrow. "Do you know that young man?"

"His name is Zhang Fei, and I met him in the Three Mortal Realms years ago." Xuanyuan Zhuanxu wore a doubtful expression after Tian Huangjin said that, forcing her to create a Qi screen displaying their past meeting in order to convince him. "We actually wanted to explore this domain together, but the portal sent us to different locations. I sensed his presence in this area earlier, but he disappeared so quickly, and I lost track of him."

Xuanyuan Zhuanxu nodded in understanding and pointed towards the temple. "They’re in the Temple of Forgotten Flame now, but you won’t be able to get close there because the Eternal Flame has returned, and it’s created a barrier to prevent people from disturbing it."

"Huh?" Tian Huangjin and her race members were shocked when they heard that, and a young male winged race member immediately asked Xuanyuan Zhuanxu. "Has the Eternal Flame really returned to this domain, Senior? When did the flame return?"
"Today." Xuanyuan Zhuanxu looked away. "I have other business, so I’ll be leaving now."
"Wait—" The young male winged race member sighed in disappointment as Xuanyuan Zhuanxu hastily disappeared. "Hey, Huangjin, who exactly is Zhang Fei? Why are you so eager to meet him?"
"Is he your lover, Huangjin?" a young female winged race member asked Tian Huangjin separately. Her question caused the other female members to tease her too.

Tian Huangjin shook her head at them. "Zhang Fei and I are old friends, and he helped me hunt down Xereth in the past. In fact, that demon had fallen into his hands, and he sent him to the Star Tower. Since he’s in the temple, we should go there to meet him. However, I warn you not to speak carelessly in front of him, especially since there are many cultivators stronger than us by his side now."
"Let’s go."

Tianshi Shengjie, who was leading the beast race against some demons, raised an eyebrow when she felt someone’s gaze on her. She decided to use her full strength and kill those demons. She then looked up at the sky. "Senior, I know you’re hiding up there, so I hope you’ll come out and meet me. My name is Tianshi Shengjie, the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race."
Xuanyuan Shun decided to meet them. "I didn’t expect the Celestial Dragon Race to send their princess to my domain to hunt these demons."
"You’re wrong about that, Senior." Tianshi Shengjie explained the reason for their arrival in the Forbidden Land to him. "Do you have any information about them, Senior?"

Xuanyuan Shun nodded slightly. "There are several portals to enter this domain, and one of them is in the Ten Hells Monarch Domain. The demons used that portal to enter here, and they took those people away through it as well."

"So, those people have fallen into the hands of those demons, senior?" A young man with a tall, bulky, and muscular body asked. His appearance was quite intimidating to most people, but it wasn’t enough to intimidate an old monster like Xuanyuan Shun.

"The Faceless Demon Race, to be precise." Tianshi Shengjie and the others frowned after Xuanyuan Shun mentioned the demon race. "As I recall, the demon race possesses extraordinary disguise abilities, and only a few people can see through their disguises, one of whom is Long Wuzhao. If my guess is correct, they intend to use those people to infiltrate important locations, so you should inform your emperor of this matter."
Tianshi Shengjie turned to the young male dragon. "Long Youjia, use your void abilities to send a message to my godfather, and tell him to directly inform our emperor about this matter."
"Alright." Long Youjia immediately took out a device, whispered something in it, and sent it into the void. "The message will reach my father in a few hours."

"That’s good." Tianshi Shengjie then asked Xuanyuan Shun. "Senior, do you know the location of the group of a young man with several mythical beasts by his side? We were supposed to explore this domain together, but the portal separated us randomly."

"They went to the temple." Xuanyuan Shun immediately warned them. "The Eternal Flame has returned, and it has created a barrier there to prevent people from approaching. If you want to go there, I warn you not to look for trouble with it; otherwise, it will attack and roast you alive."
"When did the Eternal Flame return?"
"Today, and that young man seems to know the Eternal Flame." Even though she was quite familiar with Zhang Fei, Tianshi Shengjie was still surprised by it. "Remember, don’t disturb the flame."

After the old man disappeared, Long Youjia turned to Tianshi Shengjie and asked her a question. "Is Zhang Fei really that great, Shengjie? I heard from my father that our emperor praised him to the skies, and he looked forward to their meeting."

"Whether Zhang Fei is great or not depends on your judgment, so you can wait until we meet him, and then you can judge him for yourself." Tianshi Shengjie immediately flew towards the temple, followed by the other dragon races.
"Hmm?" Long Youjia thought about something for some time before catching up with them.

In other areas, the leaders of the nine demon races looked furious, especially after receiving reports of many of their members dying in the temple area. Some of them decided to investigate the area themselves.

In another area, members of the fairy race were busy fighting demons as they moved toward Zhang Fei [5]’s previous location. Not only the fairy race, but another group also moved toward Zhang Fei [5]’s previous location. This group was from the Jiao Clan, which had been targeting him for the past few days.

All groups of cultivators from the Empyrean Main Domain also tried to search for Zhang Fei [5]’s whereabouts while fighting the demons that blocked their way. The sect masters of the domain quickly led their members to look for him, but all his acquaintances who joined those sects decided to keep quiet.
"Why are you so intently observing this ruined statue, husband?"

Zhang Fei [5] turned to Luo Yunxiao and showed her the two map fragments. "Mengying and I obtained them both at the Star and Sun Towers, and this map points to this temple. I’ve been searching for a while, but I haven’t found anything unusual in this place."
"Have you asked them?" Luo Yunxiao turned to Feng Yao and Huo Ling, who looked so intimate on the altar.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "I asked them a long time ago, but they repeatedly said they never found anything here."
"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "Since you’ve searched every corner of this floor, I thought we could try searching upstairs, and I’ll help you look for it."
"Let’s go."
When they arrived beside the altar, Huo Ling spoke to them. "Hey! This temple is my home, so I know the whole area. I told you there’s nothing mysterious here, so you can stop looking for it."
"Don’t mind us and enjoy your time." Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly led Luo Yunxiao upstairs.
Huo Ling shook her head. "He’s too stubborn, Master."
"Just let him be, Ling’er." Feng Yao looked at her seriously. "Ling’er, I think you can use your flame fragment to reactivate this altar, and—"
"I said no!" Huo Ling snapped at Feng Yao, but she then hugged her. "I already said I’ll accompany you until the time comes, so please don’t force me, okay?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1123: Demons’ Arrival
paragraphs: On the B4 floor, Zhang Fei [5], assisted by Luo Yunxiao, Sima Huiqing, and Yan Jinwu, searched the entire area.
"Why are you four so busy?" Cheng Mengyao asked her question while she and Bing Xingying were coming down from the B3 floor.
Zhang Fei [5] turned to them and spoke to Bing Xingying. "Sister-in-law, please try using your void abilities to check the entire area of this temple; I’m sure there’s something hidden here."

"Alright." Bing Xingying closed her eyes, and her real body in the Void quickly moved towards their location, checking the area from inside the void. A while later, she informed Zhang Fei [5]. "Brother-in-law, I didn’t find anything hidden in this entire temple area, so I think your guess is wrong."

"That’s weird." Zhang Fei [5] looked at the two map fragments in his hand and thought that his guess was wrong. However, he firmly believed that the system would never give him useless items, as he got one of them from the quest reward. "Perhaps I should find the remaining four map fragments first and put them together to find out the truth."
"I think so." Luo Yunxiao nodded in agreement.
"But where should we find the remaining four?" Yan Jinwu asked him.

"Son." Zhang Fei [5] and the others turned to Luo Fenghan and Beiming Youhuang, who had just arrived. "The natives just spread the announcement that the mysterious merchant will appear in a week, and the auction will start three days later. If you want to look for those four map fragments, you might be able to search through both of them. However, you need the spirit merchant token to buy items from the mysterious merchant, and you can’t use someone else’s. As for the auction token, Youhuang and I have one, so you don’t need to think about that."
"Isn’t that merchant too strict, Senior Luo?" Sima Huiqing asked.

Luo Fenghan nodded at her. "To tell you the truth, no one knows the identity and origins of the mysterious merchant, and he comes and goes like a ghost. The Golden Dragon Emperor has tried to track him down, but he has never managed to find any information about him. Moreover, all the items sold by the mysterious merchant are truly unusual, and most of them don’t exist in this Paradise Realm, which makes us all think there are other realms besides this one."

"Other realms do exist." Luo Fenghan and the others looked at Zhang Fei [5] in shock, except for Bing Xingying. "Actually, I don’t have solid proof of their existence, but an acquaintance of mine once indicated it. Feng Yao also once let slip about other realms, but she wasn’t willing to reveal the truth to me. Besides, it was clear that there were two beings who didn’t live in this realm, and they lived in another realm."
"What two creatures do you mean?" Beiming Youhuang asked.

"The Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast. Without me having to explain them in detail, you should be able to guess what kind of beasts they are, right?" Beiming Youhuang nodded to Zhang Fei. "Even Taotie and the three evil mythical beasts feared them, and they chose to become subordinates of the Primordial Nihility Beast. The only beast that could match the two primordial beasts was the ten-tailed fox, but the old fox had long since died by sacrificing himself for something unclear, and he split himself into Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian."
Beiming Youhuang naturally knew about it. "The ten-tailed fox has been dead for a long time, but he has already chosen his successor, and you are the one."
"Eh?" Only Cheng Mengyao was surprised to hear that. "Are you really the successor of the ten-tailed fox, brother-in-law? Why can’t I feel any beast aura from you?"

Zhang Fei [5] immediately transformed into his half-fox form, with nine tails dancing behind him, making Cheng Mengyao’s eyes sparkle like stars. He hurriedly returned to his human form, causing her to purse her lips. "By the way, where are the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple?"
"They went to the area behind the temple to inspect it, especially since there are many other ruins behind there," Luo Fenghan answered him.

Luo Yunxiao smiled mischievously, ran to her father’s side, and hugged his arm. "Father, tell me the truth, have you ever had a relationship with Qing Qiu’er? Why were you stunned and acting awkward when you two met a few days ago?"
Hearing that, Cheng Mengyao and Bing Xingying also looked at their father-in-law, leaving Luo Fenghan smiling awkwardly.

Luo Fenghan released a soft sigh. "I don’t have any relationship with Qing Qiu’er, and I was already engaged to your mother when I first met her in the past. However, I was once affected by her abilities, which made me keep thinking about her for quite some time. Your mother became aware of this matter and went to the Moonlit Passion Temple to confront her, and they were engaged in a fierce battle for several days with no winner. Qiu’er eventually gave her the cure, but your mother hated her and her sect since then. That’s why she strictly forbade Zhang Fei from joining that sect, and she will be furious if he joins there."

"Hahaha!" Luo Yunxiao burst out laughing after Luo Fenghan finished explaining everything; even Cheng Mengyao and Bing Xingying couldn’t hold back their laughter. Then, she asked him another question. "Have you ever done anything with Qing Qiu’er, Father?"

"Your father is a loyal man, unlike your husband, okay?" Luo Fenghan glared at his daughter. "Qing Qiu’er’s abilities affected me, but I managed to resist their effects. I never did anything with her, and I only thought about her until I drank the antidote."

Beiming Youhuang decided to join their conversation. "Your mother was an overly jealous woman, and she was even jealous of me when we first met, remember? So, there’s no way your father would dare do anything with Qing Qiu’er, and your mother would beat him to death if he dared to do such things with her."

"Pfft! Hahaha." Luo Yunxiao, Cheng Mengyao, and Bing Xingying laughed after hearing that. "You are right, master. My mother is the most jealous and possessive woman regarding my father, and she will chase away any woman who dares to come close to him."

"Stop talking about your mother." Luo Yunxiao stuck out her tongue at Luo Fenghan, who immediately told Zhang Fei [5]. "If you want to get the merchant token, you just need to complete some tests from him, and he will give it to you as a reward."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately took out the golden token and the golden auction token that he obtained after completing the quest to open his shop in the Yun and Bai Kingdoms of the Nine Stars Realm, surprising Luo Fenghan and Beiming Youhuang. "Honestly, I got both of them a long time ago, but I didn’t expect to have the opportunity to use them soon. At first, I thought I would need hundreds or maybe thousands of years to be able to use both of them, but here I am now."
"Where did you get them?"
"The Star Tower, of course." Zhang Fei [5] immediately saved the two items and the two map fragments. "We’ll have some guests coming soon."
"Guests?"
"Those demons and some acquaintances." Zhang Fei [5] then led them to the first floor.
Feng Yao and Huo Ling, who were previously on the B5 floor, hurriedly followed them after they sensed the movement of those demons.
Shortly after they exited the temple, thousands of demons arrived in the air above them. The demons fiercely stared at them, but none of them dared to touch Huo Ling’s flame sphere.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Soon, many people from the winged and beast races also arrived outside the flame sphere. Huo Ling glanced at the two groups before opening her flame sphere slightly, allowing them to enter.
"What have you done to those demons? Why are they so eager to kill you all?" Tianshi Shengjie questioned Zhang Fei [5].

The people of the winged and beast races turned their attention to Zhang Fei [5], but some of them seemed to underestimate him because of his low cultivation, especially Long Youjia. ’Is he really the successor of the ten-tailed fox? I can feel the beast aura from his body, but it’s too faint.’

"Do you think I like to look for trouble with others? You were the one who deliberately pitted me against those natural races in the past, remember?" Tianshi Shengjie’s lips curled upwards as soon as Zhang Fei [5] brought up the matter. "These demons previously looted the remaining materials in this temple, so Huo Ling killed them all, and here they are now to avenge the deaths of their subordinates."
Tianshi Shengjie and Tian Huangjin turned to Huo Ling, who was standing indifferently. ’Is she really the Eternal Flame?’

"Zhang Fei." Feng Yao pointed at one of the demons. "That demon is a member of the Asura Demon Race, and that demon race is a war demon who possesses formidable combat abilities. Therefore, I want you to fight and defeat him, and we will take care of the rest."
Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye naturally recognized the members of their two races, but they were unable to recognize them thanks to their disguise.
Zhang Fei [5] looked at the male demon. "He’s stronger than me, but there’s no harm in trying to fight him."

chapters.title: Chapter 1124: Fighting The Demons
paragraphs: The demons, standing in the sky, burst out laughing after Zhang Fei [5] said that. The asura demon that Feng Yao had pointed out earlier sneered at him, with a mocking smile and a condescending gaze.

Long Youjia, who was standing in the back row, was also mocking Zhang Fei [5]. He felt that he was too arrogant with his cultivation still at the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm but wanted to fight a demon with cultivation at the 1-Sun Celestial King Realm. ’Hey! I want to see the abilities of the man highly praised by my emperor! If he couldn’t defeat that demon, then praise for him was too exaggerated!’

Tian Shuixiang walked to Zhang Fei [5]’s side and whispered to him. ’You must not delay fighting that demon, and you must kill him before he uses our Bloodline Awakening technique. Otherwise, you will have no chance of defeating him, and you will die.’

’Alright.’ Since Tian Shuixiang was an asura demon, Zhang Fei [5] didn’t underestimate his advice. He then summoned the demon extermination sword, which vibrated with excitement and couldn’t wait to kill the demon.
"Are you sure you can face that demon?" Tianshi Shengjie asked.
Zhang Fei [5] smiled at her. "If I can’t beat him, I’ll just have to run away, right?"

As soon as Zhang Fei [5] said that, Long Youjia and the members of the beast race immediately laughed and mocked him. He didn’t care about their reactions, but Tianshi Shengjie unleashed her killing intent, forcing them to shut their mouths.
The people of the winged races did not mock or insult Zhang Fei [5]; instead, they looked forward to witnessing his fighting abilities.

"You should summon your people who have broken through to the Five Celestial Realms." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Feng Yao directly. "They’ve worked hard for the past twenty years, so it’s time for them to prove the results of their training. Moreover, most of these demons are still in the Celestial Lord Realm, so they are perfect opponents for them. As for the demons who have reached the Celestial King and Celestial Emperor Realms, we will keep them away from your people."

Beiming Youhuang, Luo Fenghan, Tian Shuixiang, Ye Zhiye, Hua Xiang’er, Tian Huangjin, and Tianshi Shengjie nodded in agreement with Feng Yao. Unlike them, Yu Shan seemed confused by her request, especially since he didn’t really know Zhang Fei [5].
After considering his options, Zhang Fei [5] immediately summoned many beasts out of the beast space.

The dragons were Long Jishan, Long Qiang, and Long Jiuxiao. (A/N: In some past Chapters, I accidentally swapped names between Long Jiutian and Long Jiuxiao, but the correct one is Long Jiuxiao. Chapter 940.)
The phoenix was Feng Yanxi.
The white tigers were Dai Hubai and Dai Yishu.
The black tortoises were Wang Wugui and Wang Yitao.
The vermilion birds were Zhu Danqing and Zhu Zhen.
The nian beasts were Nu Shen and Nu Ying.
The mythical deer were Fu Xin and Fu Yin.
Lei Huoting was the qilin, and Yuwen Xingyuan was the kunpeng beast.

Additionally, Zhang Fei [5] summoned the three beasts from the Sealed World Pearl: Sha Huoyan, the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant. Shou Yunzhi, the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth, and Xiang Zhan, the Tusked War Elephant Tiger.
’What the fuck! How could he have so many mythical beasts by his side?’ Long Youjia and the members of the beast races screamed in their hearts.

Their surprises didn’t stop there, especially since Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the portal to the training space. The first to come out was Hong Xinxin, followed by Feng Qingmeng, Zhu Lingyao, Zhu Shanniang, Nu Qichen, Huli Haohao, Huli Xianniang, Huli Zhishen, and Feng Yichen.

’This brat is insane! He oversees so many beast races! Moreover, one of them is the dark phoenix, which no longer exists in this realm.’ Long Youjia and the members of the beast races inwardly screamed again.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5]’s human wives and acquaintances also walked out of it. Shangguan Yan, Duanmu Luolan, Leng Xueyan, Wei Xiaoya, Tantai Lingyan, Qian Shuang, Xi Yinying, Wang Yourou, Tian Yuanling, Shang Yumei, Shang Yaolin, and Shang Xinyu were the first to come out, followed by Lin Moxian, Xi Hongyan, Qiao Liangren, Wu Xueming, Shang Yingyue, Yan Yinqing, Jing Qiuyue, Xi Qiuwei, Mai Xiaomeng, Jin Ruyue, Du Yuanjia, Jian Wufeng, and You Xinglan.
The presence of all of Zhang Fei [5]’s wives caused Yu Shan, Beiming Youhuang, Hua Xiang’er, Long Youjia, and the others to be stunned for quite a while.
Even though their numbers were reaching thousands, the demons of all demon races were quite worried about their appearance, especially since most of them were mythical beasts.
"Demons, huh?" Lin Moxian looked at those demons.
"Do you want us to fight them, junior brother?"
"Hey, Yingyue! Our junior brother is your son-in-law now, remember?" Yan Yinqing spoke with a teasing tone, causing Shang Yingyue to sigh helplessly.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "I’ll fight that asura demon, and the others will take care of those who have reached the Celestial King Realm and Celestial Emperor Realm. Therefore, you guys don’t need to worry about them, and you can fight the rest."

"Let’s go then! We’ve been focused on training for the past two decades, so I want to fight them now." Xi Hongyan took out her whip, followed by the others, who also took out their respective weapons.
"Let us move first." Luo Fenghan and the others moved towards those demons, followed by Feng Yao behind them.

Huo Ling shot dozens of deep red flames at those demons, who had reached the Celestial King Realm and Celestial Emperor Realm, forcing them to move away from their respective forces. Once those demons had moved away, Zhang Fei [5] led his wives, slaves, and acquaintances to attack those demons.
Luo Zhenyu, Luo Jiaxuan, Cheng Mengyao, and Bing Xingying also joined them, even though their cultivation had already surpassed that of the demons.

Long Youjia, the members of the beast races, and the members of the winged races did not move from their spots. Instead, they watched the fight that was already taking place in the sky, especially the fight between Zhang Fei [5]’s people against those demons.

Although most of their cultivations were two minor stages below the demons, Long Youjia and the others could see that they were quickly taking control of the situation, giving them the upper hand over those demons.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] stood in front of the asura demon, who glared at him. The demon extermination sword in his hand continued to vibrate, and its vibrations grew stronger and stronger.

As Tian Shuixiang had advised earlier, Zhang Fei [5] immediately attacked the male asura demon, and he used his full speed in his attack. Unlike in the past, he did not use his enhanced condition or other strengthening techniques, and he solely relied on his raw speed.

Even so, the male asura demon was still confident of defeating Zhang Fei [5], especially since his cultivation was one major stage higher than his. He was also unperturbed by his speed, and he directly deflected the demon extermination sword with his own sword when he slashed it toward him.

"Hahaha." The male asura demon laughed. "Your courage and speed as a human are indeed impressive, but you are still not my match. I am an asura demon, and war is my life. Since you want to challenge me, I will gladly serve you in battle, but you will die today."
Zhang Fei [5] said nothing and activated both his light domain and sword domain, shocking the male asura demon, who immediately flew away to escape the range of his domains.

Seeing his enemy running away, Zhang Fei [5] immediately created the giant golden sword like the one he used when he broke into the Celestial Five Realms a few days ago. He directly slashed his demon extermination sword. "Final move: Sever the Heavenly Path!"
The giant golden sword glided toward the male asura demon at high speed. To Zhang Fei [5]’s surprise, the demon also launched his final move. "Asura Sword Annihilation!"
A giant crimson sword immediately emerged from the male asura demon’s sword, and it hurtled towards Zhang Fei [5]’s giant golden sword, causing both of them to collide in the air.
*Boom*
Both Zhang Fei [5] and the male asura demon were pushed back by the powerful shockwave that swept over them due to the explosive impact of both their techniques.
The shockwave also swept out in various directions, disrupting the battles around Zhang Fei [5] and the male asura demon.
Long Youjia and the others could also feel the impact, causing them to take a deep breath. ’Holy crap! A sword god in his early forties!’

With his light element already covering his sword, Zhang Fei [5] teleported behind the demon and slashed his sword toward his back. However, the male asura demon immediately spun around and countered his attack, causing both of them to be pushed back by each other’s attacks.

Zhang Fei [5] did not waste time and moved toward the male asura demon again, and he used his Clone Illusion Steps, which had reached level ten, to create ten illusions that also moved toward the demon.

The male asura demon’s eyes suddenly glowed red, and he easily dodged all of Zhang Fei [5] and his ten illusions’ attacks. "Is this the only limit of your abilities, puny human? If your abilities are this limited, I’m disappointed."

How could he have so many mythical beasts by his side?’ Long Youjia and the members of the beast races screamed in their hearts.
Their surprises didn’t stop there, especially since Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the portal to the training space.
The first to come out was Hong Xinxin, followed by Feng Qingmeng, Zhu Lingyao, Zhu Shanniang, Nu Qichen, Huli Haohao, Huli Xianniang, Huli Zhishen, and Feng Yichen.
’This brat is insane!
He oversees so many beast races!
Moreover, one of them is the dark phoenix, which no longer exists in this realm.’ Long Youjia and the members of the beast races inwardly screamed again.
Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5]’s human wives and acquaintances also walked out of it.

Shangguan Yan, Duanmu Luolan, Leng Xueyan, Wei Xiaoya, Tantai Lingyan, Qian Shuang, Xi Yinying, Wang Yourou, Tian Yuanling, Shang Yumei, Shang Yaolin, and Shang Xinyu were the first to come out, followed by Lin Moxian, Xi Hongyan, Qiao Liangren, Wu Xueming, Shang Yingyue, Yan Yinqing, Jing Qiuyue, Xi Qiuwei, Mai Xiaomeng, Jin Ruyue, Du Yuanjia, Jian Wufeng, and You Xinglan.
The presence of all of Zhang Fei [5]’s wives caused Yu Shan, Beiming Youhuang, Hua Xiang’er, Long Youjia, and the others to be stunned for quite a while.
Even though their numbers were reaching thousands, the demons of all demon races were quite worried about their appearance, especially since most of them were mythical beasts.
"Demons, huh?" Lin Moxian looked at those demons.
"Do you want us to fight them, junior brother?"
"Hey, Yingyue!
Our junior brother is your son-in-law now, remember?" Yan Yinqing spoke with a teasing tone, causing Shang Yingyue to sigh helplessly.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them.
"I’ll fight that asura demon, and the others will take care of those who have reached the Celestial King Realm and Celestial Emperor Realm.
Therefore, you guys don’t need to worry about them, and you can fight the rest."
"Let’s go then!
We’ve been focused on training for the past two decades, so I want to fight them now." Xi Hongyan took out her whip, followed by the others, who also took out their respective weapons.
"Let us move first." Luo Fenghan and the others moved towards those demons, followed by Feng Yao behind them.
Huo Ling shot dozens of deep red flames at those demons, who had reached the Celestial King Realm and Celestial Emperor Realm, forcing them to move away from their respective forces.
Once those demons had moved away, Zhang Fei [5] led his wives, slaves, and acquaintances to attack those demons.
Luo Zhenyu, Luo Jiaxuan, Cheng Mengyao, and Bing Xingying also joined them, even though their cultivation had already surpassed that of the demons.
Long Youjia, the members of the beast races, and the members of the winged races did not move from their spots.
Instead, they watched the fight that was already taking place in the sky, especially the fight between Zhang Fei [5]’s people against those demons.

Although most of their cultivations were two minor stages below the demons, Long Youjia and the others could see that they were quickly taking control of the situation, giving them the upper hand over those demons.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] stood in front of the asura demon, who glared at him.
The demon extermination sword in his hand continued to vibrate, and its vibrations grew stronger and stronger.
As Tian Shuixiang had advised earlier, Zhang Fei [5] immediately attacked the male asura demon, and he used his full speed in his attack.
Unlike in the past, he did not use his enhanced condition or other strengthening techniques, and he solely relied on his raw speed.
Even so, the male asura demon was still confident of defeating Zhang Fei [5], especially since his cultivation was one major stage higher than his.
He was also unperturbed by his speed, and he directly deflected the demon extermination sword with his own sword when he slashed it toward him.
"Hahaha." The male asura demon laughed.
"Your courage and speed as a human are indeed impressive, but you are still not my match.
I am an asura demon, and war is my life.
Since you want to challenge me, I will gladly serve you in battle, but you will die today."
Zhang Fei [5] said nothing and activated both his light domain and sword domain, shocking the male asura demon, who immediately flew away to escape the range of his domains.
Seeing his enemy running away, Zhang Fei [5] immediately created the giant golden sword like the one he used when he broke into the Celestial Five Realms a few days ago.
He directly slashed his demon extermination sword.
"Final move: Sever the Heavenly Path!"
The giant golden sword glided toward the male asura demon at high speed.
To Zhang Fei [5]’s surprise, the demon also launched his final move.
"Asura Sword Annihilation!"
A giant crimson sword immediately emerged from the male asura demon’s sword, and it hurtled towards Zhang Fei [5]’s giant golden sword, causing both of them to collide in the air.
*Boom*
Both Zhang Fei [5] and the male asura demon were pushed back by the powerful shockwave that swept over them due to the explosive impact of both their techniques.
The shockwave also swept out in various directions, disrupting the battles around Zhang Fei [5] and the male asura demon.
Long Youjia and the others could also feel the impact, causing them to take a deep breath. ’Holy crap!
A sword god in his early forties!’
With his light element already covering his sword, Zhang Fei [5] teleported behind the demon and slashed his sword toward his back.
However, the male asura demon immediately spun around and countered his attack, causing both of them to be pushed back by each other’s attacks.

Zhang Fei [5] did not waste time and moved toward the male asura demon again, and he used his Clone Illusion Steps, which had reached level ten, to create ten illusions that also moved toward the demon.
The male asura demon’s eyes suddenly glowed red, and he easily dodged all of Zhang Fei [5] and his ten illusions’ attacks.
"Is this the only limit of your abilities, puny human?
If your abilities are this limited, I’m disappointed."

chapters.title: Chapter 1125: Killing The Demons
paragraphs: After saying that, the demon released his domain, which was red like blood, dispelling Zhang Fei [5]’s two domains.
Zhang Fei [5] flew away from the demon. "Your demon eyes’ ability is to read the enemy’s movements, right?"
The demon admitted his guess straight away. "As long as I have my eye ability, your speed is useless before me."
"Have you ever thought that being too proud of your skills could cost your life?" Zhang Fei [5] raised his right hand. A light, female figure appeared behind him.

The appearance of the female figure shocked the members of the winged race, especially since her appearance completely resembled theirs. After all, Zhang Fei [5] created it based on Jiang Yinghua’s figure, who was also a winged race.
Zhang Fei [5] summoned Jian Hei’an and Jian Guang’an out of the demon extermination sword, causing the demon to raise his vigilance. "Exorcismus!"
The demon looked up into the sky as soon as a large halo appeared above him, and it immediately shone brightly, blinding the vision of all the demons in the area.
"Shit!" The demon closed his eyes and flew away, but countless light rays shot out from the large halo and chased after him.
The demon used his instinct to deflect those light rays, but Zhang Fei [5] hastily teleported behind him and used his lust domain before activating the fourth and fifth effects.

The demon was shocked as soon as Zhang Fei [5]’s domain absorbed his Qi and demon power, transferring both into his body. ’What the hell is going on? Why are my Qi and demon power leaving my body and flowing into his?’
Zhang Fei [5] didn’t give the male asura demon time to react, activated his sword domain again, and ordered the two female sword spirits to attack him.

"Arghhh!" The demon screamed loudly as soon as Jian Hei’an and Jian Guang’an attacked him with powerful and swift slashes using their sword qi. Simultaneously, the light rays penetrated his body, swiftly drenching it in his black blood.
Zhang Fei [5] launched the light, female figure towards the demon and pierced through the male asura demon’s body directly, worsening his injuries.

’Shit! I have no other choice but to use that technique, or I will die in his hands.’ The demon thought as he flew away as fast as possible. He tried to open his eyes, but the light halo was still shining brightly, dazzling his eyes.

Zhang Fei [5], who realized the demon’s plan, immediately threw four talismans at him. The four talismans spread out in different directions and formed a transparent pyramid that sealed his demon power.

’Shit! This bastard is also an array master, and this array is a high-level one!’ Not only was the demon shocked by that, but Long Youjia and the spectators of their fight were also shocked by Zhang Fei [5]’s formation array.
The demon suddenly felt a chill down his spine, and he forced his eyes open despite that dazzling light. He vaguely saw Zhang Fei [5] already taking a sword stance and slashing his sword at him.
"Last move! Ashen Bloom!" After Zhang Fei [5] said that, a flurry of petals made of sword intent bloomed from nothing and destroyed everything in its path as it shot towards the demon.
"Crap! I underestimated him too much." The male demon said his last words before his body disintegrated.

Zhang Fei [5] exhaled softly after killing the demon, and he asked the two sword spirits to return into the demon extermination sword. "Fortunately, the demon underestimated me from the start; otherwise, I wouldn’t have won against him. If he succeeded in activating his technique, I would be the one who died at his hands."

Zhang Fei [5] suddenly sensed a powerful aura lock onto him, and he turned towards Long Youjia, who was flying towards him. However, Huo Ling intercepted the void dragon and knocked him back, and a small flame sphere trapped him directly.
"Do you know who I am?" Long Youjia asked Huo Ling threateningly.

"Even if Long Xukong and Long Wuzhao were here now, they wouldn’t dare act arrogantly in front of me, yet a little weakling dragon like you dares to threaten me." Huo Ling spoke as she looked condescendingly at Long Youjia. She then strangled his neck and burned it, causing him to scream in pain. The members of the Beast Race wanted to move to stop her, but she shot a few flames at them, forcing them to stop in their tracks. "Even if I kill you now, your void dragon race will never dare to hold me responsible. So, if you don’t want to die, you should shut your lowly mouth."

"Hah... Hah..." Long Youjia breathed heavily after Huo Ling let go of him, but she still confined him within her flame sphere. ’Fuck! Who is this fucking bitch, really? How dare she challenge my void dragon race?’

Zhang Fei [5] smiled as he listened to Huo Ling say all that, but he immediately turned his attention to his wives and acquaintances who were facing the other demons. They had succeeded in killing many demons in the Celestial Lord Realm, especially Luo Yunxiao, who overpowered them with her Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique.

Luo Fenghan, Beiming Youhuang, Yu Shan, Qing Qiu’er, and the others also succeeded in killing many demons. The number of demons who had reached the Celestial King and Celestial Emperor Realms had decreased significantly compared to before.

Zhang Fei [5] then took a sword stance once again, but he did not create the golden sword like before. Instead, he placed his sword beside his waist, and his gaze focused on the demons in the Celestial Lord Realm.

"All of you move now!" Hearing Zhang Fei [5]’s shout, all his wives and acquaintances immediately moved away from the demons. Thereafter, he directly slashed his sword horizontally. "First move: Severing Slash! Third move: Dust Slash!"

A large, dense sword Qi quickly cut through the air, followed by a hidden attack that instantly sliced through all the demons in its path, causing a lot of black blood to gush out and rain down on the ground below.
Lin Moxian and the others shook their heads at the sight. "Junior brother, you wanted us to fight them, but you ended up killing them all instead."
"Show off!" Yan Yinqing shouted to Zhang Fei [5].

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at their response. "Try spreading your senses in several directions. There are still hundreds of thousands of demons from the nine demon races in this domain, so you guys still have plenty of opportunities to fight them."
All of them spread their senses according to Zhang Fei [5]’s instructions, discovering countless demons roaming around several areas of that domain.

Zhang Fei [5] then warned them. "However, all of you must be careful in hunting those demons, especially since the strength of fifty of them far surpasses all of you. I’m sure they will continue to come to our location, so we don’t need to go far to hunt them, and we just need to wait for them to arrive."
"That’s good."
A while later, Luo Fenghan and the other senior cultivators had already killed the demons who were their opponents, causing considerable losses to the nine demon races.

Feng Yao immediately floated to Zhang Fei [5]’s side. "Your fight with the asura demon earlier wasn’t bad, and I was quite satisfied with your abilities, but you still wasted time dealing with your enemy. I’ve been following your progress for a long time, and I know you should have been able to kill him early in the fight. Not all of your enemies are as arrogant as that demon, and they won’t waste time killing you. Therefore, you must act more efficiently in dealing with them; otherwise, you will be the one to die first. Do you understand?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded to her. "Since the mysterious merchant will only appear in a week, we will stay here while waiting for those demons to come to us."
Feng Yao nodded in agreement before looking at Huo Ling. "Ling’er, please free that little dragon."
Huo Ling didn’t say anything and directly retracted her ability, which allowed Long Youjia to be freed from her flame sphere.

Tianshi Shengjie immediately landed beside him and healed the burn wound on his neck. "I warned you not to act rashly, but you didn’t listen to me. Do you know the identities of those two women? Not even our emperor can defeat them, let alone juniors like us."
"Who are they?" Long Youjia asked, looking at Feng Yao and Huo Ling in turn.

"The woman by Zhang Fei [5]’s side is the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling." The eyes of Long Youjia, the members of the beast race, and the members of the winged races immediately widened as soon as Tian Huangjin mentioned that name. Her next words shocked them further. "The woman who did this to you just now is the Eternal Flame."
Feng Yao simply smiled at their reaction, and she landed in front of Huo Ling, who immediately pulled her into the temple.
Zhang Fei [5] paid no attention to them and led all his wives, slaves, and acquaintances after the two women.
Tian Huangjin and Tianshi Shengjie could only shake their heads at the reactions of the members of their races, and they led them to go to the area behind the temple to avoid Huo Ling and Feng Yao.

chapters.title: Chapter 1126: Become An Elder
paragraphs: Up in the sky, the three senior women of the Xuanyuan Clan kept staring at the Temple of the Forgotten Flame. "Did you two hear what that female winged race said just now?"

The other two nodded to Xuanyuan Changyi before Xuanyuan Qian spoke. "I didn’t expect that female phoenix to be the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling, and she clearly has a deep relationship with the Eternal Flame."

"Somehow, I feel like their relationship has been going on for a long time; otherwise, they wouldn’t be so close." Xuanyuan Changyi and Xuanyuan Qian looked at Xuanyuan Wuyue. "If you two recall, Empress Huo Yanling’s past title was the Spirit Flame Empress, and her mastery of the fire element surpassed all cultivators. I’m sure that the Eternal Flame has been by her side for a long time, and it helped her obtain her title."
Xuanyuan Changyi and Xuanyuan Qian pondered some past events, which convinced them that Feng Yao and Huo Ling had indeed been together for a long time. "Should we meet them?"

"No." Xuanyuan Wuyue refused with a shake of her head. "The Eternal Flame should have already noticed our presence, but it won’t allow us to enter. Therefore, we should not disturb them and wait for the right time to meet him. By the way, I’m more curious about Zhang Fei [5], especially his swordsmanship."

"Me too." Xuanyuan Changyi nodded. "Our Xuanyuan Clan is the best in the sword path, and no other cultivator can match us in it. However, the sword technique and domain that Zhang Fei [5] used before show that he is a god-rank swordmaster, and he has also perfectly comprehended the sword dao, which is difficult for cultivators at his age to achieve."

Xuanyuan Qian nodded in agreement. "It took us hundreds of years to fully understand the sword dao, but he was able to do it in less than forty years, which is truly amazing. Moreover, he has so many mythical beasts under his command, and all the humans on his side are strong, despite their cultivation still being in the Celestial Lord Realms. The most important thing is that he belongs to the righteous path, or this realm will face a terrifying scourge if he belongs to the heretic path."

"Since he wants to wait for the merchant to appear, I’m sure he also wants to attend the auction. This way, we’ll meet him later, and we can talk to him then." After that, the three women left the area and returned to monitoring the movements of the demons from the nine races, as they were sure that they would move soon, especially after many of their members died in a short time.
After he gave some instructions to his close people, Zhang Fei [5] went to the roof of the temple, which was more like a rooftop, to check some things.
However, Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling followed him there. "Do you want to join our sect?"

Zhang Fei [5] turned to them. "I was indeed planning to go to your domain after returning from this domain, and I had planned to join your sect to look for you, mainly because of the Forbidden Lotus Codex. However, I didn’t expect you to appear here, and I already had quite a few ideas about that technique. As for the Lotus Limbo World, I would never help you to enter there."
"Why is that? Why are you so obedient to Empress Huo?" Qing Qiu’er asked with a frown.

Zhang Fei [5] released a soft sigh. "You might think I’m too obedient to Feng Yao, but I know her quite well. Moreover, you already know her past identity as Empress Huo Yanling, so you should know that she is not an ordinary cultivator. She knows more things than other cultivators, but I won’t explain it to you in detail. Since she has strictly prohibited you from entering the Lotus Limbo World, I will never take you there. If you force yourself to go there, no one will be able to help you leave that place, and you will become one of those wandering souls."

Qing Qiu’er shivered at the thought. Although she was eager to see the Lotus Limbo World, she was not a stupid woman, especially with her knowledge of Empress Huo Yanling’s abilities; not even Luong Wuzhao could defeat her in the past.
"Are you going to send your people back?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head before answering. "They have cultivated and trained diligently to reach their current level over the past two decades, but cultivation and training will be useless without actual combat experience. They are not that weak even though their cultivation is still at the Celestial Lord Realm, so I will let them stay in the domain for now, and they will take care of the demons that will come here."

"Although my cultivation is significantly higher than theirs, I lack confidence in my ability to fight them without using cultivation, much less to defeat them." Qing Qiu’er then took out a token and gave it to him. "With your abilities, our tests will be useless to you. Since you have decided to join our sect, I give this token to you. However, you will not be joining us as a disciple, and I want you to become an elder in our sect."

Zhang Fei [5] was a little surprised by Qing Qiu’er’s decision, but You Feiling immediately spoke to him. "Even though I’m not a swordmaster, I’m sure you’re a god-rank swordmaster, right? The formation array you used to fight the asura demon earlier wasn’t a low-grade or middle-grade array, but a high-grade one, which can exclusively be used by a rank 10 array master. With such abilities, it’s useless for you to be a disciple in our sect, and the position of an elder is the most appropriate for you."
"Why do you two want me to be an elder?" Zhang Fei [5] curiously asked.

Qing Qiu’er released a soft sigh before explaining. "Zhang Fei, our sect is a dual cultivation sect, but Feling and I don’t want our sect to continue to be as stagnant as it is now, and we want our sect to become one of the best in this realm. To make that happen, we believe we can’t just rely on dual cultivation, and we have to learn many new things. However, we don’t have knowledge in other fields, and we can’t possibly recruit people from various fields to join us, especially since most of them hate dual cultivators like us. Since you are an expert in several fields and have decided to join our sect, we hope you are willing to help us improve it."

[Isn’t that a good choice, Master? You want to find a suitable place to establish your own power in this realm, and the Moonlit Passion Temple is quite powerful, even though it’s still not as powerful as the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary. If you join that sect and take these two women as your partners, their sect will automatically become yours, and you can use it as a base for the demon fox group.]
"How many elders and disciples are in your sect?"

"There are ten female and five male elders in total. However, our male elders don’t have significant influence, and all decisions in our sect rest with me and Feiling." Zhang Fei [5] was not surprised by Qing Qiu’er’s answer, especially since Feng Yao had already told him about the latter. "If you are willing to accept our offer, we will give you the freedom to make the decision, and we will follow your decision."
"Alright, I agree." Zhang Fei [5]’s decision made broad smiles spread across the faces of Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling.

[Quest: Upgrade your sect.]
[Reward: Sect Gift Pack x1 was sent to the inventory.]
’Additional quest, huh?’ Zhang Fei [5] then read the third notification. ’Upgrade my sect? I just joined the sect, but the system gave me such a quest straight away.’
"What should we do to improve our sect?"

Zhang Fei [5] pondered several ideas for a while. "I want you to contact all your elders, and you can order them to prepare several places, such as the medical hall, blacksmith hall, alchemy hall, sword hall, and array hall. Dual cultivators without other advantages will never be useful, and I want your sect to change completely from a dual cultivation sect to a universal sect."
"Alchemy, blacksmithing, and medical?" Both Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling were confused by that.

Zhang Fei [5] took out his alchemy token. "As you guys can see, I am a god-rank alchemist. Even though I don’t have my blacksmith token yet, I am actually a supreme-rank blacksmith. As for the medical field, I have several people with good healing abilities, and I will bring them to join our sect. They will help us teach disciples who are interested in it, and our sect will truly become a universal sect ."
Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling were stunned to the point of being speechless for a while, making Zhang Fei [5] smile in amusement.

sentences.text: Up in the sky, the three senior women of the Xuanyuan Clan kept staring at the Temple of the Forgotten Flame.
"Did you two hear what that female winged race said just now?"
The other two nodded to Xuanyuan Changyi before Xuanyuan Qian spoke.
"I didn’t expect that female phoenix to be the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling, and she clearly has a deep relationship with the Eternal Flame."
"Somehow, I feel like their relationship has been going on for a long time; otherwise, they wouldn’t be so close." Xuanyuan Changyi and Xuanyuan Qian looked at Xuanyuan Wuyue.
"If you two recall, Empress Huo Yanling’s past title was the Spirit Flame Empress, and her mastery of the fire element surpassed all cultivators.
I’m sure that the Eternal Flame has been by her side for a long time, and it helped her obtain her title."
Xuanyuan Changyi and Xuanyuan Qian pondered some past events, which convinced them that Feng Yao and Huo Ling had indeed been together for a long time.
"Should we meet them?"
"No." Xuanyuan Wuyue refused with a shake of her head.
"The Eternal Flame should have already noticed our presence, but it won’t allow us to enter.
Therefore, we should not disturb them and wait for the right time to meet him.
By the way, I’m more curious about Zhang Fei [5], especially his swordsmanship."
"Me too." Xuanyuan Changyi nodded.
"Our Xuanyuan Clan is the best in the sword path, and no other cultivator can match us in it.

However, the sword technique and domain that Zhang Fei [5] used before show that he is a god-rank swordmaster, and he has also perfectly comprehended the sword dao, which is difficult for cultivators at his age to achieve."
Xuanyuan Qian nodded in agreement.
"It took us hundreds of years to fully understand the sword dao, but he was able to do it in less than forty years, which is truly amazing.
Moreover, he has so many mythical beasts under his command, and all the humans on his side are strong, despite their cultivation still being in the Celestial Lord Realms.
The most important thing is that he belongs to the righteous path, or this realm will face a terrifying scourge if he belongs to the heretic path."
"Since he wants to wait for the merchant to appear, I’m sure he also wants to attend the auction.

This way, we’ll meet him later, and we can talk to him then." After that, the three women left the area and returned to monitoring the movements of the demons from the nine races, as they were sure that they would move soon, especially after many of their members died in a short time.
After he gave some instructions to his close people, Zhang Fei [5] went to the roof of the temple, which was more like a rooftop, to check some things.
However, Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling followed him there.
"Do you want to join our sect?"
Zhang Fei [5] turned to them.
"I was indeed planning to go to your domain after returning from this domain, and I had planned to join your sect to look for you, mainly because of the Forbidden Lotus Codex.
However, I didn’t expect you to appear here, and I already had quite a few ideas about that technique.
As for the Lotus Limbo World, I would never help you to enter there."
"Why is that?
Why are you so obedient to Empress Huo?" Qing Qiu’er asked with a frown.
Zhang Fei [5] released a soft sigh.
"You might think I’m too obedient to Feng Yao, but I know her quite well.
Moreover, you already know her past identity as Empress Huo Yanling, so you should know that she is not an ordinary cultivator.
She knows more things than other cultivators, but I won’t explain it to you in detail.
Since she has strictly prohibited you from entering the Lotus Limbo World, I will never take you there.
If you force yourself to go there, no one will be able to help you leave that place, and you will become one of those wandering souls."
Qing Qiu’er shivered at the thought.
Although she was eager to see the Lotus Limbo World, she was not a stupid woman, especially with her knowledge of Empress Huo Yanling’s abilities; not even Luong Wuzhao could defeat her in the past.
"Are you going to send your people back?"
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head before answering.
"They have cultivated and trained diligently to reach their current level over the past two decades, but cultivation and training will be useless without actual combat experience.
They are not that weak even though their cultivation is still at the Celestial Lord Realm, so I will let them stay in the domain for now, and they will take care of the demons that will come here."

"Although my cultivation is significantly higher than theirs, I lack confidence in my ability to fight them without using cultivation, much less to defeat them." Qing Qiu’er then took out a token and gave it to him.
"With your abilities, our tests will be useless to you.
Since you have decided to join our sect, I give this token to you.
However, you will not be joining us as a disciple, and I want you to become an elder in our sect."
Zhang Fei [5] was a little surprised by Qing Qiu’er’s decision, but You Feiling immediately spoke to him.
"Even though I’m not a swordmaster, I’m sure you’re a god-rank swordmaster, right?
The formation array you used to fight the asura demon earlier wasn’t a low-grade or middle-grade array, but a high-grade one, which can exclusively be used by a rank 10 array master.
With such abilities, it’s useless for you to be a disciple in our sect, and the position of an elder is the most appropriate for you."
"Why do you two want me to be an elder?" Zhang Fei [5] curiously asked.
Qing Qiu’er released a soft sigh before explaining.
"Zhang Fei, our sect is a dual cultivation sect, but Feling and I don’t want our sect to continue to be as stagnant as it is now, and we want our sect to become one of the best in this realm.
To make that happen, we believe we can’t just rely on dual cultivation, and we have to learn many new things.
However, we don’t have knowledge in other fields, and we can’t possibly recruit people from various fields to join us, especially since most of them hate dual cultivators like us.
Since you are an expert in several fields and have decided to join our sect, we hope you are willing to help us improve it."
[Isn’t that a good choice, Master?
You want to find a suitable place to establish your own power in this realm, and the Moonlit Passion Temple is quite powerful, even though it’s still not as powerful as the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.
If you join that sect and take these two women as your partners, their sect will automatically become yours, and you can use it as a base for the demon fox group.]
"How many elders and disciples are in your sect?"
"There are ten female and five male elders in total.

However, our male elders don’t have significant influence, and all decisions in our sect rest with me and Feiling." Zhang Fei [5] was not surprised by Qing Qiu’er’s answer, especially since Feng Yao had already told him about the latter.
"If you are willing to accept our offer, we will give you the freedom to make the decision, and we will follow your decision."
"Alright, I agree." Zhang Fei [5]’s decision made broad smiles spread across the faces of Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling.

chapters.title: Chapter 1127: Future Plans
paragraphs: "Why do you want to build one?" Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling asked in confusion, especially since such a group would only bring trouble for them. Moreover, countless cultivators already dislike them, mainly because of their sect’s status as a dual cultivation sect.

"Are you two afraid we’ll get in trouble?" Both women nodded at Zhang Fei [5]. "Isn’t the Hidden Moon Sect also a den of assassins? If other cultivators didn’t bother with them and used their services to handle the tasks that they couldn’t accomplish themselves, then we should be able to do the same, right? We just need to follow their pattern by investigating our target’s background first, and we will refuse any incoming killing tasks if our targets are innocent. This way, I believe other cultivators won’t bother us either, and they might use our services."
"Why are you eager to form an assassin group?"

"Actually, I already have an assassin group founded by one of my wives, and we have thousands of members." Zhang Fei [5]’s revelation surprised both women. "My group’s name is the Demon Fox, and they are spread throughout the Three Mortal Realms. Once I have settled in this realm, I will bring them over. However, they must enter seclusion to increase their strength first, and I will deploy them in this realm once they are fully prepared. Furthermore, we cannot develop a sect without adequate cultivation resources, right? Assassination tasks should give us a lot of income, and we can use it to buy those resources."

"That’s true." Qing Qiu’er then spoke. "I’ve heard that the fees for hiring assassins from the Hidden Moon Sect cost a lot of fortune, depending on their target. The cheapest is 50 million purple jewels, and the most expensive is 100 million golden jewels."

"Building a reputation isn’t easy, and our group couldn’t become popular overnight. Moreover, the Hidden Moon Sect isn’t the only sect with an assassin group, and there are many others spread across various domains." You Feiling spoke skeptically.

"Can you reach your current level overnight?" You Feiling’s lips twitched in response to Zhang Fei’s question. "See? Nothing is easy in this life, and we have to keep working hard to achieve our goals. For now, we shouldn’t think too much about the assassin group, especially since we still have many preparations to make to change our sect’s image from a dual cultivation sect to a universal sect. Contact those elders now and instruct them to prepare all that."

Qing Qiu’er took out her communication device and contacted the elders of their sect, while You Feiling asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Why did you name your group the demon fox group? If we use that name, people will think that we are a demon group, and they might attack us."

"People who attack others just because of a name are the stupidest people. Moreover, we are cultivators; we should be able to distinguish between humans and demons, and we should not carelessly kill other people." Zhang Fei [5] then touched You Feiling’s forehead, sharing images of his two other forms with her, shocking her. "Qiu’er has known about my three identities since we first met, and others won’t be able to tell me apart if I don’t use my other two forms."

You Feiling’s eyes moved up and down, seriously observing Zhang Fei [5]. However, she couldn’t sense any beast or demon auras from him, which proved that he was truly an ordinary human. His three identities perplexed her, especially since she had never met a human with three different entities. Even though beasts could transform into humans, their beast auras would still be detectable by others, but she couldn’t sense anything from him.
*Tap... Tap...*

You Feiling looked at three women, who were walking side by side towards them. Zhang Fei [5] introduced them to her. "Xi Hongyan is my senior brother’s wife, and Xi Qiuwei is her aunt. Meanwhile, Yinying is one of my wives, and their clan is an assassin clan."
"Oh?" You Feiling was momentarily surprised.
"Are you thinking about establishing another assassin group?" Xi Hongyan asked him.

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] explained to them about his status as an elder of the Moonlit Passion Temple, and he also explained to them about his future plans, including the assassin group. "What do you guys think about this matter?"

Xi Yinying answered him directly. "Husband, I have no problem with that, but you must discuss this matter with Sister Hua and the Wen Twins first, especially since the three of them are the ones who always take care of your assassin group."
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] then looked at Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei. "What about you two?"
"Does that mean you will bring our Xi Clan members to this realm in the future?" Xi Qiuwei asked him instead.
Xi Hongyan also spoke to him. "If you are willing to bring our Xi Clan members to this realm, I will help you with the new group."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed softly. "Naturally, I will bring them to this realm, but I won’t be doing it anytime soon. I want to settle here while I investigate the situation in the other domains first."

Both women agreed with that, but then Xi Hongyan spoke to him. "Since you already planned all that, I think it would be better if we joined the sect too. However, I will discuss this with my husband first, especially since he has already thought of several ideas for us."

"Oh! That’s right! Senior Brother Moxian and his Lin Clan are puppeteers, and so are Miao Miao and her Miao Clan." Zhang Fei [5] then looked at Qing Qiu’er, who had just finished speaking with the elders via a long-distance communication device. "What do you think about the puppeteer?"

Qing Qiu’er informed him directly. "In fact, puppeteers are quite rare in this realm, but there are several clans that practice it in other domains. If you have some puppeteers on your side, we might be able to enlist their help in establishing our own puppeteer group."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately contacted Lin Moxian and Miao Miao, asking them to meet them on the rooftop. As soon as they arrived there, he immediately told them his plan, surprising them a bit.
Lin Moxian answered him first. "Junior brother, if you want to move my Lin Clan to this realm, you should first discuss this matter with my aunt. If she agrees, our members will definitely agree."

"As for my Miao Clan, I’m not sure they will agree to move to this realm because they are already too comfortable with their life in the Red Sun Realm, and they have no desire to start a new life." Miao Miao’s answer did not surprise Zhang Fei [5] and the others, especially since everyone had their own choices. "However, I can contact some of them, and I believe they will be willing to move here if I persuade them."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding and opened the gate to the Red Sun Realm. "Go to your clan now, and my clone will meet you there."
"Alright." Miao Miao immediately disappeared into the gate.
Lin Moxian then asked him, "What about the Soul Hall? Are you going to ask our master to join that sect?"

"I’ve sent a voice transmission to our master, but he is busy fighting the demons in that area." Zhang Fei [5] pointed northeast. "Your aunt and the others are also there along with their respective sect members. If our master is not willing to join us, I will hand over the Soul Hall to Senior Sister Quuyue and the others. As for the blacksmith hall, I will ask Tie Xuan to lead it, and Shi Xi will help him."
"Shi Xi’s ability in blacksmithing has already surpassed Tie Xuan, so I think she is more suitable to lead the blacksmith hall, right?" Lin Moxian asked.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "Shi Xi’s abilities have indeed surpassed Tie Xuan’s now, but he’s more experienced as a leader, so I’ll hand over the blacksmith hall to him."
"What about the alchemy hall? Are you going to lead it yourself?" You Feiling asked.

"If Senior Jingxia agrees to join us, she will take charge of the alchemy hall. If she is unwilling and chooses to stay at the Star Cloud Pavilion, I will ask one of my wives to lead it." Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling wore curious looks, especially since they had not yet met all of Zhang Fei [5]’s wives. "Feng Qingmeng and Feng Yanxi are expert alchemists, and their abilities have advanced greatly in the past two decades. Apart from them, I have several alchemist wives who have reached god-rank."

Xi Yinying then spoke. "Sister Yunxiao and the others’ abilities in alchemy are not inferior to our husband’s, and they are already used to concocting superior-grade pills. As long as they work together, your sect will never lack a supply of pills, and other sects will probably be jealous of us."
"Then—"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] abruptly looked toward the distance. "Those beasts finally appeared."
"What kind of beasts are you referring to?"

"The beasts of the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain." Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling’s expressions also turned serious after Zhang Fei [5] said that. "I don’t have clear information about the purpose of those beasts and demons invading this domain, but the presence of those evil beasts doesn’t bode well, and they might cause big trouble soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 1128: Evil Beast Races
paragraphs: "How did you manage to check such a distance? If I recall correctly, the third portal should be 5,000 miles to the southwest."

Zhang Fei [5] didn’t answer Qing Qiu’er; instead, he took out the Demon Eye’s orb and flew it southwest at full speed. Along the way, he used the orb to monitor the other areas, and he saw all those groups of cultivators fighting with those demons, with many of them dying at the hands of those heretics.

Zhang Fei [5] contacted Hun Di and all his acquaintances, who had joined the sects of the Empyrean Main Domain, instructing them to stay away from the southwest area and go to his location as soon as possible.
Zhang Fei [5] took out the memory extractor and activated it immediately, drawing the attention of Qing Qiu’er and the others to the screen that appeared in front of them.

Feng Yao and Huo Ling suddenly appeared on both sides of Zhang Fei [5] and looked at the screen before frowning. "The situation in this domain has become even more chaotic with the appearance of those nine half-step demon gods, especially since their cultivation has already reached the 1-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm."

"Those demons are indeed troublesome, but those evil beasts in the southwest are more dangerous." After Zhang Fei [5] said that, Feng Yao and Huo Ling scanned the area with their senses. "What do you two think about those beasts?"
"I can kill them in a second." Huo Ling was the first to answer.

Feng Yao seriously observed the beasts. "Taotie and the others didn’t hold back in sending their strongest subordinates, and many of them were mythical-rank beasts with cultivation at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm."
"Do they have subordinates with cultivation at the Celestial God Realm?" Zhang Fei [5] asked as he checked the data about those evil beasts.

Feng Yao shook her head at Zhang Fei [5]. "Not many cultivators from all races have reached that stage, so I’m sure they don’t have subordinates at that stage. However, the cultivation of Taotie, Taowu, Qiong Qi, and Hundun has reached that stage."
"What do you think was their real reason for invading this domain with such enormous force? Are there many valuable treasures here?" Zhang Fei [5] asked her again.

Feng Yao considered several options first. "As I told you back then, this domain is much older than all the domains in this realm. There are many treasures buried in this domain, relics of the ancients. However, they wouldn’t send massive armies just to search for those treasures; instead, they’re targeting the mysterious merchant."
"The mysterious merchant?" Zhang Fei [5] and the others looked at Feng Yao in surprise.

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled at their reactions. "The mysterious merchant is simply too mysterious, and his strength is beyond their league. Back then, Taotie and the others attacked him, and he defeated them with just one move. Long Wuzhao is powerful, but he wouldn’t be able to defeat them with one move, so you should already know how strong he is."
