chapters.title: Chapter 1129: Three Dragons
paragraphs: The Eternal Spring Oasis is a lush, verdant area located deep in a barren desert. The oasis is fed by an underground spring that never runs dry, regardless of season or climate. The water is clear, slightly warm, and rich in celestial Qi. Surrounding the central pond are tall palm-like trees, medicinal herbs, and fruit-bearing plants that grow in abundance. The air here is fresh and slightly humid, a stark contrast to the harsh environment outside. Small spiritual beasts and birds often gather here, making it both a natural resource hub and a strategic resting place for travelers. However, its constant abundance attracts unwanted attention from wandering cultivators.
"This place is gorgeous, despite its location in such an unremarkable area." Feng Yao nodded in agreement to Zhang Fei [5], who then pointed at the oasis. "I detected several things from the bottom."
Feng Yao used her senses to examine the bottom, where she found several types of valuable materials. "Water Heart Alloy, Deep Spring Copper, Rippling Water Silver, and many other precious materials."
"All of them are rare forging materials," Zhang Fei [5] muttered with a look of excitement. "Do you think those evil beasts are targeting this place because of those materials?"

"I’m not sure, but I won’t let them get these materials." Feng Yao then took out a talisman and threw it directly above the oasis, causing a thick mist to cover the entire area from outside to inside. "You can enter this domain through your gate whenever you want, right?"
"Yes."

Feng Yao nodded slightly. "If that’s the case, we should go back now, and my talisman will prevent them from coming in here. When the situation calms down, you can come back here to get these materials."

A while later, they returned to the temple, and they saw many other human cultivators starting to arrive. However, Huo Ling wouldn’t let them in, especially since most of them had no connection to Zhang Fei [5].

The ancestors of the Fan, Ru, Zhi, Chen, Qin, and Jiang main clans of the Empyrean Main Domain immediately recognized Zhang Fei [5]. They wanted to talk to him, but Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing went ahead of them.
"Hahaha! We meet again, young man." Gong Wei spoke as he laughed.
Lu Shaqing then asked. "Are they your entourage?"

"We meet again, Senior Gong." Zhang Fei [5] then answered Lu Shaqing. "Only a few of them are my acquaintances, Senior Lu. As for the members of my entourage, they are inside the temple right now, including my father-in-law. The two of you can go in there if you want to meet him, but the disciples of your two sects can’t go there."
"Who created this barrier?" Gong Wei asked.

"Her." Zhang Fei [5] pointed to Huo Ling, who was sitting leisurely on the rooftop, watching the people outside her flame barrier. Some of them tried to break in, but their strength was simply too weak compared to hers, preventing them from doing so. "Don’t approach or disturb her, or she’ll beat you both up."

Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing looked at Huo Ling, but a cold and murderous gaze greeted them, causing their necks to shrink. "We want to meet Sect Master Luo, but the situation doesn’t seem possible, so we’ll wait here."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded to them and then turned his attention to the people from the Empyrean Main Domain, who were staring at him in shock and confusion due to his current cultivation level. After all, they were present at his wedding with Luo Yunxiao, and his cultivation was still at the 1-Moon Divine Expansion at that time, but he had already broken through to the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm now.

Zhang Fei [5] was not interested in them, but the presence of a group of women in black sparked his interest. He knew that they were members of the Hidden Moon Sect, mainly because of the smell of blood on their bodies. However, he had no intention of meeting them, and he immediately went into the temple.

The people from the Empyrean Main Domain were quite annoyed that Zhang Fei [5] didn’t greet them, but they didn’t say anything because they could feel Huo Ling’s cold gaze. Fan Ning then asked Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing. "Do you two know that kid?"

"Senior Fan, we don’t really know him, and we’ve only met him once when he broke through to the Five Celestial Realms in the Moon Illusion Domain a few days ago." Lu Shaqing was the first to answer him.
Gong Wei then told him. "Senior Fan, his breakthrough is truly terrifying and breathtaking, and he summoned lightning of nine different colors."
"Nine different colors?" Fan Ning, Ru Yan, Zhi Yuan, Chen Qi, Qin Wuzhang, and Jiang Yuhei were shocked to hear that, especially since all the cultivators only knew lightning had seven colors.
Gong Wei touched their foreheads in turn and shared his memories of Zhang Fei’s breakthrough. "You guys can see for yourselves."
While they were watching Gong Wei’s memories, a woman dressed in black approached him. "Please share it with me too, Sect Master Gong."

The woman has a smooth face, fair skin, and straight black hair tied in a high ponytail. Her eyes were narrow, with subtle makeup emphasizing their shape. Her lips were full and lightly tinted. Her figure was tall and curvy, with a narrow waist and pronounced hips. Her breasts were large and accentuated by a form-fitting black leather outfit, featuring a deep neckline and a high slit on one side, revealing much of her thigh.
"Hahaha." Gong Wei laughed at her request. "It’s rare for you to feel attracted to a man, Vice Sect Master Yin Chang."

"You’re wrong about that; I have no interest in him." Yin Chang shook her head to deny it. "You guys are too focused on his age and cultivation, but I’m different from you, and I can smell the strong scent of blood from his body, indicating that he has killed countless people in the past. Otherwise, the heavens wouldn’t be eager to kill him, right?"
Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing nodded in agreement with that, and he shared his memories with Yun Chang, who immediately closed her eyes and watched everything.
Before long, Yin Chang opened his eyes. "Thank you, Sect Master Gong."

Yin Chang immediately returned to her group without saying anything else, which made Gong Wei laugh wryly at her demeanor. He and Lu Shaqing immediately left the people from the Empyrean Main Domain and returned to the members of their two sects.

In the Divine Samsara Sect, Liang Huizhong was standing with three other men. The first man looked very young, appearing more like a teenage boy with waist-length golden hair and golden eyes. The second man had a stark contrast with his shoulder-length gray hair, and his eyes were also gray; he was wearing a simple black outfit.
Meanwhile, the third man has long white hair, and he has a youthful appearance, like the first man. He wore a simple, plain white outfit.
"Is it true that demons from the nine races are in there, Golden Dragon Emperor?"

Long Wuzhao nodded to Liang Huizhong. "Previously, Tianshi Shengjie asked Long Youjia to send a message to Brother Xukong, and he informed us that the nine demon races were inside there. According to them, the mastermind behind this seal was the Celestial Demon Race, but they had not received definite information about the purpose of the demons."
"What are we going to do now? Are you going to destroy this barrier? If those demons attack them, there will definitely be many casualties."
"Why should we bother destroying it?" Long Wuzhao looked at Long Xukong. "Bring us there."
"Alright." Long Xukong sliced through the air, but nothing happened. "How is this possible? Why can’t I open the void leading inside?"
Long Wuzhao frowned before touching the portal. "Apparently, those demons have reinforced the seal after your son sent a message to you, and they added a new seal to prevent us from entering."
"Shall we go to the other portals, Brother Wuzhao?" The white-haired man asked.
Long Wuzhao nodded at him. "I have a bad feeling about this event, so we have to go to the other portals, Tianshi Bailong."
Long Wuzhao first handed a device to Liang Huizhong, and he immediately left with the other two afterward. "Has Empress Huo Yanling truly returned, Brother Wuzhao?"
"Are you impatient to spar with her again, Bailong?" Long Wuzhao asked back.

"Hahaha." Tianshi Bailong laughed at that. "Empress Huo is the only cultivator who can keep me bedridden for half a year. Although I’ve always feared her strength, I always look forward to sparring with her again."

"Not only you, but I also want to spar with her again," Long Xukong spoke with a burning gaze. "Even though I was the void dragon, she rendered my void abilities useless, as if she had better control of the void element than I did. Unfortunately, she suddenly decided to reincarnate, and I’ve always wondered about the reason behind her decision."

Long Wuzhao shook his head. "I myself couldn’t understand her decision back then, but I’ve gotten some clues about it. If my guess is correct, she did it to find the heir of the ten-tailed fox, and she’s managed to find him."
"Zhang Fei."
"That’s right." Long Wuzhao turned towards the Divine Samsara Sect behind them. "That kid should be in the Forbidden Land now, and we will meet him soon."

According to them, the mastermind behind this seal was the Celestial Demon Race, but they had not received definite information about the purpose of the demons."
"What are we going to do now?
Are you going to destroy this barrier?
If those demons attack them, there will definitely be many casualties."
"Why should we bother destroying it?" Long Wuzhao looked at Long Xukong.
"Bring us there."
"Alright." Long Xukong sliced through the air, but nothing happened.
"How is this possible?
Why can’t I open the void leading inside?"
Long Wuzhao frowned before touching the portal.
"Apparently, those demons have reinforced the seal after your son sent a message to you, and they added a new seal to prevent us from entering."
"Shall we go to the other portals, Brother Wuzhao?" The white-haired man asked.
Long Wuzhao nodded at him.
"I have a bad feeling about this event, so we have to go to the other portals, Tianshi Bailong."
Long Wuzhao first handed a device to Liang Huizhong, and he immediately left with the other two afterward.
"Has Empress Huo Yanling truly returned, Brother Wuzhao?"
"Are you impatient to spar with her again, Bailong?" Long Wuzhao asked back.
"Hahaha." Tianshi Bailong laughed at that.
"Empress Huo is the only cultivator who can keep me bedridden for half a year.
Although I’ve always feared her strength, I always look forward to sparring with her again."
"Not only you, but I also want to spar with her again," Long Xukong spoke with a burning gaze.
"Even though I was the void dragon, she rendered my void abilities useless, as if she had better control of the void element than I did.
Unfortunately, she suddenly decided to reincarnate, and I’ve always wondered about the reason behind her decision."
Long Wuzhao shook his head.
"I myself couldn’t understand her decision back then, but I’ve gotten some clues about it.
If my guess is correct, she did it to find the heir of the ten-tailed fox, and she’s managed to find him."
"Zhang Fei."
"That’s right." Long Wuzhao turned towards the Divine Samsara Sect behind them.
"That kid should be in the Forbidden Land now, and we will meet him soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 1130: A Week Later
paragraphs: In one area of the Forbidden Land filled with dense forests, representatives of the nine demon races discussed the situation they were facing, especially the deaths of their subordinates in the area of the Temple of the Forgotten Flame.
They decided to contact their respective leaders, especially after the arrival of those evil beasts, who had the same interests as them.

Their leaders ordered them to avoid the evil beasts and focus on targeting other beasts, humans, and natural races. They also told them they would send additional reinforcement to assist them, which relieved them, especially since their numbers had decreased significantly.

The three female ancestors of the Xuanyuan Clan eavesdropped on their conversation, but they couldn’t care less about the fate of the cultivators from outside. They didn’t make any moves, especially since the demons had not targeted the native races of their domain.

The three male ancestors of the Xuanyuan Clan monitored the movements of the evil beasts, and they summoned ancestors from the other clans to leave their seclusion and help them deal with those beasts.

Although the Forbidden Land was vast, the domain did not have many clans because many clans chose to move to other domains after the Eternal Flame disappeared. There were only five main clans and a few minor clans, with the strongest being the Xuanyuan Clan, followed by the Zhao, Dongfang, Huang, and Gongsun Clans.

After receiving the summons from Xuanyuan Zhuanxu, the ancestors of the four clans left their seclusion and spread out to several areas, especially since those evil mythical beasts divided their subordinates into several groups.

They did not confront the evil mythical beasts leading their groups directly, especially since they were quite powerful. Instead, they moved to kill their subordinates who tried to harass the inhabitants of their domain, causing their numbers to gradually decrease.
The beasts and natural races noticed the humans moving towards the temple and decided to follow them there, especially since the demons continued to hunt them.

The vice sect master of the Divine Samsara Sect had arrived at the temple area with his disciples, but like most cultivators, they were unable to approach the temple due to Huo Ling’s flame sphere enveloping the area. He begged her to let them enter the area, but she did not dare and threatened to attack them if he insisted on going inside, forcing him to stop.

At midnight, many beasts and natural races arrived at the Temple of the Forgotten Flame area. Unlike those human cultivators, Huo Ling allowed them to enter the temple area in accordance with Feng Yao’s orders, except for the fairy race members.
Although Huo Ling allowed them to take shelter behind her flame sphere, she did not allow anyone to enter the temple, and she created another flame sphere to stop those who wanted to enter.

Inside the temple, Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling introduced Zhang Fei [5] to the disciples of the Moonlit Passion Temple, and their decision to appoint him as an elder of their sect greatly surprised them. After all, he was still young, and his cultivation was still below most of theirs.

Su Yao was most surprised by Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling’s decision, but her mind was opened once they told her and the others that Zhang Fei [5] was a god-rank alchemist, a supreme-rank blacksmith, a rank 10 array master, and a god-rank swordmaster.

To prove his status, Zhang Fei [5] showed them his ability in alchemy by performing a live alchemy show, and he concocted several superior-grade pills before their eyes. He also demonstrated his abilities in formation arrays by creating several high-grade talismans, especially for attack and defense.
Additionally, Zhang Fei [5] sparred with the strongest among them without using cultivation. Although he didn’t defeat that person, it was enough to prove his combat abilities.

Luo Fenghan, Beiming Youhuang, and Yu Shan could only shake their heads after they learned of Zhang Fei [5]’s decision to become an elder of the Moonlit Passion Temple. However, they were surprised by his decision to change the sect’s purpose from a dual cultivation sect to a universal sect, and he even wanted to build several new halls to implement his idea.

After he had considered everything, Zhang Fei [5] decided to meet the representatives of the Nine Sword Hall, the Azure Immortal Peak, the Hidden Moon Sect, the Star Cloud Pavilion, and the Eternal Heaven Sect. He informed them that he wanted all his acquaintances who had previously joined them to join the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Naturally, the leaders of those sects were reluctant to lose talented cultivators such as Hun Di, Lin Jingxia, Gong Ren, and several others so easily. They demanded compensation from Zhang Fei [5], but Luo Fenghan and Yu Shan immediately mediated for them.

In the end, Zhang Fei [5] decided to provide them with several batches of his pills, but he only gave them his basic and common pills. They objected to that and demanded better pills, forcing Feng Yao to intervene.
Once Feng Yao revealed her past identity as Empress Huo Yanling, all the sect leaders shut their mouths and accepted Zhang Fei [5]’s offer.
After they finished discussing, Huo Ling chased them out of her temple, and her identity as the Eternal Flame caused them to cower in fear.

Since the ancestors of the main clans Fan, Ru, Zhi, Chen, Qin, and Jiang from the Empyrean Main Domain insisted on speaking with him, Zhang Fei [5] decided to meet with them. However, he declined their wish to cooperate with him directly; instead, he asked them to cooperate with Luo Fenghan and the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, especially since they were his family.

Outside, Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, and Tianshi Bailong had already arrived at the location of another portal leading to the Forbidden Land, but it was also sealed from the inside. "What should we do now? Are we going to force our way through this seal?"

"We have no other choice, right?" Long Xukong replied to Tianshi Bailong with a helpless sigh, but an item suddenly shot out of the void. He immediately caught it and listened to the message inside, which surprised him. "Brother Wuzhao, my son just sent me another message, and he said that we don’t need to worry about them because Empress Huo Yanling is inside with Zhang Fei [5]. Additionally, the Eternal Flame has returned, and it turned out to be in her hands all this time."
Long Wuzhao nodded in understanding. "No wonder my golden flames never had any effect on Empress Huo in the past; it turns out she had obtained the Eternal Flame a long time ago."
"Doesn’t that mean her past identity as Empress Huo Yanling is not her true identity, Brother Wuzhao?"

"Yes." Long Wuzhao nodded to them. "The Eternal Flame disappeared several million years ago, which turned that place into the Forbidden Land. Empress Huo Yanling wasn’t that old in the past, so I’m sure that she was reincarnated before, and she was the one who took the flame in the past."
Long Xukong then spoke. "If that’s true, Empress Huo Yanling is a reincarnation of one of the ancients, especially since the Eternal Flame disappeared in the ancient era."

"You’re right, Bailong. Since Empress Huo Yanling and the Eternal Flame are in there, we no longer need to force our way in. We have to go back now before they notice our arrival, and we’ll leave everything to the two of them." Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong immediately followed Long Wuzhao away.
Day after day passed, and seven days had passed in the Paradise Realm.
[Daily quest I: Absorb 10,000,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1000 purple jewels.]
[Daily Quest II: Absorb 10,000,000 demon essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade demon cores.]
[Daily Quest III: Absorb 10,000,000 beast essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade beast cores.]
[Daily Quest IV: Killing 1000 beasts/demon beasts in the Celestial Lord or above.]
[Reward: Celestial daily pack x1]

During the past seven days, Zhang Fei [5] and his closest people joined other cultivators to face those demons and evil beasts, but he didn’t use all his abilities, mainly because some of them were clearly targeting him, such as the fairy race and the Jiao Clan.

Powerful demons and evil beasts were faced by senior cultivators such as Feng Yao, Luo Fenghan, Beiming Youhuang, Yu Shan, Gong Wei, Li Shaqing, and others. This way, Zhang Fei [5] and his people could face enemies that matched their level without fear of their attacks.

"Husband, those people have been monitoring you for the past week. They have been trying to find an opening to attack you, but Huo Ling has repeatedly stopped them." Luo Yunxiao spoke as she glanced at the Jiao Clan entourage.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly to her, but he was more focused on the members of the fairy race, especially since they seemed to be starting to suspect him even though he hadn’t used his beast or demon abilities in the past week. "Those fairies seem to be starting to realize my identity, and the Fairy King will find out about my presence in this realm soon."
"Are you thinking about killing them, husband?" Yan Jinwu asked.
"They are stronger than me, okay?" Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in reply. "For now, I will think of another solution regarding them, and I will move after everything is finished."
*Thud*
Feng Yao landed beside them and pointed at the sky. "The mysterious merchant will appear soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 1131: Mysterious Merchant
paragraphs: "Here he comes."

The sky above the Forbidden Land split in two, and a tunnel of light descended from it, followed by a powerful pressure that pressed down on everyone present. Those beasts and demons experienced the most significant impact, including Zhang Fei [5].
Feng Yao moved to protect Zhang Fei [5] and all the beasts on their side, especially since they were too overwhelmed to withstand the pressure.

The first thing that appeared was the head of a dragon mixed with a deer, and its two horns were more similar to deer antlers than dragon horns. The size of its head is enormous; its two dragon eyes are a hundred times bigger than a ball, and it has a long neck like a serpent covered in white scales.
"What kind of beast is that?" Zhang Fei asked Feng Yao, especially since the system could not detect its status.
Feng Yao smirked faintly. "That beast is the one and only Ancient Leiyu Tianlu, which is a mixed breed of the Ancient Celestial Dragon and the Longevity Deer."

"A mixed breed of the Ancient Celestial Dragon and the Longevity Deer?" Tianshi Shengjie was shocked to hear that, especially since she herself was a celestial dragon. "Why have I never heard of the latter?"
Feng Yao shook her head slightly. "As I said before, the mysterious merchant belong to the ancients. They no longer live in this Paradise Realm, and they live in the realm above it."

"A realm above this realm?" Most of the cultivators of the Paradise Realm had met the mysterious merchant several times, but none of them had ever known his true identity, so Feng Yao’s revelation greatly shocked them. However, it also made them wonder about her true identity, especially since no cultivator in their realm knew about the ancients, which proved that her identity was deeper than they previously imagined.

"The Ancient Celestial Dragon is truly powerful, and its size surpasses yours and your race’s." Tianshi Shengjie didn’t refute her, especially since the beast head was simply much bigger than her head in her dragon form. "The Longevity Deer has almost become extinct in the past, and only ten were left in the realm, which happened because of the greed of living beings. Based on the beast’s name, you guys must have understood the reason behind their goal to hunt it, right?"
"Yeah."

Soon, the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu was completely visible before their eyes, and its pure white dragon body covered a quarter of the area of the Forbidden Land. Above the beast’s back, a young man in his twenties stood with a calm expression and relaxed demeanor, with a small wooden box floating behind him.
The man suddenly looked towards them, extended his hand forward, and sucked Zhang Fei [5] toward himself. However, Feng Yao hurriedly grabbed his shoulder and held him back, shocking the man.

’Puyang Shangren, you shouldn’t do that; otherwise, you will cause him significant trouble.’ The man was even more shocked when Feng Yao’s voice echoed in his mind, and he knew his name. ’You may not know me, but I know a lot about your Puyang Merchant Clan, including Puyang Shenmi.’
Puyang Shangren asked the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu to stop flying, and he stared at Feng Yao with many questions in his mind. ’Who was your previous reincarnation?’

’These people have been waiting for you for a long time, so it isn’t the right moment to discuss my identity; you should prioritize serving them first.’ Puyang Shangren frowned at Feng Yao as he watched those people, but he was only interested in her and Zhang Fei [5]. ’You should go to that city now, and you will meet him there.’
Puyang Shangren nodded slightly and asked the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu to continue their journey, but he looked back several times at Feng Yao and Zhang Fei [5].

All the cultivators present in the temple hurriedly left, including the natural and beast races, as they were afraid of failing to get the merchant’s items, especially since most of them were rare to extremely rare ones.
Unlike them, Zhang Fei [5]’s people did not immediately move, and they waited for his decision.
’Hey! Does that mean the portal to the ancient realm is in this domain?’ Zhang Fei [5] asked Feng Yao via telepathy.
Feng Yao nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. ’Actually, this domain is the border that connects the paradise realm, the ancient realm, and several other realms.’
’Hmm?’ Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow slightly. ’Can we also go to the Primordial Realm through this domain?’

Feng Yao shook her head slightly. ’The Primordial Realm isn’t directly connected to the other realms, including the Ancient Realm. Although Hu Tianlang has already told you about my other identity, it is not yet time for me to explain it to you in more depth, and you should focus on your life in this realm, especially since it is just about to start.’
’I know.’ Zhang Fei [5] then looked at the people behind them. "Let’s go there now."
In front of the main city, the people from the five clans were already lined up neatly, with some of their clan members behind them, waiting for Puyang Shangren’s arrival.

Soon, Puyang Shangren arrived, and he immediately walked down toward them as if descending a staircase. The Ancient Leiyu Tianlu quickly shrank its body to become as small as a bird, and it perched on his right shoulder.
After Puyang Shangren stood in front of them, Xuanyuan Zhuanxu immediately led the others by cupping their hands to him. "Welcome to our town, Senior Puyang."

"All of us come from the ancient race, so you guys don’t need to be this formal with me." Puyang Shangren then asked them. "Do you know the identity of the crimson-haired woman in the temple? How can she know my name and our race?"

Xuanyuan Wuyue answered him immediately. "Senior Puyang, I don’t know her current name, but her past identity is Empress Huo Yanling. As for how she could know about you and our ancient races, I don’t have an answer for that."
"Huh?" Puyang Shangren was momentarily taken aback. "Is she really that Spirit Flame Empress?"

"My sisters and I overheard their conversation a week ago, so we’re certain that she is indeed Empress Huo Yanling’s reincarnation." Puyang Shangren nodded slightly, and Xuanyuan Changyi informed him of something else. "If you see the red-haired woman by her side, she is the Eternal Flame."
"What?" Puyang Shangren exclaimed in shock. "I did see that red-haired woman by her side, and she is indeed a flame spirit, but is it true that she is the Eternal Flame?"

Xuanyuan Qian then explained. "Senior Puyang, only the Eternal Flame could create the deep red flame barrier, and they’ve been living in the temple since they arrived in our domain. Furthermore, they have protected the temple from those demons and beasts, so we are sure we have not mistaken the identity of that red-haired woman."

"If she really is the Eternal Flame, then why doesn’t she reactivate the altar? If she reactivates, this domain will return to normal, and all of you will regain your strength." All of them shook their heads at Puyang Shangren, especially since they had not met Huo Ling because of her barrier. "The situation in the domain this time seems unusual; I can see hundreds of thousands of demons and evil beasts roaming here, and they seem to be looking for something."

"Senior Puyang, they seem to know about the existence of that thing in our domain." Puyang Shangren raised an eyebrow in response to Xuanyuan Zhuanxu. "I don’t know how they found out about it, but we’ll make sure that they will never manage to find it."

Puyang Shangren nodded to him. "You must keep a close eye on that thing, especially since it could destroy this Paradise Realm and the Three Mortal Realms if it falls into the hands of those heretics. Who is the young man next to Empress Huo Yanling? Why does she seem so protective of him?"

"Based on their conversation, his name is Zhang Fei [5], but we don’t have any detailed information about him." Puyang Shangren intently listened to Xuanyuan Wuyue, who explained several things about him, including the presence of mythical beasts by his side. "Senior, those people are on their way to this city, so I think we should prepare to welcome them."
Puyang Shangren nodded in response. "Let’s go there. I brought many new items today, and you guys can choose the items you need before those people arrive."

Xuanyuan Zhuanxu wanted to lead Puyang Shangren into the city, but Zhang Fei [5] and his entourage suddenly appeared. Moreover, it was clearly not Feng Yao who had brought them there; it was him. ’His speed is even more astonishing than what he showed last week.’

Puyang Shangren was also quite surprised. "You have such a marvelous movement technique, little boy. The distance from the temple to this city is nearly 10,000 miles, but you were able to bring them here in seconds. Moreover, I couldn’t feel any ripples in your Qi, proving that you have complete control over iti."
"Senior, you praise me too much," Zhang Fei [5] respectfully replied.

Puyang Shangren nodded slightly. "Since you guys have arrived, you can follow us now. As usual, you must have my token to purchase items from me, and you can take the test if any of you don’t have one yet."
"Yes, Senior."

Above the beast’s back, a young man in his twenties stood with a calm expression and relaxed demeanor, with a small wooden box floating behind him.
The man suddenly looked towards them, extended his hand forward, and sucked Zhang Fei [5] toward himself.
However, Feng Yao hurriedly grabbed his shoulder and held him back, shocking the man.

’Puyang Shangren, you shouldn’t do that; otherwise, you will cause him significant trouble.’ The man was even more shocked when Feng Yao’s voice echoed in his mind, and he knew his name. ’You may not know me, but I know a lot about your Puyang Merchant Clan, including Puyang Shenmi.’
Puyang Shangren asked the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu to stop flying, and he stared at Feng Yao with many questions in his mind. ’Who was your previous reincarnation?’

’These people have been waiting for you for a long time, so it isn’t the right moment to discuss my identity; you should prioritize serving them first.’ Puyang Shangren frowned at Feng Yao as he watched those people, but he was only interested in her and Zhang Fei [5]. ’You should go to that city now, and you will meet him there.’
Puyang Shangren nodded slightly and asked the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu to continue their journey, but he looked back several times at Feng Yao and Zhang Fei [5].

All the cultivators present in the temple hurriedly left, including the natural and beast races, as they were afraid of failing to get the merchant’s items, especially since most of them were rare to extremely rare ones.
Unlike them, Zhang Fei [5]’s people did not immediately move, and they waited for his decision.
’Hey!
Does that mean the portal to the ancient realm is in this domain?’ Zhang Fei [5] asked Feng Yao via telepathy.
Feng Yao nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. ’Actually, this domain is the border that connects the paradise realm, the ancient realm, and several other realms.’
’Hmm?’ Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow slightly. ’Can we also go to the Primordial Realm through this domain?’
Feng Yao shook her head slightly. ’The Primordial Realm isn’t directly connected to the other realms, including the Ancient Realm.

Although Hu Tianlang has already told you about my other identity, it is not yet time for me to explain it to you in more depth, and you should focus on your life in this realm, especially since it is just about to start.’
’I know.’ Zhang Fei [5] then looked at the people behind them.
"Let’s go there now."
In front of the main city, the people from the five clans were already lined up neatly, with some of their clan members behind them, waiting for Puyang Shangren’s arrival.
Soon, Puyang Shangren arrived, and he immediately walked down toward them as if descending a staircase.
The Ancient Leiyu Tianlu quickly shrank its body to become as small as a bird, and it perched on his right shoulder.
After Puyang Shangren stood in front of them, Xuanyuan Zhuanxu immediately led the others by cupping their hands to him.
"Welcome to our town, Senior Puyang."
"All of us come from the ancient race, so you guys don’t need to be this formal with me." Puyang Shangren then asked them.
"Do you know the identity of the crimson-haired woman in the temple?
How can she know my name and our race?"
Xuanyuan Wuyue answered him immediately.
"Senior Puyang, I don’t know her current name, but her past identity is Empress Huo Yanling.
As for how she could know about you and our ancient races, I don’t have an answer for that."
"Huh?" Puyang Shangren was momentarily taken aback.
"Is she really that Spirit Flame Empress?"

"My sisters and I overheard their conversation a week ago, so we’re certain that she is indeed Empress Huo Yanling’s reincarnation." Puyang Shangren nodded slightly, and Xuanyuan Changyi informed him of something else.
"If you see the red-haired woman by her side, she is the Eternal Flame."
"What?" Puyang Shangren exclaimed in shock.
"I did see that red-haired woman by her side, and she is indeed a flame spirit, but is it true that she is the Eternal Flame?"
Xuanyuan Qian then explained.
"Senior Puyang, only the Eternal Flame could create the deep red flame barrier, and they’ve been living in the temple since they arrived in our domain.
Furthermore, they have protected the temple from those demons and beasts, so we are sure we have not mistaken the identity of that red-haired woman."
"If she really is the Eternal Flame, then why doesn’t she reactivate the altar?

If she reactivates, this domain will return to normal, and all of you will regain your strength." All of them shook their heads at Puyang Shangren, especially since they had not met Huo Ling because of her barrier.
"The situation in the domain this time seems unusual; I can see hundreds of thousands of demons and evil beasts roaming here, and they seem to be looking for something."
"Senior Puyang, they seem to know about the existence of that thing in our domain." Puyang Shangren raised an eyebrow in response to Xuanyuan Zhuanxu.
"I don’t know how they found out about it, but we’ll make sure that they will never manage to find it."
Puyang Shangren nodded to him.
"You must keep a close eye on that thing, especially since it could destroy this Paradise Realm and the Three Mortal Realms if it falls into the hands of those heretics.
Who is the young man next to Empress Huo Yanling?
Why does she seem so protective of him?"

"Based on their conversation, his name is Zhang Fei [5], but we don’t have any detailed information about him." Puyang Shangren intently listened to Xuanyuan Wuyue, who explained several things about him, including the presence of mythical beasts by his side.
"Senior, those people are on their way to this city, so I think we should prepare to welcome them."
Puyang Shangren nodded in response.
"Let’s go there.
I brought many new items today, and you guys can choose the items you need before those people arrive."
Xuanyuan Zhuanxu wanted to lead Puyang Shangren into the city, but Zhang Fei [5] and his entourage suddenly appeared.
Moreover, it was clearly not Feng Yao who had brought them there; it was him. ’His speed is even more astonishing than what he showed last week.’
Puyang Shangren was also quite surprised.
"You have such a marvelous movement technique, little boy.
The distance from the temple to this city is nearly 10,000 miles, but you were able to bring them here in seconds.
Moreover, I couldn’t feel any ripples in your Qi, proving that you have complete control over iti."
"Senior, you praise me too much," Zhang Fei [5] respectfully replied.
Puyang Shangren nodded slightly.
"Since you guys have arrived, you can follow us now.
As usual, you must have my token to purchase items from me, and you can take the test if any of you don’t have one yet."
"Yes, Senior."

chapters.title: Chapter 1132: Enemies’ Movement
paragraphs: When they arrived at the town hall, the townspeople had already filled the place. Despite their large numbers, they lined up neatly on both sides, with the youngest generation standing at the front.
Just like the townspeople, Zhang Fei [5] and the others also had to queue to buy Puyang Shangren’s items.
Xuanyuan Zhuanxu and several elders from the other clans led Puyang Shangren into the town hall, while the rest stood guard around the town to prevent those people from breaking in.

To Puyang Shangren’s surprise, the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu flew from his shoulder and landed on Zhang Fei [5]’s shoulder, rubbing his head against his cheek. ’Hmm? Tianlu has never been close to anyone before, and he never allowed my parents to touch him, but he actually took the initiative to approach this little boy.’

Puyang Shangren ignored that and entered the town hall, where he opened the small wooden box that quickly expanded on its own, revealing various kinds of items. "Call your youngest generations first."
"Yes, Senior." Xuanyuan Wuyue called them one by one to choose the items they wanted.
Outside, Zhang Fei [5] rubbed the beast’s little head as he monitored the inside of the town hall using his senses, and the number of items that Puyang Shangren brought quite surprised him.
Luo Yunxiao and the others tried to touch the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu, but the beast immediately showed hostility towards them, and he tried to attack them.
Unlike toward them, the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu did not show any hostility when Feng Yao touched him; instead, he visibly trembled because of her aura.
"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled at the beast’s reaction. "If you dare attack me, I will roast you with some spices, and I will enjoy your meat."
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head and spoke to the beast. "They are my wives, so please don’t attack them, okay?"
The Ancient Leiyu Tianlu looked at Zhang Fei [5] for a moment before nodding, and he snuggled against his shoulder while continuing to rub his head.
"Is his wooden box an artifact?" Zhang Fei [5] asked Feng Yao.

Feng Yao nodded at him. "His wooden box is the Redwood Void Cabinet, and it has no limitations because it was created using the void elemental law. Therefore, you should not be surprised if he can carry so many types of items in large quantities."
"Do you think he has demon items?" Zhang Fei [5] curiously asked.

"There are some ancient demon races in that realm, and they are much stronger than those ten demon gods. Therefore, he should have some demon items, and you can try asking him about them later." Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Feng Yao. "The character of the demons in that realm is still quite evil, like those in this Paradise Realm and the Three Mortal Realms, but they rarely clash with other races."
"Don’t other races hate those demons, Big Sis Yao?" Luo Yunxiao asked.

Feng Yao then created a small Qi screen. "Unlike the people in this realm or in the Three Mortal Realms, the inhabitants of that domain never regard those demons as heretics. Despite some other races still harboring hatred for them, they can coexist together for so long."
"Doesn’t that mean the realm is much more peaceful?"
"Not really." Feng Yao shook her head at Wang Yourou. "Although clashes between them are rare, some still occur, and their scale is much larger and more devastating."
"Can people from this realm ascend to the Ancient Realm?" Yan Yinqing asked her.

"No." Feng Yao’s answer confused them. "This domain is indeed the border between the Paradise Realm and the Ancient Realm, but no cultivator from this realm can ascend there directly, and they can only ascend there if the ancients take them there."
"So, we will never have the chance to ascend to the Ancient Realm?"

"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed at their dejected expression. "Why are you guys reacting like this? All the cultivators in this realm would never be able to ascend to the Ancient Realm without the ancients, but you guys have Zhang Fei [5], remember? As you already know, the ten-tailed fox is a primordial beast, and he will become one when he inherits all of Hu Tianlang’s souls and evolves into the ten-tailed fox."
"Huh?" All of them looked at Zhang Fei [5] in shock. Even the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu also looked at him with a shocked expression, not expecting that he was the heir of the ten-tailed fox.
Zhang Fei [5] himself was also shocked by Feng Yao’s words. "Will I really become a primordial beast after I evolve into the ten-tailed fox?"

"Yes." Feng Yao answered him with a nod. "There is only one ten-tailed fox in this universe, and you will become a primordial beast after you evolve into one. Unfortunately, your road to evolving into one is still long, and you have to find all of Hu Tianlang’s souls first."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "According to the information I have, two of his souls are in the Slaughter Blood Domain and in the Floral Mirage Domain, but I don’t know which souls are hidden there. As for his wrath soul, it is in the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain, but I can’t possibly go to all three domains for now."

"If you want to go to the Slaughter Blood Domain, you must at least break through to the advanced demon ranks first." Feng Yao then pointed at Tian Shuixiang. "He is an asura demon, and he should still be familiar with the situation in that domain, so you can ask him to lead you to that place. As for the Floral Mirage Domain, you must first increase your cultivation until it reaches at least the Celestial Emperor Realm. For Hu Tianlang’s wrath soul, you don’t need to think too much about it, and I’m sure it will come to you on its own in the future."
Zhang Fei [5] had not given it much thought, particularly because the incident from years ago remained vivid in his memory, despite the passage of time.

A few hours later, cultivators from various races had arrived in the town, but people from the five clans prevented them from entering, especially since many of their members had not yet had their turn to meet with Puyang Shangren.

Although they were disappointed, they had no choice but to wait for their turn. They tried to look for Zhang Fei [5] and the others behind them, but they didn’t know that they had already arrived at the town much earlier than them.
Some of them tried to use their senses to inspect the city, but Xuanyuan Qian and the others forbade them from doing so, and they could only look inside the city when it was their turn.

While waiting for their chance to enter the town, several groups of evil beasts approached it, accompanied by a large army led by various evil mythical ones. Meanwhile, several other groups of beasts went to other areas to carry out their primary missions, one of which was the Eternal Spring Oasis.
Many demon groups, a combination of the nine demon races, also moved towards the town, led by several demons who had reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.

The people from the five clans naturally noticed the movement of those beasts and demons, and they immediately ordered their clan members to intercept and kill them. They did not stay in the main town, and they moved as soon as Xuanyuan Zhuanxu activated the barrier protecting the town. The other towns in the Forbidden Land also activated protective barriers to protect their families.
Feng Yao looked around outside the town. "As expected, those beasts and demons are indeed targeting Puyang Shangren, and they’re on their way here in large numbers."
"Do they want to commit suicide? That senior is an ancient being, and he surpasses them in all aspects." Luo Yunxiao then asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Are we going to move?"

"Not now." Zhang Fei [5] calculated their distance through the system’s map. "Those demons and beasts are still far from our location, and the ancestors of the natives of this domain have already moved to stop them. Therefore, we don’t need to waste our energy attacking them, and we will move if many of them manage to escape and arrive here. However, we have to measure their strength first and don’t move rashly, especially since there are many beasts and demons in the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm now."
"Youjia." Long Youjia directly looked at Tianshi Shengjie. "I want you to help them, but you only need to help them from afar using your void element."
Long Youjia nodded, flew into the sky, and transformed back into his void dragon form. After that, he quickly flew towards the demons and assisted the people from the five clans in stopping them.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised when the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu flew from his shoulder and enlarged himself, and he looked at him as if asking him to go with him.
Feng Yao pushed him forward. "Go with him, and I will protect you from here."
"Alright." Zhang Fei immediately jumped onto the back of the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu, which quickly carried him away from the main town.
"Are you sure it’s okay, Big Sis Yao?"
Feng Yao nodded at her. "You don’t need to worry about them, Yunxiao. The Ancient Leiyu Tianlu is truly powerful, and those evil mythical beasts are not his opponents."

chapters.title: Chapter 1133: Massacre
paragraphs: All the evil beasts that were moving towards the main town immediately stopped in their spots as the giant shadow of the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu covered the entire area.
Even the evil mythical ones, such as the Dark Qilin, Three-Eyed Dark Dragon, Corpse Feather Roc, Shadow Hou Monarch, Blood Pixiu, One-Horned Dark Bai Ze, and others, feared the giant beast.
"Run! Save your lives now!" The Three-Eyed Dark Dragon shouted like a roar to all the beasts below, and it hurriedly flew away from the attack range of the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu.

Unfortunately, it was too late for those evil beasts to escape, especially since the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu immediately shot countless light rays from his mouth, raining down on all the beasts in the area.

Whether they were beasts with cultivation at the Celestial Lord Realm or those who had reached the Celestial Emperor Realm, they died instantly on the spot as soon as those light rays pierced their heads, flooding the ground beneath them with their blood.

Seeing all their subordinates die in one attack made the Dark Qilin and the other mythical evil beasts realize the power of the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu, and they fled away with their tails between their legs.

Unlike those beasts, the loud cheers of native cultivators from the Forbidden Land echoed from various areas, especially since the action of the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu greatly lightened their burden to face their enemies.

On the back of the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu, Zhang Fei [5] stared at the ground in a daze as he was shocked by the beast’s attack that wiped out all the evil beasts in one go. ’Crazy shit! This beast’s strength is simply too frightening!’

The Ancient Leiyu Tianlu looked at those evil mythical beasts with a look of disdain and mockery, but he immediately flew after them with his mouth wide open. He ate them alive and chewed them like candy.

The Ancient Leiyu Tianlu then looked at the demons who were fighting with the native cultivators from the Forbidden Land. Just like those evil beasts, he wiped out all the demons with one attack, making Zhang Fei [5] smile bitterly at his back.
Thereafter, the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu eliminated all the evil beasts in the other areas, filling the entire domain with the cheers of the natives.

’This big guy didn’t hold back and killed them in seconds.’ Zhang Fei [5] inwardly muttered his regret over the deaths of those evil beasts and demons. He wanted to absorb the beast and demon essences from the strongest beasts and demons, but the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu eliminated them without any remains.
After he confirmed that not a single enemy remained, the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu brought Zhang Fei [5] back to the main town, where everyone stared at the beast in awe, fear, and horror.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately jumped down and landed by the side of Feng Yao and the others, allowing the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu to shrink his body and perch on his shoulders again. "This big guy is too scary!"

"Hahaha." Feng Yao laughed at that. "He is an ancient beast, and he could wipe out Taotie and the others easily, let alone their subordinates. This way, you should already be aware of the difference in strength between the cultivators in this realm and the ancients, right?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a nod. "Did the other ancients never descend to this realm?"

Feng Yao shook her head at him. "The only ancient clan that descended to this realm was the Puyang Clan, but they never left this domain. After the auction is over, they will go home directly, and they will come again a hundred years later."
"What is the real reason behind their decision to sell those items directly and through auction in this domain, Big Sis Yao?" Long Yunxiao asked her.

"Talents." Zhang Fei [5] and the others turned to Feng Yao in confusion. "One of the fundamental factors of cultivators is talent, and they are tasked with searching for new talents from this Paradise Realm. Unfortunately, talent in this realm continues to decline every year, and those who are talented may not necessarily meet their criteria. If they do, the people from the Puyang Clan will take them to the ancient realm, depending on their age. If those people have matured as cultivators, they will take them there immediately, but they will leave them here for a few years if they are not yet mature."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "So, they are deliberately selling rare items to lure talents in this realm out, huh?"

"You could say it like that." Feng Yao replied with a slight nod. "As we all know, all sects and clans will always prioritize their best talents, and they will do anything to help them develop. The ancients think that if they sell rare items to this realm, those clans will bring their best talents to this domain to purchase the items directly or attend the auction."
Zhang Fei [5] looked towards the town gate. "I’ve been watching them for the past week, and there are indeed many good talents among them, but they haven’t shown their abilities directly."

"You will see their abilities when the auction takes place in three days." Zhang Fei [5] gave Feng Yao a questioning look. "The auction is different from the other auctions, and you can see it for yourself in three days."

"Don’t you think today’s incident will be a problem for our realm?" Luo Fenghan suddenly asked Feng Yao. "This senior beast slaughtered hundreds of thousands of evil beasts and demons in one day. I’m sure their leaders won’t remain silent about this matter, and they might even come out in person to seek revenge."

Feng Yao shook her head at him. "Their leaders must already know the mastermind behind their subordinates’ deaths, so I believe they won’t mess around in this realm. They might come here in person, but they won’t be able to harm these natives, and they will be the ones to die if they dare to come here for revenge."
"Are you saying that the ancestor of the Xuanyuan Clan will act against them?"

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at Zhang Fei [5]. "The ancestor of the Xuanyuan Clan is truly powerful, and his strength surpasses even Long Wuzhao. If a great danger threatens this domain, he will wake up from his slumber to eliminate it, and he will enter a long slumber again afterwards."
"Why would he do that?"

Feng Yao released a soft sigh. "The ancients are different from other cultivators in this realm, and they need a long time to recover their strength during their stay here. Therefore, he chose to enter a long sleep, or else he would weaken too quickly. The reason they couldn’t go to the ancient realm was because their true strength was sealed after Huo Ling left with me, especially since she was the lifeblood of this domain and natives, so she had to reactivate the altar to unlock the seal on their power. If she did that, she wouldn’t be able to leave the altar again, unless I take her away again."
"What was your reason for taking her away with you in the past?" Zhang Fei [5] curiously asked.
Feng Yao smiled at him. "Surpass me first, and I will tell you everything you want to know then."
"Cheapskate!" Luo Yunxiao and the others laughed seeing Zhang Fei [5] making an annoyed face because of Feng Yao.
When night fell, all the natives of the Forbidden Land had taken their turn to meet and purchase items from Puyang Shangren, which made them overjoyed.
Xuanyuan Zhuanxu immediately approached them. "Empress Huo, it’s your turn to meet Senior Puyang. Once you’re all done, I’ll let the people outside come in and meet him."
"Alright." Feng Yao immediately pulled Zhang Fei [5] with her.
Huo Ling wanted to follow them, but Xuanyuan Zhuanxu stopped him. "Senior Eternal Flame, please wait."
"Hmm?" Huo Ling furrowed her brows. "What do you want from me?"
*Thud*

Xuanyuan Zhuanxu dropped to his knees and prostrated himself before Huo Ling. "Senior, you’ve been missing for several million years, and we’ve suffered for so long because of your disappearance. Since you’ve returned to this domain, I humbly beg you to reactivate the altar and unseal our true strength. This way, we don’t have to suffer anymore, and we can go to the Ancient Realm."

Xuanyuan Zhuanxu released a heavy sigh, rose to his feet, and stared at the townhall. ’What exactly is her task? Why does she choose it over our suffering?’

Even the evil mythical ones, such as the Dark Qilin, Three-Eyed Dark Dragon, Corpse Feather Roc, Shadow Hou Monarch, Blood Pixiu, One-Horned Dark Bai Ze, and others, feared the giant beast.
"Run!
Save your lives now!" The Three-Eyed Dark Dragon shouted like a roar to all the beasts below, and it hurriedly flew away from the attack range of the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu.

Unfortunately, it was too late for those evil beasts to escape, especially since the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu immediately shot countless light rays from his mouth, raining down on all the beasts in the area.

Whether they were beasts with cultivation at the Celestial Lord Realm or those who had reached the Celestial Emperor Realm, they died instantly on the spot as soon as those light rays pierced their heads, flooding the ground beneath them with their blood.

Seeing all their subordinates die in one attack made the Dark Qilin and the other mythical evil beasts realize the power of the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu, and they fled away with their tails between their legs.

Unlike those beasts, the loud cheers of native cultivators from the Forbidden Land echoed from various areas, especially since the action of the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu greatly lightened their burden to face their enemies.
On the back of the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu, Zhang Fei [5] stared at the ground in a daze as he was shocked by the beast’s attack that wiped out all the evil beasts in one go. ’Crazy shit!

The Ancient Leiyu Tianlu looked at those evil mythical beasts with a look of disdain and mockery, but he immediately flew after them with his mouth wide open.

chapters.title: Chapter 1134: Abyssal Demon Heart
paragraphs: "Is there something you need from me, Empress Huo?" Puyang Shangren asked.
"None of your items catch my eye." Feng Yao pushed Zhang Fei [5] forward. "Instead, he needs some demon items, and I think you have them."

Puyang Shangren looked at Zhang Fei [5] in confusion, especially since he couldn’t sense any demon aura from him, so he thought that demon items should be useless to him. "Why do you need demon items? And what items do you need?"

"I need the Abyssal Demon Heart, the Infernal Blood Core, the Demon Essence Drop, the Demon Soul Elixir, and the Demon Ritual Sigil." Puyang Shangren became even more confused after Zhang Fei [5] mentioned them. "Your guess is correct; I need them for my demon rank to break through to the advanced demon ranks."

"Your demon rank?" Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his demon form, shocking Puyang Shangren a bit. Even the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu flew off his shoulders, perching above the cabinet, and staring at him. "How did you suddenly become a demon? I couldn’t sense any demon aura from you before, and I could sense it after you transformed into one. Moreover, your demon form is a lust demon, but I’ve never encountered one with nine tails."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Feng Yao, who nodded to him. He then transformed into his complete nine-tailed heavenly fox form, shocking Puyang Shangren once again.

The Ancient Leiyu Tianlu immediately flew down, circled Zhang Fei [5], and sniffed his beast scent. He became excited after sniffing his scent, and he made low noises as if he was telling his master something.
Puyang Shangren nodded to his beast. "Tianlu told me that you are an authentic fox beast, but we have never seen your fox race before."

"My fox race is the Heavenly Fox Race, and it only exists in the Three Mortal Realms. As for the reason I can have three identities, it happened by accident." Puyang Shangren did not believe Zhang Fei [5] so easily, and he asked Feng Yao for confirmation, who immediately told him the fact. "Do you have them, Senior?"

Puyang Shangren didn’t answer Zhang Fei [5], and he took another wooden box from his storage ring before activating it. Dozens of demon items emerged from it, and he retrieved a black heart that continued to beat by itself. "Out of the five demon items you desire, I only have this Abyssal Demon Heart. However, I won’t sell it to you if you don’t have my token, and you have to take the tests to get one."

"Here." Zhang Fei [5] showed the golden token that he got from the system quest. "I got it at the Star Tower, but I didn’t know what it was for until Feng Yao told me about you, and I’ve kept it ever since."

Puyang Shangren nodded slightly. "I don’t care where or how you got my token, but since you already have one, you don’t need to take the tests, and you can buy this heart. However, I don’t need jewels, and you can exchange this heart for something of equivalent value."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] took his basic pills and showed them to him. "Is the price of these pills equivalent to the heart?"

Puyang Shangren took one of the pills and looked closer. "A superior-grade Essence Qi Pill that can speed up our Qi absorption rate by two times faster, huh? I didn’t expect you to be able to concoct so many superior-grade pills, but your basic pills are worth nothing in my realm, so I can’t accept this exchange."
"Are these pills really worthless in your realm, senior?"

Puyang Shangren looked over all his items before taking a bottle, and he showed the pill inside to Zhang Fei [5]. "This is a superior-grade Qi Origin Gathering Pill, and it will increase our Qi absorption rate by ten times."
"Ten times!" Zhang Fei [5] let out a low cry. "How much does this pill cost in your realm, Senior?"
"One hundred million golden jewels." Puyang Shangren’s answer almost caused Zhang Fei [5] to fall, as the price of the pill was simply too sky-high.

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled and took out a piece of paper. She wrote a few things before handing it to Zhang Fei [5]. "That’s the recipe for concocting the Qi Origin Gathering Pill, so you don’t need to buy the pill and concoct it yourself. You can find the ingredients in this realm, and you can ask Jin Nanqing for help in obtaining them."
Zhang Fei [5] excitedly read the list of ingredients in the paper. On the other hand, Puyang Shangren looked annoyed, especially after he saw the mischievous smile on Feng Yao’s face.
After he finished reading everything, Zhang Fei [5] put away the paper and took out a pill. "Senior, I have many kinds of pills, but none are more valuable than this one."
"What kind of pill is this?" Puyang Shangren asked, bending forward and looking at the pill.
Zhang Fei [5] confidently explained to him directly. "If you take this Beauty Restoring Pill, you will regain your youth."
"Oh?" Puyang Shangren was surprised and seemed interested in the pill. "This pill is quite interesting, and there’s no such pill in my realm. Did you concoct it yourself?"
"She taught me to concoct it." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Feng Yao. "In fact, she is my alchemy master in name, and she taught me a lot about alchemy."

Feng Yao glared at Zhang Fei [5]. "He did learn alchemy from me, but I only taught him the basics. He accomplished the rest on his own by relying on his talent, and he managed to reach the god rank in just eight years."

"I see." Puyang Shangren nodded slightly. "Reaching the god rank is no simple matter, and if you did achieve it in eight years, it proves your talent in alchemy is indeed extraordinary. However, how can I know that the effect of your Beauty Restoring Pill is real?"

Zhang Fei [5] smiled at him. "Whether the effect of my pill is real or not, I want to know first whether it is equivalent to the Abyssal Demon Heart or not. If you think the two are equivalent, you can swallow my pill to prove its effect."

"If the effect is real, this pill is equivalent to two Abyssal Demon Hearts. If the result is according to your words, I will give this heart to you, and you can choose my other items to pay it off." Puyang Shangren swallowed the pill as soon as Zhang Fei [5] agreed, but he would have to wait a while to see the results. "Hmm? How long will it take to take effect?"
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "Some people need a few minutes, and some need a few hours."
"Do you sell such a precious pill to the public?"

"You’re wrong about that, Senior. I never sell this pill to the public, and I only give it to those closest to me." Puyang Shangren nodded understandingly at Zhang Fei [5]. "However, the effect of my Beauty Restoring Pill isn’t permanent, and you’ll age again after a few hundred years. If you want a permanent effect, I have another pill, whose effect complements that pill."

’This kid is really cunning! He deliberately didn’t take out the second pill from the start, and he mentioned it after I swallowed the first one! If the effect of the first pill is real, I have no other choice but to buy the second pill.’ Puyang Shangren inwardly released a heavy sigh. "What’s your second pill?"

"As I said before, the effects of both pills complement each other, and you will never age again by taking this Youthful Retaining Pill." Puyang Shangren was frozen in his spot, staring at him in shock. The Ancient Leiyu Tianlu flew before Zhang Fei [5] with its mouth open. "Haha! You should ask your master first, Senior Tianlu. If he allows you, I will give these two pills to you."
The Ancient Leiyu Tianlu turned to Puyang Shangren with glassy eyes, begging him to buy him Zhang Fei [5]’s two pills, leaving him to sigh. "Give him the pills, little boy."
The Ancient Leiyu Tianlu was overjoyed upon hearing that, and he opened his mouth to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately threw the two pills into his mouth.
Zhang Fei [5] also gave the Youthful Retaining Pill to Puyang Shangren after he asked for it, and he waited for the two pills to take effect while examining the other items in front of them.
Mei suddenly spoke to him. [Master, take a look at that silver sword; it should be one of the seven profound treasures, the Sky-Severing Sword.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] pointed at the sword. "Senior, is this sword what I think it is?"
"That sword is indeed one of the seven profound treasures, the Sky-Severing Sword." Feng Yao then asked Puyang Shangren. "Did you bring that sword here to auction?"

Puyang Shangren nodded before explaining. "My great-grandfather discovered the Sky-Severing Sword in the Holy Sword Graveyard decades ago. In fact, it asked him to take it out of there, and it said that its destined master had already appeared. Several people tried to unsheathe it before, but no one met its criteria. Therefore, he asked me to bring it to auction this time in the hope that it would meet its master, but I’m not sure there’s anyone worthy in this realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 1135: War God’s Berserk Method
paragraphs: "What’s the Holy Sword Graveyard?"
Feng Yao created another Qi screen. "That is the Holy Sword Graveyard."

The Holy Sword Graveyard is a vast, open mountain filled with swords of all shapes and sizes. Most are rusted, but a few still emit a faint glow and oppressive aura. The ground is uneven and marked with deep cracks and slashes, remnants of fierce battles fought here long ago.

The area is eerily quiet, except for the occasional metallic hum carried by the wind. The graveyard is said to be the final resting place of countless sword masters, their weapons left behind as a mark of respect. The lingering sword intent makes the air heavy and dangerous, and those without strong will or sufficient sword mastery risk serious injury just by entering.
In the center, there was a giant sword stele, with four golden chains chaining its hilt in four different directions."

Zhang Fei [5] was amazed as he looked at those countless swords, but the giant sword stele piqued his interest more. Even the Sky-Severing Sword vibrated strongly when the screen displayed that place. "A sword stele?"

Feng Yao nodded at him. "It looked like a useless sword stele, but it was actually a real sword. Unfortunately, no sword master has ever managed to take that sword, and it is believed that doing so would grant the power to control all other swords in the graveyard."
"What kind of sword is that? Why is it so large? Is the giant race the owner of that sword?"

"The true giant race is always confident in their physical strength, and they never use any weapons. In battle, they always use their bare hands, and their raw strength can destroy half of this domain." Feng Yao then created another screen, displaying a middle-aged man controlling the sword stele. He could adjust the sword’s size to that of a normal sword or enlarge it significantly. "He was the first sword master to perfectly comprehend the Sword Dao, and people of the past nicknamed him the Sword God, especially since his abilities were truly flawless and unmatched. "A sword that can reduce everything to nothingness." Zhang Fei [5] muttered under his breath in awe and shock.

Unlike Zhang Fei [5], Puyang Shangren was more curious about Feng Yao’s identity. "Who exactly are you, Empress Huo? Not even the ancient races know the name of that sword, let alone its owner, but you possess memories of him, proving that you are older than the ancient races."
"Hehe." Feng Yao replied with a giggle to Puyang Shangren, further fueling his curiosity about her identity. She then removed all the screens. "Try to unsheathe the Sky-Severing Sword."
"Is it okay, Senior?" Zhang Fei [5] asked Puyang Shangren first, especially since the sword was his.

Puyang Shangren took the sword and handed it to Zhang Fei [5]. "Even though I work as a merchant, I am a god-rank sword master. Therefore, I can tell that you are also one, but it does not guarantee that this Sky-Severing Sword will be willing to recognize you as its master."

"I understand." Zhang Fei [5] received the sword and grabbed the hilt straight away. Before trying to unsheathe the sword, he first used his sword domain and sword dao. Unfortunately, the sword didn’t move an inch, as if it were one with its sheath.

Zhang Fei [5] didn’t want to give up so easily, and he tried several other options to unsheathe the sword. Unfortunately, all his efforts were in vain, and the sword remained motionless. "I guess this sword doesn’t like me."

"Hahaha." Puyang Shangren laughed as he received the sword, and he placed it back in its original place. "There are countless god-rank sword masters in my realm, but no one has succeeded in unsheathing the sword, including me. If you have many sword masters by your side, you can take them to the auction in three days, and they can try unsheathing it at that time."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "There are several god-rank sword masters by my side, including my master. Although I still don’t want those people to know them, I will bring them to attend the auctions, and I hope that one of them will succeed in winning this sword’s recognition."

After After waiting for some time, the two pills finally took effect on Puyang Shangren and the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu. The man immediately washed the black liquid off, dried their bodies, and took out a mirror.
"Are you satisfied with the results, Senior?" Zhang Fei [5] asked with a faint smile.
"Will I really never grow old again after today?"
"I guarantee the results will be permanent." Puyang Shangren nodded and handed the Abyssal Demon Heart to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately stored it into the system inventory. "Thank you, Senior."
[Obtained 1 Abyssal Demon Heart.]

"Since Tianlu and I have swallowed your pills, you can choose some other items from my collection, and I will consider their prices." Zhang Fei [5] excitedly started selecting several items from Puyang Shangren’s collection. "What do you think if I bring him to the ancient realm, Empress Huo?"

Feng Yao shook her head in refusal. "He has been focused on his seclusion since he ascended to this realm, and he has no experience here. I want him to stay here before he reaches the Celestial God Realm, and I will take him to the ancient realm when he is ready."
"I see." Puyang Shangren nodded in understanding.

"By the way, is there something going on with the Ancient Nether Clan? Why did they send someone to invade the Three Mortal Realms in secret?" Puyang Shangren looked at Feng Yao in shock, prompting her to explain to him about Zhang Fei [5]’s encounter with the mysterious woman from that clan in the Sovereign Heaven Realm years ago. "I haven’t set foot there for too long, so I don’t have much information about the situation there."

"Actually, the Ancient Nether Clan almost became extinct." This time, it was Feng Yao’s turn to be shocked when she heard that from Puyang Shangren. "No one knows what really happened to them at that time, but three-quarters of their clan members died overnight, and their remaining number was no more than fifty. Strangely, we found no traces of battle on their clan or corpses, and the people who examined their corpses said they died in their sleep."

Feng Yao furrowed her brows, but Huo Ling spoke directly to her. "Master, the only person who can do such a thing to them is that guy, but I found it strange for him to slaughter so many people from the Ancient Nether Race in one night."
"Yes." Feng Yao agreed, recalling the man that Huo Ling was mentioning. "I also felt strange about his actions, especially since he’s not such a cold-blooded killer."
"Who is the person you two are talking about?"

Feng Yao told Puyang Shangren directly. "Puyang Shenmi and the people of her generation nicknamed him the Nightmare Lord, mainly because all of his abilities were related to dreams. His true name is Meng Zhou, a hybrid between a female human and a dream demon, but he never kills people without reason."
"Hmm?" Puyang Shangren frowned, as he had heard Meng Zhou. "Are you sure that man is their killer?"

Feng Yao nodded at him. "If your previous words are true and those people died in their sleep, I am certain that Meng Zhou is their killer. However, I don’t know his reason for doing so, and you can ask your clan members to investigate him."

"Alright, I’ll have them investigate that man later." Puyang Shangren then told her something else. "The woman you were referring to earlier might be Yuan Xiajie, especially since she’s been missing for so long, and none of their race has managed to find her. Her father was the former leader of the Ancient Nether Race, and she said that she wanted to take revenge against that person before she disappeared."
"I see." Feng Yao nodded in understanding.
After some time, Zhang Fei [5] had chosen four items, which were two pills, a weapon, and a scroll. "Are these items equivalent to my four pills, Senior?"

"Let’s see." Puyang Shangren looked at the items one by one before taking a scroll from his hand. "This War God’s Berserk Method is truly dangerous, and only a high-level body cultivator can learn it. Ordinary cultivator can learn it, but the risk is too great, and you will become a cripple if you use it rashly."

Zhang Fei [5] replied to him directly. "Actually, I’m a body cultivator, and my body cultivation level has already reached the Diamond Body Stage. Additionally, I’ve mastered seven body cultivation techniques, so I chose this method. However, I don’t know if my four pills are enough to redeem all these items."

Feng Yao confirmed that to Puyang Shangren, who immediately returned the scroll to Zhang Fei [5]. "You sure are insane, little boy! Honestly, the total of these four items is more expensive than your pills, but since the effect of your pills is permanent, I will give them to you. However, you must remember my advice well: do not use the method if you don’t have to, or you will waste your talent if you become a cripple."
"Thank you for your advice, Senior."
