chapters.title: Chapter 1136: Four Perils
paragraphs: After they left the town hall, Luo Fenghan took his turn to meet Puyang Shangren. He took his two sons and daughters-in-law with him.
"Did you get any good items, husband?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Luo Yunxiao. "I got the Abyssal Demon Heart, but I need to find the remaining four items to reach the advanced ranks. Additionally, I got two pills, a weapon, and a scroll."
"Are those two pills related to dual cultivation?" Yan Jinwu curiously asked.

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed and took out the two pills. "The golden-red pill is the Dragon-Phoenix Pill, and it will enhance the Yang Qi I release and the Yin Qi I obtain. This way, you guys will get more of my Yang Qi, and I will get more of my Yin Qi from you all. The effect will last a whole month, but this pill is quite rare and difficult to concoct, and we can only consume it once a year."
"Only a whole month?" Luo Yunxiao and the others were disappointed by the effect, mainly because their numbers were simply too numerous.

Zhang Fei [5] smiled amusedly and pinched their cheeks one by one. "Even though the effects only last a month, it’s not a big deal, right? I can release my Yang Qi almost without limitation, remember? Moreover, all of you won’t be able to accommodate too much of my Yang Qi, and I still have many other types of pills, so I think a whole month is excellent."
"Then, what is the second pill?" Huli Haohao asked, pointing his index finger at the deep red pill on his hand.

Zhang Fei [5] showed them the pill and explained, "This Nine Suns Flame Pill is one of the extreme Yang Pills, and its effect naturally boosts my Yang Qi. Its main ingredient is the Nine Suns Flame Fruit, and it grows once every thousand years under nine suns. We need several other very rare ingredients to concoct it, such as Sun Chalcedony, Dawn Flame Nectar, Solar Peony Petals, Firebird Blood Essence, and Inferno Wolf Beast core."
"Such a rare pill!" Huli Zhishen and the others claimed.
’Then, why did you only buy one, husband?’

Zhang Fei [5] pinched Zhu Lingyao’s nose. "Why are you being so greedy? This pill is truly rare and expensive, and Senior Puyang only has this one. If he had more, I would buy more for our seclusion."
’Oh!’ Zhu Lingyao nodded in understanding.
Zhang Fei [5] then put away the two pills. "By the way, those items aren’t cheap, and my pills aren’t valuable to Senior Puyang, so I don’t know if you’ll be able to get any good ones later."

"Hehe." Luo Yunxiao giggled and hugged his arm. "Husband, they are my sisters, and I have saved a lot over the past hundreds of years. If you don’t have enough jewels, I will use my savings to help them obtain the items they desire. My parents have all my needs met, so I don’t need to spend any jewels to buy my necessities, and I’ve saved everything since we returned to this realm."
"Sister Yunxiao, how much have you saved since then?" Wang Yourou and the others looked at her with expressions full of curiosity.
Luo Yunxiao shook her head at them. "Secret! I won’t tell you guys, but I’m sure my savings are enough for all of us."
"Hahaha!" Yan Jinwu laughed heartily and patted her shoulder. "It’s really nice to have an ultra-rich sister like you, Sister Yunxiao."

Zhang Fei [5] let out a soft sigh in his heart, especially since he had tried so hard to collect jewels for all his wives and family members after several years, but the results of all his efforts were hard to compare with the wealth of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.
Zhang Fei [5] then approached Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Su Yao, and the disciples from the Moonlit Passion Temple to discuss plans for the future of their sect.
Inside a magnificent black palace, several furious roars and the smashing of objects continued to be heard from within.

In the middle of the throne room, there are four beasts surrounding a screen showing the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu slaughtering the evil beast, and their expressions were full of anger as they watched that.
"Bastard! How dare that damned beast slaughter all our subordinates!" One of the four beasts in the throne room shouted furiously.
The four beasts are none other than the four perils: Taotie, Qiongqi, Taowu, and Hundun.

Taotie is a stocky quadruped beast with a bulky body covered in mottled gray, green, and reddish scales. It has a massive head with two large curved horns sweeping backwards, plus a single long central horn jutting forward. It has a wide and gaping mouth, full of sharp teeth.

Hundun looked like a pig; it had a round, plump body with no distinct neck or head. It lacks visible facial features, possessing a smooth, blank front. It has two large sets of black-and-white feathered wings emerging from the back. It has four short, stout legs, and its body is colored in warm orange-red tones.

Qiongqi is muscular-looking, with a tiger-like body covered in orange fur with black stripes. It has large fangs and sharp ears pointing backwards. It has large, feathered wings, bluish in color, sprouting from the shoulders. It has a long tail, elongated snout, and powerful limbs ending in clawed paws.

Taowu resembles a lion with powerful legs and a fierce gaze. Its feline face had a thick, pale blue mane, and its snout displayed rows of large, sharp teeth. It has two long tails with pronged tips, like serpents.
"Shut your mouth, Hundun! Your screams disturb my hearing!" Taowu spoke.
Hundun turned to him, but no one knew his expression, especially since he didn’t have a face. "What exactly is that beast? Why does it slaughter our subordinates?"
"Are you senile? Isn’t the beast’s identity clear?" Qiongqi responded with a shake of his head.

Taotie then spoke to them. "That beast is clearly the mysterious merchant’s mount, and it’s an ancient mythical beast, but it is entirely different from the beast that beat us in the past. The beast we faced in the past was indeed powerful, but it wasn’t as ferocious as this one."

"You’re right, brother." Qiongqi replied with a nod. "The beast only attacked our subordinates who attacked those natives, but it didn’t attack our passive subordinates. At that time, I believed I would die at the beast’s hands, but it chose to spare us due to its master’s orders; otherwise, the four of us would have perished long ago."

"Brr." Taowu shivered in fear, recalling the events from that time. "That damn beast back then had a small body, but its strength was too terrifying. I was already using my full strength at the time, but it blocked my all-out attacks with just its tail."
Taotie, Qiongqi, and Hundun also looked frightened after Taowu said that. "By the way, what about that foolish demon? Has he still not contacted you?"

"Not yet." Taotie shook his head in response. "The last time he contacted me was about two decades ago, but that was only about five months in that realm. At that time, he informed me that he had fought against a male human who possessed various elements, including both light and darkness. Additionally, he told me that the Abyssal Leviathan Demon Beast had resurfaced along with another beast whose identity was not yet clear, but I suspect that it was the Ancient Devourer Beast."
"Doesn’t our master want to get those two beasts? Do we need to inform him of their whereabouts?" Qiongqi asked.

"If you want to die, you can inform our master now." Qiongqi glared at Taowu. "Our master wanted to get those two beasts, but he ordered us to capture them, remember? What will happen if we report to him but haven’t captured them? Do you think he’ll spare us? Even if he does, he’ll punish us severely first."

Qiongqi nodded in agreement. "Since we can’t do anything in the Forbidden Land now, I think we should focus on the Three Mortal Realms first. We have too many tasks, and we haven’t completed any of them yet."

"Phew!" Hundun sighed before speaking. "We have tasks involving those two beasts, the ten demon seeds, the Nin Yin Soul Banner, the Abyssal Demon Heart, and many more. What if we send our other subordinates to that realm? I never believed in that foolish demon, and he has wasted too much time collecting all of them."
"No need." Taotie rejected Hundun’s idea. "Give him a few more years, and we’ll send our subordinates to the Three Mortal Realms if he still fails by then."
The other three frowned at him, but Taotie hurriedly left the throne. "What exactly happened to him? Why does he seem afraid of something in the Three Mortal Realms?"
"No one knows." Taowu replied with a shake of his head. "Apparently, we are not the only ones who lost many subordinates, and those demons have the same fate as us."
Qiongqi immediately walked away. "We lost too many subordinates today, so we must reorganize them; otherwise, we would be overwhelmed if those birds attacked us."
The situation in the Ten Hell Monarch Main Domain was also very chaotic, and the ten demon gods had gathered there to discuss the situation affecting their demon race.
"Can one of you explain the situation to me?" A female demon god asked them.

"It is a ferocious battle technique that ignites a body cultivator’s bloodline, turning it into an unstoppable force of destruction.
By burning vitality and channeling boundless killing intent, it will push our bodies beyond their natural limits, granting incredible strength, speed, and endurance.
However, we cannot use it continuously, especially since it will cost our bodies immense strain." Zhang Chen frowned in response to Zhang Fei’s explanation.
"This technique has five sub-techniques: Rending Battle Cry, Bloodline Rampage, Carnage State, Berserk Domain, and War God Descent."
"Why are the names of the sub-techniques so terrible?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed.
"You’re right, Grandma.
The names of the sub-techniques are terrifying, and so are their effects."
"Tell me."
[Rending Battle Cry: A soul-shaking roar infused with qi and killing intent.
Weak foes collapse instantly; stronger enemies feel their morale break and their blood churn.]
[Bloodline Rampage: It ignites blood qi, transforming it into scarlet flames.
The user’s muscles bulge, speed surges, and every strike explodes with destructive power.]
[Carnage State: A berserk trance where pain and fatigue vanish.
The more the user is wounded, the stronger they become.]
[Berserk Domain: Unleashes a bloody aura that spreads across the battlefield.
Enemies within feel their strength suppressed, while the user grows stronger with every drop of spilled blood.]
[War God Descent: The user’s body swells with Qi and killing intent, transforming into the phantom of an ancient War God, capable of toppling sects and slaughtering legions in a single rampage.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Chen looked horrified as she listened to all the effects.
"How long can you use that technique to avoid backlash?"
"I still haven’t learned the technique, so I can’t say for sure how much time I’ll have to use it.
However, I can probably use it for about half an hour to an hour, depending on which one I use.
The War God Descent will be the hardest, and it will probably be very taxing on my body." Zhang Chen looked at Zhang Fei with a serious gaze, hoping that he would not learn that technique.
However, she knew that she couldn’t possibly stop him if he had already decided something.
"Grandma, please trust me, okay?
I won’t use the technique rashly, and I will only use it when the situation forces me to use it."
Zhang Chen nodded at him.
"I’ve always believed in you, remember?
I know you won’t use it rashly, but I still have to remind you."
"You are always the best, Grandma!" Zhang Fei sat up, pulled Zhang Chen onto his lap, and gave her a deep, passionate kiss right away.
After more than two decades of intimate relations, Zhang Chen was no longer embarrassed by their relationship.
She wrapped her arms around his neck, returned his kiss, and followed his rhythm.
As their kiss became more passionate, Zhang Chen pushed Zhang Fei to lie down on the ground.
She then laid down by his side and kept kissing him, while her hand grabbed his dick and slowly jerked it.
In the distance, three women watched the two.
"Mom, why do I feel that my grandma is more aggressive than us?
Even though their relationship has long since reached the intimate stage, she still hasn’t dual-cultivated with big brother."
"I don’t know." Qing Yi answered her second daughter with a shake of her head.
"As you already know, your grandmother has only ever had a relationship with your grandfather, and she has not had any relationship with any man since she gave birth to your father.
Perhaps that’s because she lived in solitude for too long, and their relationship awakened her hidden desires."
"Shall we join them?"
"Don’t do it, Lin’er." Zhang Yue grabbed Zhang Lin’s hand.
"We shouldn’t disturb Grandma, even though she’s accustomed to our relationship.
Moreover, we have dual-cultivated with Fei’er too many times, so we have to give her the opportunity to enjoy their relationship."
Qing Yi agreed and pulled her two daughters away.
"Let’s take care of other things."
A while later, they had stopped kissing.
Zhang Chen looked at Zhang Fei with great affection, and her hand kept moving up and down, squeezing and jerking his dick.
"Fei’er, do you know how much I love you?"
"Grandma, I’ve always known how much you love me, and I’m truly grateful for that." Zhang Fei rubbed her cheeks.
"In all my life, you saved me twice from adversity.
The first was when Zhang Hai disowned me, and the second was when I fell almost under the control of my cursed demon heart.
You knew that it was too dangerous for you to go in there, but you still did it to save me.
I will never forget all that for the rest of my life, and you will always be the best grandmother for me."
"What kind of grandmother would do this kind of thing with her grandson?" Zhang Chen responded with a bitter smile.
"I let you see me naked, and we’ve made out intimately too many times in the past two decades.
Sometimes, I feel confused and disappointed in myself, but I can’t deny that I always enjoy our time together, and I want to step into the final stage with you.
However, there’s something in my heart that always prevents me from stepping onto that stage, and we haven’t done it because of that."
Zhang Fei shook his head slightly.
"Don’t think too much about it, Grandma.
Once you are completely ready, we will step onto that stage together, and I will bring ’happiness’ back into your life again."
"Hehe." Zhang Chen giggled upon hearing him mention ’happiness’.
"Make sure to make me happy then, okay?"
"I swear that I will make you happy, grandma." Zhang Fei then sat down again with Zhang Chen on his lap.
"The others are still busy with their breakthrough, so we will dual-soul cultivate first while waiting for them to finish."
"Alright."

At midnight, Zhang Fei’s [5] wives, allies, and acquaintances had finished meeting with Puyang Shangren.
Xuanyuan Zhuanxu wanted to lead them to some houses that had been prepared for them to wait for the auction, but Zhang Fei [5] and the others politely refused him.

Xuanyuan Zhuanxu was disappointed by their decision, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained to him that he still didn’t want to meet those cultivators and that they also wanted to train in other areas.
Xuanyuan Zhuanxu ultimately accepted Zhang Fei [5]’s decision and let him take the others away from the main town.
Thereafter, he let the cultivators who had been waiting outside for a whole day go inside to meet Puyang Shangren.
Since their numbers were too numerous, he ordered them to line up in an orderly manner, and he ordered people from the five clans to watch over them.
People from the Jiao Clan tried to look for them inside the city, as did members from the Fairy Race, but they were too late because they had already left.
Naturally, they didn’t want to miss the opportunity to meet Puyang Shangren and buy items from him, which forced them to ignore Zhang Fei [5], at least for now.
However, the native and guest cultivators didn’t notice the presence of the three female demon gods, as they blended in with the people as if they were one of them.
Moreover, they didn’t have their own demonic aura due to the disguise Wu Mian used on them, giving them more freedom.

While waiting for their turn, the three female demon gods tried to find out information about everything that happened in the domain before by listening to the people’s conversations, especially the conversations of the natives of the domain.
The three female demon gods were shocked when they heard the natives of the domain talking about Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Yao’s identity as Empress Huo Yanling.
However, the main thing that shocked them the most was their conversations about the return of the Eternal Flame.
’Since when has the Eternal Flame returned to this domain?’ The three female demon gods then sent a message to their trusted subordinates, ordering them to inform Mo Zhentian and the others about it.
Zhang Fei [5] did not take them back to the temple, but he took them to the forest to train against the beasts, especially since most of the beasts were equal opponents for them.
"Did you notice the presence of those three people?" Feng Yao asked Zhang Fei [5].

chapters.title: Chapter 1139: Auction Day
paragraphs: "They’re using disguises like Tian Shuixiang, but I can still recognize them." Zhang Fei [5] then asked Mei to open the data about the three female demon gods. "Qi Qingxiu is the Seven Emotion Demon God. Nalan Shizhe has the same surname as Nalan Yushu, so she should be the Soul-Devouring Demon God. I’ve never heard of Ye Mingran before, but I have Ye Zhiye here. I’ve also heard of Ye Fution, so I believe she’s the Eternal Night Demon God."

"You’re right about the three of them, but you should be more wary of Qi Qingxiu than Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Feng Yao with a questioning look, especially since he knew that Nalan Yushu’s abilities were quite terrifying, let alone the Soul-Devouring Demon God. "I’m not saying that the two of them aren’t powerful, but the Seven Emotion Demon God surpasses them, especially with her ability to control the emotions of living beings. Even though you have controlled your cursed demon heart, her abilities can still influence it, and you will turn into an evil demon if she uses them on you."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "I understand your concerns, but I am also aware of my weaknesses. Those three women clearly surpass everyone by my side, except for you and Huo Ling, so I wouldn’t be so crazy about meeting them."

"Hehe." Feng Yao giggled. "They came to this domain obviously to investigate the death of their subordinates and attend the auction, so you will meet them in two days. Who do you think among the people closest to you has the ability to tame the Sky-Severing Sword?"

Zhang Fei [5] considered several names, but he was uncertain whether any of his wives could tame the Sky-Severing Sword. "I think the one with the greatest chance to get the sword is my master, Han Ling."

"Han Ling’s talent in swordsmanship is excellent, and he has reached the god-rank, so I think his chances are indeed the greatest among them." Feng Yao then looked toward the distance, specifically the location of the main town. "There are many other God-rank sword masters here, and their talents cannot be underestimated. All of them will be present at the auction, so the battle to obtain the Sky-Severing Sword will be intense. However, the strongest competitor is the sword maniac, Jian Kuang."
"Oh? Who is Jian Kuang? Which sect did he come from?"

Feng Yao shook her head at him. "Jian Kuang never joined any sect, and he managed to become the strongest sword master in this realm through his own hard work and struggle. He won’t be here before the auction, so you should wait two more days to meet him, and you’ll understand why people dubbed him a sword maniac by then."
"Do you think I could ask him to spar with me?" Zhang Fei [5] asked with expectation in his eyes.

"Hahaha." Feng Yao laughed and patted his shoulder. "As the youngest sword master who managed to reach the god-rank and comprehended the sword dao, you don’t need to worry about that; I’m sure Jian Kuang will challenge you to a spar as soon as he sees you."
Zhang Fei [5]’s expression turned excited and impatient after hearing that, especially since he only had a few sparring opponents in swordsmanship. "Hey, spar with me and don’t hold back."

"Prepare to be battered then." After saying that, Feng Yao directly punched Zhang Fei [5]’s chest, sending him flying far back. She didn’t give him a chance to stabilize himself and attacked him again, causing him to grimace in pain. "You asked me not to hold back, so don’t regret your decision."
"Tch!" Zhang Fei [5] gritted his teeth and tried to attack Feng Yao, but her speed and strength simply surpassed him, and she effortlessly dodged his rapid attacks.

Not far from them, Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye sat side by side watching Feng Yao beat up Zhang Fei [5] without him being able to fight back even once. "Did you hear their conversation earlier, husband? My demon god is in this domain now, and I’m afraid that she will recognize my identity when we meet her at the auction later. Moreover, she didn’t come alone; she came together with the Seven Emotions Demon God and the Soul-Devouring Demon God. I’m not too afraid of Nalan Shizhe, but Qi Qingxiu is a different story, and there’s no way we can face her. Therefore, I am thinking of asking Zhang Fei to send us out of this domain, and we will continue our seclusion."

"I think the same as you," Tian Shuixiang replied with a serious expression. "The three of them are already troublesome, and we’ll face even greater trouble if my demon god finds out about our return."
"So, do you agree with my idea?"

Tian Shuixiang nodded at her. "Once Zhang Fei and Feng Yao finish their spar, we’ll go find him and ask him to send us out. If my demon god knows we have a relationship with him, he will definitely send his subordinates to attack him to capture us, so we have to stay away from him for now."

A few hours later, they had stopped their spar because Zhang Fei [5]’s condition was too miserable. His clothes were in tatters due to Feng Yao’s previous attacks, leaving many bruises all over his body, especially his face.

"Hah... Hah..." Zhang Fei [5] lay on the ground breathing heavily. Although he was in considerable pain and couldn’t put up any resistance against Feng Yao during their spar, he was still satisfied with the result. "Back then, Yunxiao beat me to a pulp when my cultivation was still at the Divine Expansion Realm, and you beat me this hard today."

Feng Yao squatted at his side and supported her chin. "Didn’t you ask for it yourself? No matter how strong you are, even after you evolve into the ten-tailed fox in the future, I will always be a few steps ahead of you. Therefore, you must forget your desire to get me as your wife, especially since it’s impossible to happen."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to her and inquired. "Is that so? Do I really have no chance of having you as my wife?"

"Yes and no." Zhang Fei [5] furrowed his brows, but Feng Yao only smiled without giving him a definite answer. They then looked at Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye, who were walking toward them. "You should send them out of this domain, especially since Ye Mingran will not fail to recognize members of her race. If she finds out they are close to you, you will face serious trouble with her demon race and the Asura Demon Race."

"Feng Yao is right, Zhang Fei." Tian Shuixiang spoke when he and Ye Zhiye arrived in front of them. "The Eternal Night Demon has a special method to recognize their members, and Ye Mingran will recognize my wife’s identity even if she is in disguise. Honestly, I still want to be here and attend the auction, but we have no other choice but to leave, so please send us out of this domain."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding and opened a gate. "You two will arrive at the Empyrean Main Domain like before."
"Thank you and see you again in the future." Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye immediately disappeared through the gate.

After he closed the gate, Feng Yao helped Zhang Fei [5] up. "Those three women should have heard about us from the people in the main town, and they might look for us soon. Therefore, you must be alert and send them to your training space immediately if they are really looking for us."
"Alright."

Another two days passed, but the situation in the past few days was not as Feng Yao had expected, especially since the three female demon gods did not seek them out. The Jiao Clan and the Fairy Race also did not move; instead, they waited for Zhang Fei [5] at the inn in the main town and never left their rooms.

Zhang Fei [5] repeatedly sparred with Feng Yao, even though the results remained the same as their first spar, leaving him in constant pain throughout the time. Despite this, he never forgot to complete the daily quests that appeared every day, assisted by the other four clones.
Zhang Fei [5]’s wives, family members, and acquaintances also never stopped fighting against the beasts in that area.
After they were ready and the sun was high enough in the sky, Huo Ling took them back to the main town, especially since the auction was about to start.

When they arrived, Xuanyuan Zhuanxu and several people from the other four clans were already waiting for them. They simply greeted Feng Yao and Huo Ling before leading them to the auction hall, where many cultivators had already gathered, including the three female demon gods.
Many curious, suspicious, and hateful gazes greeted them when they entered the building. Huo Ling immediately released her aura, deterring all of them, including the three female demon gods.
Feng Yao faintly smiled. "Lead us."

chapters.title: Chapter 1140: Su Shentian - Jian Kuang
paragraphs: ’Mingran, that kid must be Zhang Fei [5], and the two women by his side are the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling and the Eternal Flame.’ Nalan Shizhe spoke while stealing glances at the three. ’Moreover, there are so many young mythical beasts by their side, which makes me feel strange.’

Ye Mingran nodded in agreement. ’We don’t need to care about those young mythical beasts, but we must guard against Empress Huo Yanling and the Eternal Flame. Not to mention, the female winged race and the female dragon race are not ordinary members of their two races, and they should have high status in their races.’

’I don’t recognize the female winged race, but the female dragon is the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race, and the male dragon on her side is the third prince of the Void Dragon Race.’ Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe turned to Qi Qingxiu directly. ’I’ve seen them together with Tianshi Bailong and Long Xukong before, so I wouldn’t have mistaken their identities. Since they are both in this domain now, I think those two old dragons are most likely here too. Therefore, we should not act rashly, especially since those old dragons are slightly stronger than us.’

Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe nodded to Qi Qingxiu, who immediately shifted her gaze to Zhang Fei [5]. ’Who is he really? He is a Celestial Lord cultivator in his early forties, and I can sense a familiar aura from within his body. I need to find a way to approach him to confirm that aura, but I must be cautious of Empress Huo Yanling and the Eternal Flame by his side.’
In another area, people from the Jiao Clan kept looking at Zhang Fei [5], especially Jiao Huanfeng.

’Where is that person? Why hasn’t he come here yet? Could it be that my message a few days ago didn’t reach him?’ Jiao Huanfeng then tried to send another message to the person he intended without Jiao Suyin and their group members knowing. ’I hope he comes here soon, or this kid will disappear again.’

Just like him, Jiao Suyin also kept her eyes on Zhang Fei [5], wondering about his relationship with Feng Yao and the others. ’I still can’t believe that woman is the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling, and she seems to be protecting that kid. If we mess with him, our Jiao Clan will be in great danger. I have to think of another way to approach that kid, and it would be better if I recruited him into our clan.’
Like their elders, Jiao Meili and Jiao Moli seriously looked at Zhang Fei [5], but their gazes were filled with jealousy, mainly because of his alchemy rank.

Behind the two, Jiao Yunbai looked annoyed as he stared intensely at Luo Yunxiao. Their elders ordered him to monitor her and dig up information about her, but she and Zhang Fei [5] disappeared for days. ’Tch! I have to think of a way to get rid of that brat, and I’ll take that woman with me afterwards.’
"Do you really think he’s the person our king is looking for, Brother Leixuan?" A young male fairy asked another one.

"I’m not sure, Xiayu," Jia Leixuan replied as he looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Our king sent Jia Yuyan to the Three Mortal Realms to search for the successor of the ten-tailed fox, but she hasn’t sent any message to him since she left, and thousands of years have passed in this realm since then."
"Then, why does our king think that he is the one?" Jia Xiayu asked in confusion.

Jia Leixuan exhaled softly before telling him. "According to reports from members of our race training in the Moon Illusion Domain, that kid previously broke through to Celestial Lord there, and his breakthrough produced extraordinary phenomena. They witnessed him using several elements, and he had also comprehended the sword dao. Additionally, he managed to refine the core of his lightning tribulations, and not just anyone could do such a thing. Therefore, our king suspected that he was the successor of the ten-tailed fox, and he ordered us to bring that kid to him."

"Are we really going to do that?" Jia Xiayu stole a glance at Feng Yao. "Brother, that woman is Empress Huo Yanling, and the two of them seemed so close. Moreover, she was famous for being vicious in the past, and the late old Fairy King was defeated by her several times."

Jia Leixuan nodded slightly. "At first, I thought this was an easy task, but the presence of that woman and the Eternal Flame on his side made things difficult. We must not act rashly, and we will look for loopholes first before capturing him."
*Chatter... Chatter...*
The atmosphere in the building became lively as soon as the two men entered, and people started guessing their identities.
"Hey! Isn’t that man the sword maniac, Jian Kuang?"
"Who’s that man over here? Why haven’t I seen him before?"
"If I’m not mistaken, he’s that mysterious man!
"That’s right! He’s Su Shentian, the speed demon!"

Su Shentian wore a deep crimson robe patterned with golden embroidery, draped loosely over his broad shoulders to reveal his lean yet muscular chest and finely sculpted abs. He was quite handsome and charmed many of the female cultivators present, but his demeanor was indifferent and cold, and he enjoyed the wine in his gourd rather than paying attention to them.

On the other hand, Jian Kuang appeared like a scholar; he seemed calm and relaxed, yet no one could sense his presence despite him standing right in front of them. He wore plain clothes with a white sword on his back, and his eyes moved around looking for something.

Jian Kuang’s expression turned serious as soon as his gaze fell on Zhang Fei [5], who was also looking at him with full seriousness. A devilish smile instantly appeared on his face, and his sword aura spread across the room, causing the younger generations present to tremble and break out in cold sweat.
Su Shentian, who noticed this, immediately followed Jian Kuang’s gaze. "Oh? Does the presence of that young man make your blood boil, Old Jian?"

"Old Su, you’re not a sword cultivator like me, so you can’t sense his sword Qi. I can tell you that he’s the youngest god-rank sword master, and he’s also successfully comprehended the sword dao." Jian Kuang’s statement caused almost everyone to focus their gazes on Zhang Fei [5], and their expressions revealed shock at the realization that he had already reached the peak of swordsmanship and comprehended the sword dao. He then spoke to him. "Young man, my name is Jian Kuang, and I would like to challenge you to a sword sparring match. However, this isn’t a good time, so we’ll do it after this auction is over. What do you think about that?"

All the people present held their breath after Jian Kuang said that, especially since he took the initiative to challenge Zhang Fei [5], indicating that he acknowledged his talent. They stared at him intensely, waiting for his answer to the sword maniac’s challenge.

"Ha ha ha." Feng Yao, who was sitting beside Zhang Fei [5], immediately laughed upon hearing that. "See? What did I say to you three days ago? He will recognize your talent and challenge you directly, and the results are evident now. Since he has posed a challenge to you, you have to answer him, right?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Feng Yao, rose to his feet, and cupped his hand to Jian Kuang. "Senior Jian, my name is Zhang Fei, and I will accept your challenge."

"Hahaha!" Jian Kuang laughed heartily after hearing that. "I like you, kid! Usually, people would reject my challenge after hearing my name, but instead, I can see from the look in your eyes that you are eager to spar with me. Let’s do it after this auction is over, and I hope you won’t disappoint me."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "Don’t worry, Senior Jian. I won’t let you down as long as we spar only using our swordsmanship, especially since my cultivation is too low compared to yours."
"That’s for sure," Jian Kuang replied with a nod. "We are sword masters, so we will only fight using our abilities in swordsmanship."

Thereafter, Jian Kuang and Su Shentian went to the seats reserved for them. Before long, many other cultivators began arriving, including the Sect Master of the Divine Samsara Sect, Liang Huizhong, who came with several elders.
After the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu slaughtered all the demons, the seal on the portal immediately disappeared, allowing them to enter the domain through it.

After the venue was completely full, Puyang Shangren started the auction, but Zhang Fei [5] and the senior cultivators were not interested in the first batch of items. Unlike them, the younger cultivators scrambled to get those items, which made the bidding quite fierce.
"Are you really not going to buy those items, husband?" Luo Yunxiao asked.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "Those items are good and their grade is quite high, but they are useless to us, so we don’t need to waste jewels. Moreover, Senior Puyang has many interesting items, and he will likely only bring them out in the final phase of this auction, so we’ll wait for those items to come out."
"I see." Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "I’m more curious about who will get the Sky-Severing Sword in the end."

Why hasn’t he come here yet?

If we mess with him, our Jiao Clan will be in great danger.
I have to think of another way to approach that kid, and it would be better if I recruited him into our clan.’
Like their elders, Jiao Meili and Jiao Moli seriously looked at Zhang Fei [5], but their gazes were filled with jealousy, mainly because of his alchemy rank.
Behind the two, Jiao Yunbai looked annoyed as he stared intensely at Luo Yunxiao.
Their elders ordered him to monitor her and dig up information about her, but she and Zhang Fei [5] disappeared for days. ’Tch!
I have to think of a way to get rid of that brat, and I’ll take that woman with me afterwards.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1141: Heavenly Jade Brush
paragraphs: The auction has been ongoing for several hours, with numerous items already sold. However, Zhang Fei [5], his group, and several groups of senior cultivators hadn’t made any bids at all, confusing the bidders.
"Here they come." Feng Yao muttered softly.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "All the ordinary items have appeared and sold, so it’s time for Senior Puyang to bring out the main items."

All the cultivators present were quite powerful, both junior and senior cultivators, so they could hear Zhang Fei [5]’s words. Many people agreed with him, but many others sneered at him and said he was poor, so he assumed the valuable items in their hands were ordinary ones.
Zhang Fei [5] ignored those people and focused on Puyang Shangren, who took out a brush with a handle made of green jade.

"This Heavenly Jade Brush might not be useful for normal cultivators, but it is extremely valuable, and it is an immortal-grade tool used by formation masters. Its body is made of solid dawn jade, and the tip is made from qilin hair, allowing precise control of qi flow. Unlike ordinary brushes, it does not require ink, and array masters can use their Qi to create their arrays. Plus, they don’t need to use talisman paper to create one, and they can draw formation patterns directly onto any surface or even the air." Zhang Fei [5] was shocked to hear that, but Puyang Shangren’s next words made him smile bitterly. "The starting price of this brush is ten million golden jewels, and each minimum bid is one million golden jewels."
’Fuck! Ten million golden jewels just for one brush!’ Zhang Fei cursed in his heart.
"Array masters who want to obtain this brush can start bidding now."

"11 million." Zhang Fei [5] and the others looked at Qi Qingxiu, who had just bid for the brush. She smiled at their reaction and took out her brush. "I’m an array master, and my Moonshadow Brush is too old. Moreover, the Heavenly Jade Brush is much better than mine, so it’s only natural that I bid on it, right?"
Everyone just nodded to Qu Qingxiu, and then Puyang Shangren immediately asked the group a question. "Is there anyone else?"
"12 million." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Luo Yunxiao, who winked at him. ’I know you want the brush, so I’ll help you get it.’
Qi Qingxiu glared fiercely at Luo Yunxiao, but she immediately ignored her and raised the bid. "15 million!"
"20 million!"
"25 million!"
"30 million!" Luo Fenghan and his family smiled wryly as soon as Luo Yunxiao raised her bid, and the look in her eyes clearly showed that she was eager to get the brush for Zhang Fei [5].

Qi Qingxiu frowned at her as her face darkened, and she activated her abilities to control Luo Yunxiao’s emotions. However, she was shocked when her abilities had no effect on the little girl in front of her. ’How can she be immune to my abilities?’

"Qi Qingxiu." All the cultivators present gasped in shock as soon as Feng Yao mentioned that name. "Are you surprised that I was able to see through your disguise, the Seven Emotion Demon God? The two women by your side are Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran, the Soul-Devouring Demon God and the Eternal Night Demon God."
The three female demon gods were shocked to hear that, especially since they believed their disguises would be impenetrable, but Feng Yao was able to recognize their identities.

Puyang Shangren, the natives, and the guest cultivators turned their attention to the three female demon gods. The people from the Divine Samsara Sect wanted to make a move against them, but Liang Huizhong immediately stopped them because he would rather not have any trouble with the merchant.

Jian Kuang had already grasped the sword hilt on his back, but Su Shentian hurriedly grabbed his shoulder and shook his head, forcing him to abandon his intention to attack the three female demon gods.
"We—"
*Snap*

As soon as Feng Yao snapped her finger, the three female demon gods’ disguises disappeared and revealed their true forms, shocking them and the audience. ’How is this possible? How did she dispel our disguises?’

Feng Yao immediately spoke to them again. "There are no rules prohibiting demons from participating in this auction, so I won’t stop you three if you still want to participate and bid on the items. However, I won’t allow you to use your abilities to influence others’ decisions, and I will kill you if any of you dare to do it again, so you must compete with them fairly. Do you guys understand?"

Seeing that the three female demon gods did not immediately answer her master, Huo Ling right away moved behind them. "You guys should listen to my master; otherwise, I will burn your souls in eternal flame, and you guys will never be able to reincarnate."
’Crap! This woman is the Eternal Flame.’ The three female demon gods muttered to themselves. "Alright, we’ll compete fairly."
Huo Ling hurriedly returned to Feng Yao’s side, who immediately spoke to them. "You three better keep your word, or Ling’er will burn your souls."
Puyang Shangren shook his head with a bitter smile after seeing all this. "Do you still want to bid for the brush, Qi Qingxiu?"
"50 million."
Puyang Shangren nodded slightly and looked at Luo Yunxiao, who appeared to be in deep thought. "Do you want to give up?"
’Stop bidding on the brush, Yunxiao.’
Luo Yunxiao did not listen to Zhang Fei [5]. "75 million, Senior."

The atmosphere fell silent as everyone stared at Luo Yunxiao in confusion, especially since 75 million golden jewels was too much for a brush. ’Is she a member of a major clan? Why is she so eager to buy the brush at such a high price?’
Zhang Fei [5] sighed helplessly, especially since Luo Yunxiao was unwilling to listen to him. ’I know you’re rich, but 75 million is too expensive.’
’It’s okay; I still have more savings than that.’ Luo Yunxiao replied to him with a sweet smile.
Qi Qingxiu was truly irritated by Luo Yunxiao’s behavior, and she really wanted to use her abilities on her, but Feng Yao and Huo Ling kept staring at her. "I give up."
"Alright," Puyang Shangren spoke to Luo Yunxiao. "Send me the money."
Luo Yunxiao took out a storage ring before handing it to Puyang Shangren, who immediately counted the number of golden jewels inside.
After he finished, Puyang Shangren immediately handed the Heavenly Jade Brush to Luo Yunxiao, but she handed it to Zhang Fei [5], causing all of them to look at him with jealousy.
Qi Qingxiu frowned after seeing that, but she said nothing and waited for the next items.

Thereafter, Puyang Shangren started auctioning many other items, but Zhang Fei [5] had no interest in them. Instead, Luo Fenghan participated, bidding on several items that were useful for his two sons and daughter-in-law.
Zhang Fei [5]’s acquaintances were interested in some of those items, but their prices were too high for those from the Three Mortal Realms.

Several hours later, Puyang Shangren had sold many valuable items, and he took the last item, the Sky-Severing Sword. "The name of this sword is the Sky-Severing Sword, and it is rank 4 of the Seven Profound Treasures."
"What?" All participants exclaimed in shock as they stared at the sword in Puyang Shangren’s hand.
Jian Kuang squeezed the armrests of his chair as he trembled in excitement, amusing Su Shentian by his side. "What should we do to get that sword, Senior?"

"Unlike ordinary divine weapons, this Sky-Severing Sword was not created for defense but for utter destruction. A single slash can rip apart mountains, split rivers, and even tear through the air, leaving hollow scars that take centuries to heal. Legend has it that when its true power is unleashed, this sword can cleave apart the boundaries between realms, opening a rift that leads to the realm beyond." Jian Kuang couldn’t contain his excitement even more after Puyang Shangren said that. "Owning this sword is not difficult, and you don’t need to waste jewels to purchase it; however, you do need to gain its recognition. However, this sword does not accept a weak user, and it will test its wielder’s determination to defy the heavens. If they have a weak mentality and force themselves to wield it, it will shatter their cultivation, leaving them crippled. Therefore, you guys have to think carefully before deciding to try it, and I will not be responsible if you become crippled."

All of the participants took a deep breath because the risk was too great, despite the incredible value of the Sky-Severing Sword. Even Jian Kuang, who desperately wanted to obtain the sword, seemed to be struggling to make a decision.

’What a bunch of cowards!’ They don’t even dare to make a decision!’ Puyang Shangren muttered under his breath before looking at someone walking toward him from Zhang Fei [5]’s entourage. "What’s your name, little boy? Do you really dare to try the test this sword will give you?"
"Senior, my name is Han Ling." Han Ling then stood before him. "I am a sword cultivator, and the path of the sword is never easy. Even though the risks are great, I will still try."
Ye Mingran frowned as soon as Hang Lin summoned the Eternal Night Sword, and she quickly moved to his side. "Where did you get this sword?"

’What a bunch of cowards!’ They don’t even dare to make a decision!’ Puyang Shangren muttered under his breath before looking at someone walking toward him from Zhang Fei [5]’s entourage.
"What’s your name, little boy?
Do you really dare to try the test this sword will give you?"
"Senior, my name is Han Ling." Han Ling then stood before him.
"I am a sword cultivator, and the path of the sword is never easy.
Even though the risks are great, I will still try."
Ye Mingran frowned as soon as Hang Lin summoned the Eternal Night Sword, and she quickly moved to his side.
"Where did you get this sword?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1142: Sky-Severing Sword
paragraphs: ’Husband, why did your master decide to summon his sword in a place like this?’

Zhang Fei [5] remembered his old conversation with Han Ling. ’Back then, he told me that he wanted to look for Ye Futian for something, which was related to his late master. However, he had only just arrived in this domain at that time, so I forbade him to do so, and I took him to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary instead. Since Ye Mingran is the Eternal Night Demon God, he wants to use this opportunity to find that demon.’
’I see.’ Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding before asking Feng Yao. ’Do you think his decision will bring trouble for us, Big Sis Yao?’

Feng Yao shook her head in response. ’Even if these people knew about Han Ling’s relationship with the Eternal Night Demon Race, they wouldn’t be able to accuse him of conspiring with them. If you can see it, his aura is pure white without the slightest stain. There is no evil in him because he has long been at peace with himself; he is much more righteous and benevolent compared to these people.’
’Hmm?’ Luo Yunxiao observed Han Ling seriously, but she was confused by Feng Yao’s answer about him.

"Senior, I got this sword from my late master, and he got it from my grandmaster, Ye Futian, when he was looking for his daughter in the Three Mortal Realms." Han Ling’s revelation shocked the audiences, but the female sword spirit immediately came out of the sword as soon as he summoned her out. "You should be able to recognize Yong Heng, right?"
"Is what he said just now true?" Ye Mingran asked the female sword spirit directly.

Yong Heng hurriedly explained. "Demon God, my master did not lie to you. Master Ye Futian handed his sword to my master’s late master and took him as his disciple, mainly because he was amazed by his talent in swordsmanship. Before his master died, he passed the sword to him, and he has been my master since then."
Then, Ye Mingran asked Han Ling another question. "Did you show this sword on purpose?"

Han Ling nodded at her. "Before my master died, he left me a letter, asking me to hand it over to Grandmaster Ye Futian if I ever had the chance to ascend to this realm. Since you are the Eternal Night Demon God, I deliberately took out this sword, and I hope you are willing to take me to see him."
"Aren’t you afraid of death?" Ye Mingran asked with narrowed eyes. "Look at these people; they can’t wait to kill me, and they will kill you if you have any relationship with my race."

Han Ling smiled when he heard that. "Isn’t death a part of life? There is no immortality; even the strongest cultivators will die at the end of their lifespan. Moreover, I have achieved everything in this life, except for peak cultivation. So, why should I be afraid of death?"

Unlike most of the auction participants who booed Han Ling, Puyang Shangren looked amazed at him after hearing all that. He didn’t interrupt them and let them finish their conversation first, especially since it was related to the wills of dead people.

Ye Mingran was also quite impressed by Han Ling. "I can take you to see Ye Futian, but my domain is a demon domain, and the demon aura there will turn you into a demon. If you turn into one, people will curse and hate you, and you will never be able to return to those closest to you."

"Hahaha." Han Ling laughed at that. "In my entire life, I have met countless people from many races, be they humans, winged races, beasts, demons, or natural races. Many of them acted in the name of righteousness, but in reality, they were far worse than demons. They did not only betray their friends, but they also betrayed their families. Instead, I knew several demons who helped other people a lot, and they helped them without anything in return. Even if I had to become a demon and become an enemy of many people to convey my late master’s will to Grandmaster Ye Futian, I would never regret my decision."

The atmosphere fell silent after Han Ling spoke, but many people felt insulted by his words, which implied that they were far worse than demons, causing their faces to flush with anger. They wanted to attack him, but their guts sank as soon as they remembered that he was in the same group as Feng Yao.
*Clap... Clap...*

Jian Kuang suddenly clapped as he stood up from his seat. "Little Han, your words are true. Not all humans, winged races, beasts, or natural races are righteous people. As you just said, many of them are hypocrites, and I know of a race whose members dared to betray and kill their previous king. On the other hand, not all demons are evil, and there are many good demons out there. Unfortunately, such a mindset has been passed down since ancient times, and it will continue to be passed down to the generations after us."

The faces of Jia Leixuan and the members of the fairy race darkened after Jian Kuang mentioned that, and everyone’s eyes immediately turned to them, especially because of the rumors circulating outside about the current fairy king killing his predecessor.
Jia Leixuan squeezed the armrest of his chair until it cracked. ’This bastard! He’s truly tired of living! I will report this matter to my king!’

"Hahaha." Jian Kuang suddenly laughed. "It seems that some people here feel offended by my words, particularly given those are unproven rumors. By the way, I won’t interrupt the conversation between the two of you anymore, and you should decide quickly, especially since I can’t wait to try the tests of the Sky-Severing Sword."

"Yes." Han Ling nodded to Jian Kuang before speaking to Yan Mingran again. "Please take me to your domain after this, and I will leave immediately after I hand over my late master’s letter to grandmaster Ye."

"Since you insist, I’ll take you with me after this auction." Ye Mingran immediately flew back to her two friends’ side and sat back down in her chair with her gaze still focused on Han Ling. She then sent a voice transmission to Ye Futian, informing him about the matter.
Puyang Shangren then handed the Sky-Severing Sword to Han Ling. "You must know your limits and weaknesses, or this sword will kill you."

"I understand, senior." Han Ling stored the eternal night sword in his storage ring again before accepting the Sky-Severing Sword. He held the hilt with one hand, and he held the scabbard with the other. He then activated his sword Qi and channelled it into the sword, but he suddenly received a strong attack on his mental strength, causing him to stagger backwards.
Han Ling felt extremely dizzy as many memories appeared by themselves in his mind, which were the memories of the Sky-Severing Sword.
*Clang*
The Sky-Severing Sword fell to the floor at the same time as Han Ling Yang fell to his knees. He breathed heavily as his head became truly heavy, not physically but mentally. "Hah... Hah..."
Puyang Shangren released a heavy sigh and sucked the sword into his hand. "I admit your talent in swordsmanship, but unfortunately, this sword does not want you to become its master."

"Yes, Senior." Han Ling quickly calmed himself down and stood up. Although he failed to obtain the Sky-Severing Sword, there was no hint of disappointment in his expression, and he returned to his seat with his head held high.
Jian Kuang didn’t immediately take his turn and thought deeply while staring at the Sky-Severing Sword, as he felt something was wrong with it.
"Don’t you want to try it now?" Puyang Shangren asked him.
Jian Kuang shook his head slightly. "Let those who want to try it go first, Senior."
’This kid seems to have realized it.’ Puyang Shangren then asked the others. "Do any of you want to try to obtain this sword? Or are you just cowardly sword masters who don’t have the guts to try?"
Puyang Shangren’s words offended and excited the sword masters present simultaneously, prompting them to hurriedly take their turns to try to obtain the Sky-Severing Sword.
People kept trying to get the Sky-Severing Sword, but to no avail. The sword refused to accept any of them as its master, and some of them were injured because they were too arrogant and greedy.

After everyone had taken their turn, Jian Kuang finally took his. He didn’t immediately try to unsheathe the sword from its scabbard; instead, he rubbed it and tried to speak to it. However, the sword didn’t respond to him, confusing him. ’I can sense the spirit’s presence within this sword, but it doesn’t want to communicate with me. Usually, sword spirits will answer my call even if they are unwilling to accept me as their master, but the one inside this sword seems different from them.’
’Sigh!’ Puyang Shangren sighed inwardly, certain that Jian Kuang would also fail to gain the recognition of the Sky-Severing Sword. "How is it?"
"Phew." Jian Kuang sighed in disappointment and returned the sword to him. "This sword and I have no predestined ties, Senior."
Just as Puyang Shangren was about to receive the Sky-Severing Sword from Jian Kuang, the sword suddenly released a strong vibration and hurtled towards someone, shocking both of them. "Hmm?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1143: Sky-Severing Sword Spirit
paragraphs: "Haha." Feng Yao laughed softly as the Sky-Severing Sword hovered in front of her. Instead of grabbing the sword, she flicked her fingers and threw it back. "You are indeed one of the seven profound treasures, but you are not worthy of being by my side. Furthermore, I am not a weapon wielder, and my Ling’er is more powerful than a piece of metal like you, so you can choose someone else to be your master."

Puyang Shangren, Jian Kuang, and the other cultivators looked at Feng Yao with bitter smiles on their faces. All of them eagerly wanted to obtain the sword, but she rejected it and referred to it as merely a piece of metal.

The Sky-Severing Sword returned to Feng Yao before shining brightly, dazzling the eyes of those cultivators for a while. Soon, a teenage man with waist-length white hair emerged from within the sword, and he looked at Feng Yao in annoyance. He chose her as his master, but she blatantly rejected him. "Why are you rejecting me? No one here is worthy of being my master."

"Hahaha!" Feng Yao responded with a loud laugh. "You may think they don’t deserve to be your master, but as I said before, you don’t deserve to be with me. Your choice is only one of them, and you will never find your master if you don’t choose one of them today."
"You—"

"Shut up, rusty metal!" Huo Ling immediately moved behind the sword and grabbed the hilt. "If you dare force my master to accept you, I will burn you alive, and this sword will disappear from the list of the seven profound treasures forever."
The male sword spirit turned back to Huo Ling and wanted to yell at her, but his body became scorching as soon as she used the Eternal Flame to burn him. "Ahhh! No! Stop! Don’t burn me!"
"Then, shut the fuck up and choose one of them as your master!" Huo Ling fiercely glared at the sword spirit.

The male sword spirit nodded vigorously. "But who should I choose to be my master, Big Sis? Many of them are indeed god-ranked sword masters, but they are just useless people, and they are not worthy to wield me!"
Jian Kuang and the other sword masters’ faces darkened, especially since most of them had reputations and were respected in the Paradise Realm; instead, the male sword spirit considered them useless.
"Him." Huo Ling pointed at Zhang Fei [5]. "I never liked him, but I have to admit that he is your best choice."
"Hmm?" The male sword spirit looked at Zhang Fei [5] and scowled. "Tch! He is indeed a god-rank sword master, but he is too weak and immature, so I don’t want to be his sword!"
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly before summoning the demon extermination sword, and the twin female sword spirits immediately came out of the sword.

Jian Kuang and the other sword masters briefly looked at the demon extermination sword, but none of them were interested in it due to its low grade, and it could not be compared with the Sky-Severing Sword at all. On the other hand, the twin female sword spirits piqued their curiosity because twin spirits were supposed to be weak, with their strength divided in half. However, they could see that the strength of the two was not divided, and each of them was extremely powerful. Additionally, the twin spirits clearly possess two distinct elements: light and darkness, which should not be possible.

In contrast to the others, Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, and Nalan Shizhe furrowed their brows as they gazed at the demon extermination sword, particularly because it evoked unsettling feelings in them, especially the presence of Jian Guang’an with her light element.

"You say I’m weak and immature, but you’re no different from a snooty brat compared to my two spirit wives. You’ve lived longer than them, but your soul power is too weak compared to theirs." The male sword spirit wanted to refute him, but Zhang Fei [5] swiftly released his soul domain and suppressed his soul, which shocked not only the male sword spirit but also the audience. "You have had no master for too long, and your soul has weakened because you have been confined within the Sky-Severing Sword. The seven profound treasures are indeed extraordinary, but not with the current Sky-Severing Sword, and you are its weakness. As long as you’re picky about your master, you’ll never succeed in finding one, and you’ll continue to weaken. In the end, the sword will become nothing more than a piece of sword junk, and its true power will never be revealed."
The male sword spirit opened his mouth to refute Zhang Fei [5], but no words came out of his mouth. Instead, he lowered his face and started sobbing, perplexing all of them.

Zhang Fei [5] turned to Feng Yao, who nodded in understanding and snapped her fingers. In that instant, everyone in the building fell unconscious, except for Puyang Shangren and those closest to them.

Puyang Shangren was quite shocked by Feng Yao’s actions, but then Zhang Fei [5] spoke to the male sword spirit again. "I already have my sword and my twin spirit wives, and I’m satisfied with them. Moreover, I can still upgrade my sword two more times, and it won’t be inferior to the Sky-Severing Sword by then, so it doesn’t matter to me if you’re willing to become my sword. However, I have many sword masters by my side, and I can bring them here if you’re willing to give them a chance. What do you think about that?"
"Hmm?" The male sword spirit looked at Zhang Fei [5] while thinking. "Please bring them here, and I will see if any of them are suitable to be my master."
"Sure." Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the portal to the training space, leaving Puyang Shangren shocked. "Wait a moment."
The male sword master nodded at him. "Alright."

’Where does this portal connect to?’ Puyang Shangren inwardly wondered as he looked at Liu Qingyu, who was walking out while leading several others, such as Xu Ling’er, Zhang Lingxue, Xian Xianqin, Zhou Shenxin, and several other women who were sword masters. ’Who are these women? Where did they come from?’
Zhang Fei [5] immediately spoke again. "They are my wives, and you should be able to feel the power of their sword Qi."
"Huh?" The male sword spirit and Puyang Shangren were shocked to hear that. "Are these women really your wives?"

"Why don’t you try to sense my Yang Qi inside their bodies?" The male sword spirit and Puyang Shangren immediately did so, and they discovered Zhang Fei [5]’s Yang Qi was rich and thick within their bodies. "There are many of them, so you can test them now."
"Yeah." The male spirit sword brought the Sky-Severing Sword to Liu Qingyu first. "Grab the hilt, and I will check your worthiness to be my master."
Liu Qingyu nodded and grabbed the hilt, but her head became heavy, just as Han Ling and the other sword masters had experienced.
Zhang Fei [5] teleported behind Liu Qingyu and supported her as soon as she staggered backwards, and the Sky-Severing Sword slipped from her grasp. "Does this mean I failed, husband?"

"You are interesting, but you are still not worthy of my master." Liu Qingyu nodded to the male sword spirit, who immediately brought the sword before Xian Xianqin. "I can tell that you are more skilled than her in swordsmanship, but I still have to test you to determine your worthiness."

Xian Xianqin nodded, calmed her mind, and grabbed the sword hilt. Just like Liu Qingyu, she also felt her head grow heavy as countless memories flooded into her mind, weighing heavily on her mental strength.
Despite this, Xian Xianqin managed to endure it for quite some time, but she still failed in the end, disappointing her. "I failed, husband."
"It’s okay." Zhang Fei [5] supported her and rubbed her back. "After all, the Sky-Severing Sword is one of the seven profound treasures, and not everyone can wield it."
"Uhm." Xian Xianqin nodded slightly.
Thereafter, the male sword spirit tested Zhou Shenxin and several other women, but none of them were worthy of becoming masters of the Sky-Severing Sword.

The male sword spirit then brought the Sky-Severing Sword before the final woman, who was none other than Xu Ling’er. "I felt something strange hidden in you, and I felt familiar with it, but I had a hard time recognizing it because it was too vague."
"Xu Ling’er." Xu Ling’er looked at Tian Huangjin, who had already taken out the Holy Radiance Sword, confusing her race members. "Use this first."

Xu Ling’er caught the sword as soon as Tian Huangjin threw it at her, and a golden aura quickly enveloped her body. Within a few minutes, the golden aura disappeared, and she had transformed into her past figure, causing the jaws of the members of the winged race to drop.

The male sword spirit and Puyang Shangren were surprised by Xu Ling’er’s transformation, as she had previously appeared to be an ordinary human; however, she suddenly transformed into a member of a winged race, and her aura was more soothing than that of Tian Huangjin and the others.
"Hey, Huangjin! Is she really who I think she is?" A female winged race asked.
Tia Huangjin nodded at her. "You are right, Tian Zhiling. She is the reincarnation of our first ancestor, Tian Huangjin."

In the end, the sword will become nothing more than a piece of sword junk, and its true power will never be revealed."
The male sword spirit opened his mouth to refute Zhang Fei [5], but no words came out of his mouth.
Instead, he lowered his face and started sobbing, perplexing all of them.
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Feng Yao, who nodded in understanding and snapped her fingers.
In that instant, everyone in the building fell unconscious, except for Puyang Shangren and those closest to them.
Puyang Shangren was quite shocked by Feng Yao’s actions, but then Zhang Fei [5] spoke to the male sword spirit again.
"I already have my sword and my twin spirit wives, and I’m satisfied with them.
Moreover, I can still upgrade my sword two more times, and it won’t be inferior to the Sky-Severing Sword by then, so it doesn’t matter to me if you’re willing to become my sword.
However, I have many sword masters by my side, and I can bring them here if you’re willing to give them a chance.
What do you think about that?"
"Hmm?" The male sword spirit looked at Zhang Fei [5] while thinking.
"Please bring them here, and I will see if any of them are suitable to be my master."
"Sure." Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the portal to the training space, leaving Puyang Shangren shocked.
"Wait a moment."
The male sword master nodded at him.
"Alright."

’Where does this portal connect to?’ Puyang Shangren inwardly wondered as he looked at Liu Qingyu, who was walking out while leading several others, such as Xu Ling’er, Zhang Lingxue, Xian Xianqin, Zhou Shenxin, and several other women who were sword masters. ’Who are these women?
Where did they come from?’
Zhang Fei [5] immediately spoke again.
"They are my wives, and you should be able to feel the power of their sword Qi."
"Huh?" The male sword spirit and Puyang Shangren were shocked to hear that.
"Are these women really your wives?"

"Why don’t you try to sense my Yang Qi inside their bodies?" The male sword spirit and Puyang Shangren immediately did so, and they discovered Zhang Fei [5]’s Yang Qi was rich and thick within their bodies.
"There are many of them, so you can test them now."
"Yeah." The male spirit sword brought the Sky-Severing Sword to Liu Qingyu first.
"Grab the hilt, and I will check your worthiness to be my master."
Liu Qingyu nodded and grabbed the hilt, but her head became heavy, just as Han Ling and the other sword masters had experienced.
Zhang Fei [5] teleported behind Liu Qingyu and supported her as soon as she staggered backwards, and the Sky-Severing Sword slipped from her grasp.
"Does this mean I failed, husband?"
"You are interesting, but you are still not worthy of my master." Liu Qingyu nodded to the male sword spirit, who immediately brought the sword before Xian Xianqin.
"I can tell that you are more skilled than her in swordsmanship, but I still have to test you to determine your worthiness."
Xian Xianqin nodded, calmed her mind, and grabbed the sword hilt.
Just like Liu Qingyu, she also felt her head grow heavy as countless memories flooded into her mind, weighing heavily on her mental strength.
Despite this, Xian Xianqin managed to endure it for quite some time, but she still failed in the end, disappointing her.
"I failed, husband."
"It’s okay." Zhang Fei [5] supported her and rubbed her back.
"After all, the Sky-Severing Sword is one of the seven profound treasures, and not everyone can wield it."
"Uhm." Xian Xianqin nodded slightly.
Thereafter, the male sword spirit tested Zhou Shenxin and several other women, but none of them were worthy of becoming masters of the Sky-Severing Sword.
The male sword spirit then brought the Sky-Severing Sword before the final woman, who was none other than Xu Ling’er.
"I felt something strange hidden in you, and I felt familiar with it, but I had a hard time recognizing it because it was too vague."
"Xu Ling’er." Xu Ling’er looked at Tian Huangjin, who had already taken out the Holy Radiance Sword, confusing her race members.
"Use this first."
Xu Ling’er caught the sword as soon as Tian Huangjin threw it at her, and a golden aura quickly enveloped her body.
Within a few minutes, the golden aura disappeared, and she had transformed into her past figure, causing the jaws of the members of the winged race to drop.

The male sword spirit and Puyang Shangren were surprised by Xu Ling’er’s transformation, as she had previously appeared to be an ordinary human; however, she suddenly transformed into a member of a winged race, and her aura was more soothing than that of Tian Huangjin and the others.
"Hey, Huangjin!
Is she really who I think she is?" A female winged race asked.
Tia Huangjin nodded at her.
"You are right, Tian Zhiling.
She is the reincarnation of our first ancestor, Tian Huangjin."

chapters.title: Chapter 1144: Leave The Forbidden Land
paragraphs: Puyang Shangren furrowed his brows. ’Is that little girl really the reincarnation of the first ancestor of the winged race? If that’s true, then she should be much older than all the ancient races.’
The male sword spirit was stunned as his eyes stared at the Holy Radiance Sword in Xu Ling’er’s hand, and his body visibly trembled.
Tian Huangjin hurriedly led her race members before Xu Ling’er, knelt on one knee, and greeted her. "Ancestor."

"Get up," Xu Ling’er said, shaking her head. "I was Tian Huangjin in the past, but the current me is Xu Ling’er. I’m still in my mid-thirties, so I want all of you to stop addressing me as your ancestor."

All of them nodded and stood up, but they still maintained their respectful attitude toward Xu Ling’er. Tian Huangjin then spoke to her. "I don’t understand how you guys grew up so fast; you were only eleven when we last met. However, you have become a mature woman in your mid-thirties, and you have also become his wife."
Tian Zhiling and the others looked at Zhang Fei [5]. ’Since he is our ancestor’s husband, he is now our ancestor too, right?’

"My younger self has waited too long to become his wife, and she became his wife once she reached 18 years old. Unfortunately, she still hasn’t gotten all my memories, and she’s only gotten a tenth of them, so she can’t use my true strength yet." Xu Ling’er then looked at the male sword spirit. "Long time no see, Ling."
"You... you... are you really Tian Huangjin?" Ling asked with a trembling voice because of excitement.

Xu Ling’er grabbed the hilt of the sword and rubbed the blade. "It’s really me, Ling. Even though a long time has passed, I can still clearly remember the process when Tiankong Changqiong forged the Sky-Severing Sword in the past. He used the Firmament Ancient Steel, Void Essence Ore, Ancient Flameheart Crystal, Bone of the Sky-Tyrant Beast, and Sky Soul Orb to forge it. He spent a thousand years forging it, then he placed the newborn you into it once it was finished, and you have been its spirit ever since."

"Hua... Hua..." Ling cried loudly as she hugged Xu Ling’er. "I... I always thought that I was the only one left from our era, and I thought all of you had disappeared from this universe, but you still exist to this day."

Xu Ling’er let out a soft sigh and hugged him back. "In fact, the others still exist to this day, but my younger self still hasn’t regained my past memories, so she can’t look for their reincarnation yet."
"Does... does that mean my master was also reincarnated in this era?" Ling asked with a sob.

"Yes." Xu Ling’er nodded at him. "If you are patient, I’m sure you will meet his reincarnation one day. However, he may not be the same person he once was, and he may not be able to wield this sword again. As my husband said, you must not be too picky in choosing your new master; otherwise, you will continue to weaken, and this Sky-Severing Sword will also lose its true power."
"But—"

Xu Ling’er pushed him back a little. "I want to be your master, but you should already be aware that I will never be able to wield the Sky-Severing Sword, right? Moreover, I already have this Holy Radiance Sword, which was also forged by Tiankong Changqiong in the past. Therefore, I can’t be your master, and you must choose someone else."
"Yeah." Ling nodded slightly before looking at the other woman. "Which of them is worthy to be my new master?"

"Her." Xu Ling’er pointed at Xian Xianqin. "Among them, she lasted the longest in your previous test. Moreover, our husband has taught her the Heaven-Severing Sword Technique, and that technique is a complement to the Sky-Severing Sword, so she is your best choice."

"What... what..." Ling stuttered when he heard that. "Have... have those two truly mastered the Heaven-Severing Sword Technique? Where... where did they get that technique book? It... it has disappeared since you all died."

"Our husband obtained the technique in a realm called the Sovereign Heaven Realm, which is located in the Three Mortal Realms," Xu Ling’er’s answer left him stunned. "Not only did Xian Xianqin and our husband master the technique, but Zhou Shenxin and the others have also mastered it. If you don’t believe me, we can go out now, and they will show you."
Xian Xianqin and the others nodded to Ling as soon as he looked at them, and Zhang Fei [5] led them away. "Let’s go out, and we’ll show you."
"Yeah." Xu Ling’er immediately brought Ling and the Sky-Severing Sword after them.
Puyang Shangren, who was curious about the sword skills of Zhang Fei [5] and the others, followed them immediately out of the building.
After they arrived outside, all of them immediately flew quite high in the sky, and Zhang Fei [5] was the first to show Jian Ling his mastery in using the Heaven-Severing Sword Technique.
Zhang Fei [5] used the technique from the first move, the severing slash, to the final move, the severing of the heavenly path, leaving Ling and Puyang Shangren dumbfounded.
After that, it was Xian Xianqin and the others’ turn to demonstrate their skills in using the technique, but some of them still couldn’t use the final move.
After they finished, Xu Ling’er gave the Sky-Severing Sword to Zhang Fei [5]. "Use this sword to maximize the power of that technique, husband."

"Alright." As soon as he received the Sky-Severing Sword from Xu Ling’er, Zhang Fei [5] immediately used all the techniques of the Heaven-Severing Sword Technique, which increased the power of each technique several times higher. "Amazing sword and sword technique!"
Despite this, Zhang Fei [5] did not want to have the Sky-Severing Sword for himself. He asked all his wives, who were sword masters, to try the sword.
At the end of the session, Ling chose Xian Xianqin as his new master after considering everything. For him, Zhang Fei [5] was the best choice, but the two did not want each other, so he chose her.

Puyang Shangren exhaled in relief as the Sky-Severing Sword chose its master. "Since this sword has chosen you, you can have it, little girl. I will tell my great-grandfather about his choice, and I’m sure he will be relieved by this."
"Thank you, Senior Puyang." Xian Xianqin responded by cupping her hand.
Puyang Shangren nodded slightly and then asked Feng Yao. "Are you all leaving now? What about those people?"

"They will wake up by themselves, so you don’t need to think about them, and you don’t need to tell them about the choice of this sword." Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei [5], who immediately sent most of his closest people into the training space, except for Luo Fengyan and his family. "Wake them up first, and we will leave this domain after that."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned to the building, and he woke up Qing Qiu’er and the people from the Moonlit Passion Temple, who were confused about their situation. As for Jian Kuang, he left a message for him and asked him to meet him at the Moonlit Passion Temple to fulfill their spar promise.
Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] led them to meet Feng Yao and the others, and he immediately took them away from the Forbidden Land, except for Han Ling, Tian Huangjin, and Tianshi Shengjie.
Tian Huangjin and Tianshi Shengjie immediately led the members of their races out of the Forbidden Land.

After they disappeared, they returned to the building. Puyang Shangren woke up the natives, like Xuanyuan Zhuanxu and the others. However, he chose not to wake the guest cultivators and instead waited for them to awaken on their own.

Xuanyuan Zhuanxu and the other natives were disappointed that Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Yao decided to leave without saying goodbye to them, but Puyang Shangren told them that the two would definitely come back soon.

Puyang Shangren then woke up the three female demon gods, who immediately jumped away in shock. However, he immediately restricted their movements, rendering them unable to move even an inch. "They’re gone, and they left this little boy here because he wanted to go to your demon domains."
Nalan Shizhe and Qi Qingxiu did not say anything and nodded to Puyang Shangren. On the other hand, Ye Mingran asked Han Ling, "Are you sure you want to go to my domain?"
"I’ve made up my mind, Senior." Han Ling answered with determination.
Ye Mingran nodded slightly. "Let’s go now."
Shortly after they left, the guest cultivators began to wake up one by one. Puyang Shangren and the natives didn’t explain the details to them, including the choice of the Sky-Severing Sword.

Su Shentian was disappointed with Zhang Fei [5] and the others’ decision, but Jian Kuang told him that he had asked him to visit the Moonlit Passion Temple, and the two of them hurriedly left the Forbidden Land.
The members of the Fairy Race grew increasingly suspicious of Zhang Fei [5]’s identity, and they hurriedly returned to the Floral Mirage Domain to report to their king.

Once everyone had left, Puyang Shangren immediately bid farewell to the natives. He and the Ancient Leiyu Tianlu decided to return to their realm immediately. "Don’t worry, Tianlu. You’ll definitely meet that kid again in the future, and I look forward to his progress at that time."
