chapters.title: Chapter 1145: Twin Flames Domain
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] first went to the alchemy shop to meet Luo Lianjin, and he left a message for Jin Nanqing through him, asking him to go to the Moonlit Passion Temple to meet.

Given that Luo Fenghan had been absent for some time, Zhang Fei [5] sent his father-in-law back to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary. As for Luo Zhenyu, Luo Jiaxuan, Cheng Mengyao, and Bing Xingying, he let them train in the training space first.
"Are you going to bring them back to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain?" Zhang Fei [5] asked Feng Bingying.

Feng Bingying nodded at him. "At first, I wanted to take them to explore the Forbidden Land, but the presence of those demons and evil beasts ruined our plans. Since there is nothing else we can do here, I will bring them back to our domain, and I hope you are willing to take your big sister and the others there someday."

"Once she’s strong enough, I’ll take my big sister there." Feng Bingying immediately led her race members to leave the Divine Samsara Sect, and Zhang Fei [5] then asked Feng Yao. "Are you going to take your parents back to the Flame Spirit Citadel now?"

Feng Yao replied with a nod. "Your training space is excellent, but that place is much better for fire phoenixes like us. Once I’m ready to take them to the Blazing Nirvana Domain, I’ll contact you and take you with us."
"Okay." After Zhang Fei [5] summoned Feng Tian and Feng Jiu out of the training space, Feng Yao and Huo Ling immediately took them away.
"Aren’t you going to bring your people to our sect?" Qing Qiu’er asked him.
"I’ll take them there, but we don’t need a big group, and I’ll summon them when we arrive." Zhang Fei [5] then opened the gate leading to the border. "Get in."
Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling immediately led the members of the Moonlit Passion Temple into the gate, but Zhang Fei [5] first observed several areas of the Divine Samsara Sect before following them.
Shortly after they left, Tian Huangjin and Tianshi Shengjie walked out of the portal, followed by members of both their races.
Long Youjia directly opened a void tunnel, and he took Tianshi Shengjie and the other beast race members away through it, speeding up their return.
Meanwhile, Tian Huangjin warned the members of his race. "Don’t tell anyone that we met our first ancestor. Do you guys understand?"
"Why is that, Huangjin?" Tian Zhiling asked in confusion.

A male member of the winged race immediately explained this to her. "Zhiling, not all members of our race will welcome the news of our first ancestor’s return, especially Elder Qiye and her loyalists. That’s one reason our leader didn’t send any of our members from their side here, and the second reason is that he wants to hinder their development, especially since their development has been too rapid in the past few hundred years."
"Did your father tell you about all that, Huotian?"
"Hahaha." Tian Huotian laughed softly. "My father is one of the grand elders, remember? Moreover, Elder Qiye and her loyalists have never liked him and Elder Yizu, so they are very wary of her."

Tian Zhiling nodded in understanding. "You’re right, Elder Qiye is indeed a hypocrite. Despite her outward kindness, her heart is as corrupt as a rotting tomato, and she always behaves cruelly towards everyone. By the way, doesn’t that mean Zhang Fei [5] will become our ancestor, Huangjin?"

"Naturally." Tian Huangjin replied with a light nod. "Our first ancestor’s reincarnation is his wife, so his status is equal to hers in our race. Let’s go back now; I have to report all the incidents inside to my father and our leader."

After the winged race members left, the natural races left the Forbidden Land, followed by the people from the Divine Samsara Sect. They didn’t even bid farewell to Liang Huizhong and the elders, and they hurriedly left the sect, especially the members of the Fairy Race.
Liang Huizhong then asked Yu Shan. "What kind of information do you have about Zhang Fei [5]?"

"Sect master, please forgive me, but I can’t tell you anything about him." Yu Shan’s answer caused them all to frown. "You’ve heard that the two women by his side are the reincarnation of Empress Huo Yanling and the Eternal Flame, right? You guys didn’t witness their meeting when they arrived at our sect, and I heard Empress Huo’s parents call him their son-in-law, so—"
"Is that true? Is Zhang Fei [5] really Empress Huo’s husband?"
Yu Shan touched on the vice sect master and shared his memories of when he saw Zhang Fei [5] meeting the three fire phoenixes. "Watch them, Vice Sect Master Li Guangyu."
Li Guangyu closed his eyes for a moment, and then Liang Huizhong asked him a question. "How did it go?"
"It’s true." Li Guangyu opened his eyes. "Empress Huo’s parents truly called that kid their son-in-law, and their relationship was very close."

Liang Huizhong nodded in understanding. "Since that kid is Empress Huo’s husband, we should not disturb him. Even so, we should try to build a good relationship with him, but unfortunately, we don’t know his next destination."

Another male elder immediately spoke. "Isn’t that kid a member of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary’s entourage? Since he came to our sect with them, I’m sure Sect Master Luo and his family have information about him, and we can ask them about his next destination."

"You guys don’t need to bother with that." They turned to Yu Shan. "Zhang Fei [5] is a dual cultivator, and he already told me that he will be joining the Moonlit Passion Temple. In fact, Sect Master Qing has already appointed him as an elder, and they should be on their way there now."

Liang Huizhong and the others wore looks of disgust after Yu Shan mentioned the Moonlit Passion Temple, especially since they despised dual cultivators so badly. "Since he’s joined the sect, we don’t need to see him anymore. Although I want to build a good relationship with Empress Huo, I would rather not have any connections with those whores."
’What a stupid thought!’ Yu Shan then turned to Su Shentian and Jian Kuang, who had just arrived. "Do you want to meet Zhang Fei [5] at that sect?"

"Hahaha." Jian Kuang laughed at that. "We had a sparring appointment, and that kid asked me to meet him at the sect. However, we won’t go there straight away, especially since he also told me that he wants to rebuild that sect."

"That’s true." Since Yu Shan had previously joined Zhang Fei [5] and the others in the Temple of Forgotten Flame, he naturally knew about his plans. "Soon, the Moonlit Passion Temple will be completely transformed, and he will transform it into a universal sect with multiple fields."
"Is he also going to establish the sword hall in the sect?"

"Do you need to ask that, Old Jian?" Su Shentian asked, shaking his head. "That kid is a god-rank sword master like you, remember? Moreover, one of his closest people obviously managed to get the Sky-Severing Sword, so I’m sure he will set up the sword hall in the Moonlit Passion Temple."
Jian Kuang nodded his head several times. "Let’s go to another domain first, and we’ll go to that sect once he’s ready to spar with me."

"If that kid is smart, he must take advantage of Jian Kuang. That guy has no affiliation with any sect, and he’ll be useful for guarding the Moonlit Passion Temple, but he’ll have to defeat him first." Yu Shan immediately left the place and returned to his private quarters.

paragraphs: "Has this domain always been in this state since its inception? How can there be two moons here?" Despite this, Zhang Fei [5] felt that the two moons were quite interesting.

Qing Qiu’er shook her head. "In fact, this domain is one of the oldest in this realm, and many stories and rumors about it have been circulating for a long time; however, no one has ever been able to prove the truth of any of these claims. One story says that this domain was a punishment ground for an ancient winged race and an ancient demon who had a romantic relationship. If you look at both ends of the river, you can see two headless statues."

"Too young?" The female elder nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "In some things, experience does depend on age, but not in others, such as dual cultivation. I may be younger than any of you, but I dare say that I am far more experienced than all of you in dual cultivation."

The female elder and the others scowled in response to Zhang Fei [5]’s confidence, but then Qing Qiu’er spoke to them. "He didn’t lie to you, Hua Xiang. He is much more experienced in dual cultivation than all of us, including Feiling and me. If you guys want proof, you can try sensing all types of Yin Qi in his body."
Upon hearing that, they quickly examined Zhang Fei [5]’s body, but their expressions shifted dramatically when they found hundreds of different types of Yin Qi within him, which were extremely dense.

Zhang Fei [5] simply shook his head before taking out his alchemy token, which shocked them. "Apart from being a dual cultivator, I am also a god-rank alchemist. You previously thought that I was too young and inexperienced, but none of you have this at your age now, right?"
"God... god-rank alchemist." All of them stuttered, looking at the alchemy token.

Qing Qiu’er then revealed something else. "He is also a god-rank sword master. Even the sword maniac, Jian Kuang, challenged him to a spar. Additionally, he is also an expert soul cultivator, a supreme-rank blacksmith, a rank-10 array master, and several others."

Hua Xiang and the other elders stood like statues in their spots, dumbly looking at Zhang Fei [5]. Even though they were not alchemists, they knew that reaching the peak of alchemy was not easy, yet he did it at such a young age, and he also reached the peak in several other fields.
"Look at them, Big Sis. They’ve gone stupid from the shock," You Feiling said, shaking her head.
Su Yao and the disciples, who were standing behind the three of them, also laughed at the elders’ reactions.
Qing Qiu’er immediately put away her flying artifact before leading Zhang Fei [5] into the sect, followed by You Feiling and the others. "Let’s talk about our future plans in the main hall."
Hua Xiang and the other elders, who had already recovered their senses, hurriedly followed Qing Qiu’er and the others.

"I know many of you don’t like Qiu’er’s decision, but you shouldn’t argue with her. If you guys remain loyal to this sect, I will give you many benefits." Zhang Fei [5] directly took out fifteen bottles of basic pills and handed them to the elders. "These basic pills are just the start."

All of them immediately opened the pill bottles in their hands and checked the contents, but they right away looked at Zhang Fei [5] with their bodies shaking in excitement. "Superior grade basic pills!"

"Since everyone has made a decision, we will collaborate and put in our best efforts to rebuild this sect from scratch, and this sect will become a universal sect. "Do you have people to lead those halls?" Lan Qingyan asked.

Zhang Fei [5] was curious about Lan Qingyan, especially since she was the only elder with exotic tan skin. Although she wasn’t that pretty, her body was quite sexy and tempting, and her skin was quite exotic in his eyes.
Qing Qiu’er naturally noticed Zhang Fei [5]’s reaction, and she teased him directly. "Do you want to dual cultivate with Qingyan? Since you are an elder, you can do it with her if you like."

"Eh?" Lan Qingyan was a bit surprised to hear that, but she didn’t deny that she wanted to try dual cultivating with Zhang Fei [5], especially since he was handsome and his body was sturdy, with muscles bulging out from under his skin.

"She’s not pretty, but she’s quite special. However, we won’t do anything else now, and we will focus on our sect first." Zhang Fei [5] then opened the Yin-Yang Space, shocking Lan Qingyan and the elders.

Before long, quite a few people came out from inside, starting with Hun Di and Lin Jingxia, followed by several others. However, the elders’ reactions were the same as when they met Zhang Fei [5] previously, especially since the cultivation of those closest to him was still at the Celestial Lord Realm.

"Their cultivation is indeed far below yours, but that’s because they only ascended to this realm a few years ago. If they were born and grew up in this realm, I believe they would have already surpassed you all." Lan Qingyan and the elders found it hard to believe, prompting Zhang Fei [5] to explain their identities and point to them one by one. "He is Hun Di, and he is my master in the soul cultivation path. I got help from many women to raise my soul level, but his soul has already reached the divine level through his own hard work. Beside him is Lin Jingxia, and she is a god-rank alchemist like me. Next to her are Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji, who are the best artifact crafters in the Three Mortal Realms. Although Tie Xuan has not yet reached the supreme-rank blacksmith, he is one of the best blacksmiths I know, and I have learned a lot from him in the past. On the other hand, Ji Changlan is a supreme-rank blacksmith like me, and he leads the blacksmith union in our realm."
"Who are they?" Fang Roulan pointed to several other people.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately explained. "You Shen, his daughter, and his disciples are experts in poison, and the people of the Three Mortal Realms nickname him the Poison God. Qiu’er may not have told you about this matter, but I want to set up the Assassin Hall, and they will be responsible for it."
"The Assassin Hall?" All of them gasped in shock.

"You guys know that the Hidden Moon Sect is an assassin sect, right?" They nodded at Zhang Fei [5]. "The assassin hall will have the same function as that sect, and we will not accept all assassination assignments. I will assign a team to investigate the target’s background before we accept the task, and we will reject it if the target has a clean background."

They seemed relieved after Zhang Fei [5] said that, especially since their sect would make many enemies if they accepted all assassination assignments without regard for their targets’ backgrounds, which would bring ruin to their sect.

Zhang Fei [5] then continued, "Qiu’er told me that this sect already has a Medical Hall, but you guys don’t have a competent healer yet. Therefore, I brought Elmyra here, and some others will help her run the hall according to its function."
"Isn’t she an elf? How did you manage to persuade her to join you?" They looked at Elmyra with curious expressions.

Zhang Fei [5] looked at the female elf with a smile. "Elmyra and I came from the same realm in the Three Mortal Realms, and she has followed me for over two decades. Even though her cultivation isn’t as high as yours, her healing abilities are top-notch because she is an elf, and she always heals me whenever I experience injuries due to my lightning tribulations."

chapters.title: Chapter 1148: Start Rebuild The Sect
paragraphs: "Then, who are these other people?"

Zhang Fei [5] pointed to the two old men. "Grandpa Hong Quan is an experienced body cultivator, and Grandpa Yan Leibao is an experienced speed cultivator. They will lead the Body Hall and the Speed Hall. A true dual cultivator requires a strong physique, so I want all elders and disciples to learn the body cultivation path. I have a few body and speed cultivation techniques, and I will hand some over to them later."
"Who are those three women?" Shui Qianrou asked.

"They are three of my wives." The elders did not expect that Zhang Fei [5] would bring several of his wives to their sect. "Duanmu Luolan is a rank 10 array master, and she will lead the Array Hall. Shangguan is a domain master, and she will lead the Domain Hall. Shang Ziyuan has a unique talent, and she can create any technique from scratch, so I want her to lead the Book Hall."
’This guy! How did he manage to bring these people together? Their cultivation bases are low, but they possess extraordinary abilities in their respective fields.’
Han Yueqin then asked. "What do you mean by a domain master?"
"Yan’er."
Shangguan Yan explained it to them. "A domain master represents a unique cultivation path, as our primary goal is to create domains."
"Can everyone really create domains?" Lan Qingyan asked skeptically.

Shangguan Yan turned to the others, who immediately activated their respective domains, shocking not only all the elders but also Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling. "Naturally, not everyone can create their domains, especially if they don’t know the basics. We, domain masters, are different from others, and we can help everyone to create one. I can help you create your domain, but its strength and function depend on you, whether it’s elements or other things."
All the elders nodded in understanding after Shangguan Yan said all that, and they were excited for the opportunity to create their own domain.

Zhang Fei [5] then pointed to the other two. "Lin Moxian is my senior brother in the soul cultivation path, but he is also a puppeteer, as is Miao Miao. I plan to establish a Puppet Hall, and anyone interested is welcome to join. In addition to those halls, I will also establish the Business and Beast Tamer Halls, but I haven’t appointed leaders for both yet."
"What’s the use of the Business Hall?" Yue Xi asked in confusion.

"Do you think a sect can develop without having a business?" Yue Xi shook her head at Zhang Fei [5]. "The duty of the members of the Business Hall is to organize and supervise the sect’s business out there, and they will establish trade with other sects from this domain or other domains. Regarding the Beast Tamer Hall, I don’t need to explain the details, right?"
"The Beast Tamer Hall is for those who fight relying on the beasts." Mei Ruyan said.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Beast tamers are quite unique, but not everyone can become one, and only those with a deep understanding of beasts can do so. This hall may be the smallest of all the halls, but if its members manage to tame powerful beasts, it will become the most powerful among the others. As for the technique, I have one, but the results still depend on their hard work."
"Then, what about the Sword Hall? Who will lead it?" This time, Xue Ling asked him.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at her. "I haven’t decided on the leader yet, but I already have a candidate, and I will wait for that person to come to our sect first."
"Who is that person?"

"The Sword Maniac, Jian Kuang." They gasped after Zhang Fei [5] mentioned the name. "I’ve heard that he’s not affiliated with any sect, but I might have a way to persuade him to join our sect. If I succeed, it will be beneficial for us, and if I fail, I’ll lead the Sword Hall myself. By the way, I think my explanation is enough for now, and I want all of you to gather the disciples. Once they are gathered, we will start opening up the areas that have never been touched before, and we will use those materials to build all those halls."

The elders turned to Qing Qiu’er first, especially since she was their sect master. "As I said before, you guys must follow his orders. The faster you move, the faster we can rebuild this sect. I want them to work seriously, and I believe our sect will become one of the important forces in this realm in the future."

All the elders still couldn’t understand why Qing Qiu’er favored Zhang Fei [5] so much. They admitted his talents were extraordinary, but they felt that her attitude toward him was too weird. Despite this, they hurriedly left the hall, gathering all the disciples of their sect.

You Feiling brought Su Yao to join them, and Zhang Fei [5] summoned more people out of the training space and beast space. He asked them to assist the disciples in accelerating the rebuilding process of the sect.

Zhe Wuming and the others also joined them, except for Elmyra, Duanmu Luolan, Shangguan Yan, and Shang Ziyuan. Zhang Fei [5] sent them back to the training space, especially since the others had enough to help those disciples.
After they left, Qing Qiu’er moved to Zhang Fei [5]’s lap, embraced his neck, and gave him a brief kiss. "How long will the process take to complete?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] gave it a thought first. "A few weeks or a few months, especially since we will be building several halls at once. We also need a lot of furniture to fill them all, but we won’t waste jewels by buying them in the Sky Pillar Domain, and we will buy them in the Three Mortal Realms."

"Huh?" Qing Qiu’er looked confused by that. "Wouldn’t that be too much of a waste of time? Taking into account the distance from the border to the Three Mortal Realms, it would take us several months to go there and back."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate leading to Earth and took Qing Qiu’er to disappear into it.

Up in the sky, Qing Qiu’er was stunned as she saw the cities below them, but she quickly covered her nose with Qi. The pollution on Earth was still high, even though Zhang Fei [5] had installed many devices created by Gong Ren to clean it up, especially since earthlings were too dependent on technology.
Qing Qiu’er tilted her head to the side. "Are we in the Three Mortal Realms now? Why is the Qi here so thin?"

"This planet is Earth, one of the planets in the lower realms of the Three Mortal Realms, which is also my birth planet." Qing Qiu’er was surprised by Zhang Fei [5]’s answer. "In the past, the Qi disappeared completely from this planet due to a major event, and no cultivator was ever born here afterward. As I said some time ago, I became a cultivator due to an accident. I have tried to clean the air on this planet using many artifacts to bring Qi back, but it hasn’t been completely clean, so you don’t need to be surprised if the Qi here can barely exist."
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

Qing Qiu’er frowned as several people appeared in front of them, prompting Zhang Fei [5] to explain. "Pang Hong, Pang Gui, Mo Zifeng, and Zheng Mohei are my slaves, whom I was assigned to protect this planet. I have several slaves that I left in other realms, which are connected to this planet. Some of the mythical beasts you met before are also my slaves, such as Huli Jinhu, Long Jiuxiao, Wang Yitao, Dai Yishu, and several others."
"I see." Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding, but she thought that the people in front of them had no use in the Paradise Realm.
After his slaves reported some things, Zhang Fei [5] took Qing Qiu’er to take quite a lot of items in all the warehouses before returning to the Paradise Realm again.

Qing Qiu’er was already on Zhang Fei [5]’s lap again. "This sect has several special places. The Blossoming Hall is where disciples practice charm techniques, conduct dual cultivation ceremonies, and celebrate a few things. The Lunar Garden is filled with herbs and plants for dual cultivation. The Harmonious Chamber is a place for disciples to dual cultivate with their partners, and it is equipped with several formations. The Silent Pavilion is a place for those who have lost their partners to reflect in silence, especially those who have not yet come to terms with their partner’s death. The last one is the Celestial Lake, but I can’t explain in detail about this place, and you can try going there to find out the effects."

Zhang Fei [5] put Qing Qiu’er down and led her away. "Let’s look around those places first, and I’ll see if there’s anything I can do about them, especially the Harmonious Chamber and the Lunar Garden."

The Harmonious Chamber was almost no different from the Yin-Yang Chamber in the Yin-Yang Pavilion, but the formations inside were much stronger, resulting in a much higher concentration of Qi. "These formations are excellent, but Luolan and I will add a few more, and they will enhance the effect of their dual cultivation."
"That’s great!" Qing Qiu’er exclaimed happily. "Let’s go to the Lunar Garden."

Some of the mythical beasts you met before are also my slaves, such as Huli Jinhu, Long Jiuxiao, Wang Yitao, Dai Yishu, and several others."
"I see." Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding, but she thought that the people in front of them had no use in the Paradise Realm.
After his slaves reported some things, Zhang Fei [5] took Qing Qiu’er to take quite a lot of items in all the warehouses before returning to the Paradise Realm again.
Qing Qiu’er was already on Zhang Fei [5]’s lap again.
"This sect has several special places.
The Blossoming Hall is where disciples practice charm techniques, conduct dual cultivation ceremonies, and celebrate a few things.
The Lunar Garden is filled with herbs and plants for dual cultivation.
The Harmonious Chamber is a place for disciples to dual cultivate with their partners, and it is equipped with several formations.
The Silent Pavilion is a place for those who have lost their partners to reflect in silence, especially those who have not yet come to terms with their partner’s death.
The last one is the Celestial Lake, but I can’t explain in detail about this place, and you can try going there to find out the effects."
Zhang Fei [5] put Qing Qiu’er down and led her away.
"Let’s look around those places first, and I’ll see if there’s anything I can do about them, especially the Harmonious Chamber and the Lunar Garden."
The Harmonious Chamber was almost no different from the Yin-Yang Chamber in the Yin-Yang Pavilion, but the formations inside were much stronger, resulting in a much higher concentration of Qi.
"These formations are excellent, but Luolan and I will add a few more, and they will enhance the effect of their dual cultivation."

"Let’s go to the Lunar Garden."

paragraphs: In the Lunar Garden, Zhang Fei [5] saw so many kinds of herbs and plants that have many benefits for dual cultivation, and all of them are not yet available in the Sealed World Pearl. He crouched in front of one and plucked it down to its roots. "Where did you get all this? This Yang Flame Orchid is difficult to find, and they usually grow in scorching hot areas."

"Hehe." Qing Qiu’er giggled. "This sect is a dual cultivation sect, remember? We often travel to all domains, except for demon domains, to look for herbs or plants suitable for dual cultivation. You are not wrong about this Yang Flame Orchid, but the soil of this garden is different from the usual ones. I don’t know how or where it came from, but it was already here long before the Sun Moon Sect founded their sect. This garden is one of the reasons they keep trying to seize this floating plateau from us, especially since we can grow all kinds of herbs or plants here, including those that should only grow in places with extreme hot or extreme cold weather."

Zhang Fei [5] stored the Yang Flame Orchid in the system’s inventory before plucking another herb not far away. "This Yin Fragrance Lily has a high concentration of Yin Qi, and it can be used to concoct pills that can enhance women’s Yin Qi, increasing the amount of Yin Qi they produce when dual cultivating. "You’re right." Qing Qiu’er squatted beside Zhang Fei [5]. "However, such pills are not the ultimate solution, and they will become dependent on their effects if they are used long-term. The best solution is for them to learn the body cultivation path, and their physiques will become stronger as their body cultivation improves."

Qing Qiu’er tilted her head to him. "Do you have a short-term solution for them? Not all cultivators have talent in the body cultivation path, and increasing our body cultivation level is more difficult than increasing our normal cultivation. I don’t want them to have partner issues, but I also don’t want them to rely on this herb forever. If you have one, you can tell me."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] considered and calculated several things for quite a while before asking her. "How many are our disciples in total?"

"The number of our disciples is still not as large as the Sun Moon Sect, which reaches almost ten thousand, but there are still quite a lot of them." Zhang Fei [5] was a bit surprised to hear the number of disciples in that sect from Qing Qiu’er. "The total number of our disciples is only three thousand, and we deliberately accept more female disciples to avoid undesirable things, with 1600 female disciples and 1400 male disciples. Like sects in general, we divide them into outer, inner, and core disciples."
Zhang Fei [5] then activated the natural awareness ability, checking the Qi strength of the female disciples. "Does our sect use sect points to buy items in the Treasure Hall?"
"Yes." Qing Qiu’er nodded slightly. "Sect points are the primary currency, but they can also use equal exchange to purchase rare items."
"So, they can’t use jewels to buy items?"

"If we allow our disciples to buy items using jewels, their strength will become unbalanced." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow at Qing Qiu’er. "In fact, we have one group of ten disciples whose statuses are slightly above those of the core disciples because they come from exceptional backgrounds, and their talents surpass the rest."

"Ten disciples in a special group?" Qing Qiu’er touched Zhang Fei’s forehead and shared with him the identities of those disciples, who were divided into five male and five female disciples. "Are they partnered with each other?"

Qing Qiu’er explained it to him. "They met in this sect, and they decided to become dual cultivation partners because of their similar backgrounds. Yao Shiyan and Fei Yinglin were the best male and female disciples among them, and they had the longest-lasting relationship. They came from the renowned Yao and Fei Clans in the Sky Pillar Domain, but their parents banished them from their clans because of their choice to become dual cultivators."

"I see." Zhang Fei [5] was not surprised by that, especially since the reputation of dual cultivators in the Paradise Realm was terrible. He then took out several storage rings and handed them to Qing Qiu’er. "I don’t need sect points, so you can ask the disciples to exchange them for equivalent items. After they swallow them, their foundation and physique will become stronger. Even so, they still have to become body cultivators to achieve true physical strength, and they will no longer be dependent on these herbs."
"Alright, I will arrange it according to your wishes."

After Zhang Fei [5] picked enough herbs and plants, Qing Qiu’er took him to see the other areas, starting with the Blossoming Hall, where they found many disciples practicing charm techniques, and some of them performing small ceremonies as dual cultivation partners.

They didn’t linger there, and Qing Qiu’er led Zhang Fei [5] to the Silent Pavilion. There weren’t many disciples there, and those who were there were doing nothing but meditating silently. Then, she led him to the last area, the Celestial Lake.

The Celestial Lake is the most sacred place in the Moonlit Passion Temple. It stretches vast and tranquil, its surface smooth as glass, reflecting the twin moons. The water is no ordinary water; it is said to be condensed from the pure yin and yang essence of the twin moons and suns of the Twin Flames Main Domain, balancing yin and yang in perfect harmony. The mist that rose from the lake carried a faint, sweet yet intoxicating fragrance, said to awaken hidden and dormant desires.

At the center of the lake lies a small island with four solid wooden bridges spanning four different sides, where many lotuses bloom in endless cycles. However, there is only one lotus that stands out as the most precious among all of them. The Moon Lotus, the same color as the moon, blooms once every hundred years, emitting the finest fragrance. It will help cultivators achieve breakthroughs, especially female dual cultivators.
At night, the lake becomes even more wondrous with the reflections of the two moons overlapping, turning the water into a sea of shimmering silver light.
Zhang Fei [5] squatted by the lakeside as he sensed something peculiar about it. He dipped his hand into the water to feel the difference. "The ones who benefit most from this lake are the women."

"Yes." Qing Qiu’er squatted next to him. "Actually, there are two celestial lakes in this domain, and the other one is in the Blazing Union Sect, which is the second strongest dual cultivation sect after the Sun-Moon Sect. If the lake in our sect produces more Yin Qi, the one in that sect produces more Yang Qi. Therefore, we often exchange disciples with them, but each of us only sends our best disciples."
"Do the elders of both sects do this too often?"

Qing Qiu’er shook her head. "Our sect has more female elders, and their sect has more male elders. In contrast to our sect, the male elders of that sect hold more important roles, while their female elders merely serve as assistants; therefore, we never exchange elders."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] then summoned Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing out of the training space. "Try both of you to enter this lake and absorb the Yin Qi in it."

"There are no male elders or disciples coming here, and a concealment formation covers this area, so you don’t need to worry about them." After Qing Qiu’er said that, Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing swiftly took off their dresses and jumped directly into the lake. She was quite jealous of their beauty and sexiness. "Try absorbing the Yin Qi now."
Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing closed their eyes and absorbed the Yin Qi within. Their expressions changed as the Yin Qi began to flow through their bodies, and they absorbed it even faster.

Zhang Fei [5] seriously observed the flow of Yin Qi within their bodies, discovering that the Yin Qi from the lake not only strengthened theirs but also increased the quality and quantity. "If female cultivators cultivate in this lake, their cultivation will skyrocket."

"That’s right," Qing Qiu’er replied with a nod. "The Yin Qi in this lake is one of the reasons my cultivation reached this stage so quickly, and its effects are even more significant when combined with the Forbidden Lotus Codex. Otherwise, I would still need thousands of years to reach this level, especially my soul cultivation level."

paragraphs: "Let me try it." Qing Qiu’er was confused when Zhang Fei [5] floated to the top of the lake and sat cross-legged there, especially since there was only Yin Qi in it.
Zhang Fei [5] opened the training space, and Zhang Fei [4] walked out of it before turning into a woman, leaving Qing Qiu’er dumbfounded.
Zhang Fei [5] then released his soul, and Zhang Fei [4] sat behind him with his palms pressed against his back.
Zhang Fei [4] absorbed the Yin Qi from the lake and channeled it into Zhang Fei [5]’s body and soul, and it was then absorbed by the white lotus within his soul.

’Is that one of his lust demon’s abilities? I heard that a lust demon is genderless and can transform into either a male or a female at any time. Qing Qiu’er observed the movement of Yin Qi from the lake entering Zhang Fei [4]’s body, and it was continuously absorbed by the white lotus within Zhang Fei [5]’s soul. ’Where did he get the idea to use this method? Their soul cultivation levels are equal, and the two are basically one person, so the effect is much more powerful for him.’
*Thud*
Qing Qiu’er turned to the woman who had just landed. "Do you want to cultivate here, Fei Yinglin?"

Fei Yinglin has fair, delicate features, and there is a small jewel-like marking on her forehead. Her long, straight, and black hair flows past her shoulders. Her eyes were slanted, with thin eyebrows above them. Her lips were full, covered in light pink. Her figure was tall and proportionate, with a narrow waist accentuated by the decorative golden belt. She wore a long, plain purple dress with an off-shoulder design, exposing her collarbones and upper chest. Her neckline was dipped slightly, shaped to accentuate her medium-sized breasts.
"You Shiyan just left on a mission with the others, so I came here to cultivate, Sect Master." Fei Yinglin then looked at the lake. "Who are they?"

"The man is our sect’s new elder, Zhang Fei [5]." Fei Yinglin looked at Qing Qiu’er with surprise. "I don’t know the identity of the woman behind him, but the two women cultivating in the lake are two of his many wives, Sima Huiqing and Yan Jinwu. Have you heard the latest announcement?"
Fei Yinglin nodded at her. "Are you serious about turning this sect into a universal one? Are you sure it will work with our bad reputation?"

"Hehehe." Qing Qiu’er pointed her index finger toward Zhang Fei [5]. "It won’t work if we do it ourselves, but his presence will help us succeed. His cultivation is still at the One-Sun Celestial Lord Realm, but he possesses many statuses that no cultivator has ever possessed before."
Fei Yinglin returned her gaze to Zhang Fei [5]. "What statuses does he have at such a young age?"

"A god-rank alchemist, a god-rank sword master, and many more." Qing Qiu’er’s answer caused Fei Yinglin to stare dumbly at Zhang Fei [5]. "You don’t need to doubt my words, especially since Su Yao, my sister, and I have personally witnessed some of his abilities. Therefore, I appointed him as an elder, and his people will help us in rebuilding our sect."

"I never doubt your decisions, and since you believe in his abilities, I will also believe in him." Fei Yinglin paused for a moment. "If he really succeeds in changing this sect from a dual cultivation sect to a universal one, it will have a huge impact on all of us. However, we cannot place all disciples in one place, especially since the majority of them despise dual cultivators."
Qing Qiu’er nodded at her. "We are already aware of that, and we plan to build the other halls under the mountain. We will also build some new residences, and the new disciples will live there."

"Then, who are the people who will be responsible for those halls?" Qing Qiu’er told Fei Yinglin the identities of several of Zhang Fei [5]’s closest people, who had already started cleaning up the areas under the mountain. "Our cultivation only guarantees our strength, but it doesn’t guarantee our talents in various cultivation paths. If those people truly possess excellent talents in all those areas, I’m sure your plan will work, but the changes won’t happen in a short time."
"That’s true." Qing Qiu’er then asked. "Are you still going to cultivate here?"

"All of us are dual cultivators, so I don’t need to be embarrassed by his presence." Fei Yinglin swiftly took off her purple dress, dropped it to the ground, and entered the lake. In a few moments, she was already immersed in her cultivation, without caring about her surroundings or Zhang Fei [5]’s presence.
Qing Qiu’er’s lips curled up into a weird smile, but she quickly undressed and joined them in the lake.

Meanwhile, Tianshi Shengjie and Long Youjia were already standing in front of Long Wuzhao, with their fathers behind him. The female celestial dragon immediately reported to them the events that had occurred in the Forbidden Land earlier, especially the invasion of the demons and evil beasts, including their deaths. "Emperor, according to Empress Huo, the beast is an ancient beast, which is a mixed breed of the Ancient Celestial Dragon and the Longevity Deer. Additionally, the merchant does not come from the Paradise Realm but the Ancient Realm, and the Forbidden Land is the border that connects the two."

Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, and Tianshi Bailong were not too surprised by their explanation. In fact, they had long been aware that there was another realm beyond the Paradise Realm, and they had also long suspected that the merchant was indeed from that realm. However, they never expected that the Forbidden Land was the border between the two realms, and they had never found a connecting passage to that realm.
"Brothers, my previous guess turned out to be correct, and Empress Huo Yanling is indeed the reincarnation of an ancient race." Long Xukong spoke.
Tianshi Bailong nodded in agreement with him. "It’s no wonder Empress Huo was able to defeat the three of us effortlessly in the past."
"Did Empress Huo say anything to you, Shengjie?" Long Wuzhao asked.
Tianshi Shengjie shook her head in response. "Empress Huo didn’t tell me anything, but I have one piece of news that will surely shock the three of you."
"What kind of news is that?"

"Even though Empress Huo still hasn’t accepted Zhang Fei, her parents have already acknowledged him as their son-in-law." Tianshi Shengjie laughed when she saw the three old dragons stunned by the news. "Additionally, he has decided to join Moonlit Passion Temple as an elder, and he will turn the sect into a universal sect."

"Emperor! Father! Uncle Bailong! I’m a little confused about Zhang Fei." The three old dragons looked at Long Youjia. "Back then, the three of you said that he was a kid in his early twenties, but he turned out to be in his early forties, and his cultivation had already reached the 1-Sun Celestial Lord Realm."
"Is that true, Shengjie?" Tianshi Bailong asked his daughter.

Tianshi Shengjie nodded at him. "Youjia is telling the truth, Father. I myself am confused as to how Zhang Fei could have aged so quickly, especially since he was still in his early twenties when Tian Huangjin and I met him at the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary a little over five years ago. Back then, he had just broken through to the Divine Expansion Realm, but he had already reached the Celestial Lord Realm now."
"How could he do that, Brother Wuzhao?"

Long Wuzhao shook his head slightly. "I haven’t met Zhang Fei in person, so I don’t have a definite answer on that. Since he wants to rebuild the Moonlit Passion Sect, he’ll definitely be busy for the next few months, so I’ll wait for him to finish his business before going to see him."

"Emperor, I think you shouldn’t go to see Zhang Fei for the time being and wait for him to come to our domain by himself." Tianshi Shengjie directly explained to them the reason, which made the three old dragons sigh.
"You’re right, I shouldn’t go to see him." Long Wuzhao then asked his two comrades for their opinions. "Do you guys think we need to send some of our younger generations to the sect to help him?"
Long Xukong immediately gave his opinion. "We can send some people to the sect, but we shouldn’t send those who are mythical beasts."
"I agree with you, Brother Xukong." Tianshi Bailong spoke. "We can send some divine beasts with higher cultivation than him, but we have to wait until the sect is ready to become a universal one."
"Yes." Long Wuzhao then spoke to Tianshi Shengji. "You know Zhang Fei better than we do, so I want you to choose some divine beasts to join his sect."
"I will select some of them now, Emperor."
After Tianshi Shengjie and Long Youjia left the place, Long Wuzhao discussed some matters with the two old dragons. Not long after, Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong hurriedly left their domain.

In the Radiance Domain, Tian Huangjin, Tian Huotian, and Tian Zhiling stood before several grand elders of the Winged Race. They reported on all the events in the Forbidden Land, including the appearance of their first ancestors.
"What do you guys think about that little girl? Should we bring her to this domain?" A female grand elder asked the others.
